11990:
A fedora is a rare drop from the crazy archaeologist , it being the hat he wears. It is purely cosmetic and has no bonuses.

Players wearing a fedora can right click it via the Worn Equipment tab in and selecting "Tip" to perform an emote where the player tips their fedora.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room .
11992:
Lava scales are always dropped by lava dragons at the Lava Dragon Isle located in the Wilderness . They are also dropped uncommonly by brutal black dragons . The shards are an ingredient for extended antifire and extended super antifire potions.

Lava scales themselves have no use, but when ground with a pestle and mortar , players can obtain between 3-6 lava scale shards . This amount will be increased by 50% rounded down with completion of the hard Wilderness Diary , meaning that each scale will yield either 4, 6, 7, or 9 shards when ground. [ 1 ] The amount received is random, with high Herblore level yielding a higher average. [ 2 ] With 99 Herblore, there is a 98% chance of receiving the maximum amount of shards. [ 3 ]

If asking Wesley to grind them, he can only crush one scale to three shards, warning the player of this before proceeding.

Note: If attempting to obtain lava scale shards, infernal eel fishing is a viable option for players wishing to avoid the Wilderness.
11994:
Lava scale shards are the result of using a pestle and mortar on a lava scale , which is dropped by lava dragons and brutal black dragons . Grinding a scale yields between 3-6 shards, with higher Herblore levels yielding a higher average. If the hard Wilderness Diary is complete, this amount will be increased by 50%, rounded down, meaning that players can receive either 4, 6, 7, or 9 shards per scale.

They can also be obtained by using a hammer on an infernal eel , which require level 80 Fishing to catch. Each eel has a 1/8.75 chance to yield between 1-5 shards.

The shards are used as an ingredient to make extended antifires and extended super antifires , requiring levels 84 and 98 Herblore to create, respectively, with 1 shard being used per dose.
11995:
The pet chaos elemental is a pet that resembles the miniature chaotic clouds that inhabit the area where the Chaos Fanatic resides, and can be obtained by killing the Chaos Elemental or the Chaos Fanatic.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat), it will be placed into their inventory. When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne.

On death, if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.
11996:
The Helix fossil was an unobtainable item that could previously be found in the game cache.

Its purpose is unknown, but it may have been used during holiday events, as it was later replaced by the holiday tool in a hidden update.
11997: Easter is an unobtainable item added with the 2014 Easter event. Presumably, it would have been used by Jagex moderators to spawn Eggs during community events, similar to the community pumpkin and the holiday tool.
11998:
The smoke battlestaff is an elemental staff requiring 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield. The staff provides unlimited amounts of air and fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

The mystic smoke staff is an even stronger alternative, providing better melee and magic stat bonuses. It is obtained by taking the smoke battlestaff and 40,000 to Thormac . (Reduced to 30,000 or 20,000 with completion of the hard and elite Kandarin diaries respectively.)

The staff provides a 10% increase to Magic accuracy and damage when casting spells from the standard spellbook ; this bonus also applies to curse spells . [ 1 ]

The staff is only obtainable as a potential drop from the thermonuclear smoke devil .
12000:
The mystic smoke staff is an elemental staff requiring 40 Attack and 40 Magic to wield. In addition to increased Melee and Magic Attack bonuses, the staff provides unlimited amounts of air and fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

Like the smoke battlestaff , it provides a 10% increase in accuracy and damage when casting spells from the standard spellbook ; this bonus also applies to curse spells . [ 1 ]

This staff can be created after the completion of the quest Scorpion Catcher by taking a smoke battlestaff and 40,000 coins to Thormac . After completion of the Hard Kandarin Diary and Elite Kandarin Diary , Thormac will only require 30,000 coins or 20,000 coins respectively.
12002:
The occult necklace is a magical amulet that requires 70 Magic to wear. It is dropped by the smoke devil and its boss variant. Wearing it increases the player's Magic damage by 5%, and is the only amulet to give such a bonus. This 5% bonus will also stack with existing boosts, such as the staff of the dead and the imbued slayer helmet. The salve amulet(ei) does not apply its damage bonus to other hit targets when barraging. The 3rd Age amulet possess slightly higher magic accuracy but lacks magic strength. Thus, aside from using single target magic damage against undead mobs, or in situations where landing a single spell is pivotal, it is the best neck slot item for magic damage output.

A combination of the occult necklace and staff of the dead while using Ice Barrage would increase a player's max hit to 36, from an original maximum of 30. The max hit increases to 40 if using a black mask (i) or slayer helmet (i) on a Slayer task.

Players can attach an occult ornament kit, obtained from master clue scrolls, to cosmetically enhance the necklace, creating an occult necklace (or). This only alters its appearance, and gives no stat enhancements. It can be dismantled, returning the necklace and ornament kit.
12004:
A kraken tentacle is obtained from killing cave krakens (and their boss version ) in the Kraken Cove , located just south-west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony . The tentacle is used to make abyssal tentacles , enhanced tridents of the seas , and enhanced tridents of the swamps .

When the tentacle is used on an abyssal whip , an upgraded version of the whip, the abyssal tentacle , is created. The upgraded abyssal tentacle requires level 75 Attack to wield. Once combined with the whip, the weapon will degrade after 10,000 hits, consuming the whip and leaving only the tentacle. When using the items on each other there will be a warning message that states The tentacle will gradually consume your whip and destroy it. You won't be able to get the whip out again. The combined item is not tradeable.

Ten kraken tentacles can be given to Lieve McCracken to enhance a trident of the seas or swamp to hold 20,000 charges instead of 2,500. Ten tentacles are required for every trident the player wishes to enhance.
12006:
The abyssal tentacle is a weapon which requires 75 Attack to wield. It is created by combining a kraken tentacle with an abyssal whip. It is an upgraded variant of the whip, having a +8 increase in Slash and +4 increase in Strength over its predecessor. It also has a 25% chance per hit to poison the opponent, which starts at 4 damage. With regard to 4 tick one-handed weapons, the +90 slash bonus of the abyssal tentacle is second only to the +100 slash bonus of the Blade of Saeldor.

The abyssal tentacle can be created by using a kraken tentacle on an abyssal whip. Once created, the weapon will degrade after 10,000 attacks, including misses. Afterwards the whip is consumed, leaving only the tentacle. When using the items on each other there will be a warning message notifying the player that this process is irreversible and the abyssal tentacle is not tradeable.

If the abyssal tentacle is not protected upon death, it will fully degrade into a kraken tentacle. However, if it is protected on death, it will remain in its regular state as the abyssal tentacle. In addition, the abyssal tentacle does not stack in the bank, regardless of the number of charges the abyssal tentacles have.

Using a Shattered relics variety ornament kit on an abyssal tentacle will change its appearance into that of an abyssal tentacle (or).
12007:
The jar of dirt is a rare drop from the Kraken boss.

The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the Kraken. Doing so requires killing it at least once.
12009:
Soft clay pack is an item pack containing 100 noted soft clay. It is obtainable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop in the Motherlode Mine for 10 golden nuggets, from Belona's Mining Guild Mineral Exchange for 10 unidentified minerals, or from Dusuri's Star Shop for 150 stardust.

When purchasing clay packs, gold nuggets and minerals are worth 1,160, and stardust is worth 77.33.

The packs are exclusive to the stores they are bought from and therefore cannot be sold to another store in exchange for a different currency.
12010:
The Soft clay pack is a discontinued version of the standard Soft clay pack bought from Prospector Percy.

Originally, soft clay packs could be traded, and therefore turned into banknotes. This allowed players to purchase soft clay packs from other players, and sell them back to Prospector Percy to quickly gain gold nuggets to buy the Prospector kit. While this was accepted at first, it inadvertently provided a quick shortcut for a task in the hard Falador Diary. Although this was first accepted by Jagex Moderators as an "unforeseen feature", the packs were changed to become untradeable in an update on 9 April 2015.

Any player who had a bank note version of the Soft clay pack was given this item as a replacement, which is a unique stackable variant of the standard pack. They can no longer be obtained, but remain in the inventories of any player who had them before, making them a rare example of a discontinued item in Old School RuneScape.
12011:
Pay-dirt is obtained while mining ore veins within the Motherlode Mine . Mining pay-dirt grants 60 (up to 61.5 with full prospector outfit ) Mining experience and requires a minimum Mining level of 30. Pay-dirt can be cleaned by depositing them into the hopper in the centre of the mine. Once cleaned players must search a sack to claim their ores, which is dependent on the player's Mining level. Pay-dirt cannot be deposited in the bank.

Players have a 1/32 (~3.13%) chance of obtaining a golden nugget per pay-dirt, which can be used to purchase the prospector outfit and other mining-related rewards from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop . The number of golden nuggets received is limited to 3 per batch of pay-dirt deposited into the hopper. While this limit doesn't cause issues during normal gameplay, seasonal events with boosted rates can cause golden nuggets to be deleted. To avoid this, players can deposit half of their pay-dirt at a time by dropping the other half before depositing.

Which ore the pay-dirt becomes is determined at the time it is mined. If using a temporary boost, to try to get ore above your level, use the boost while mining , as opposed to using the boost at the hopper and sack.

The double-ore bonus from Varrock armour does not apply to pay-dirt.
12012:
Golden nuggets are obtained in the Motherlode Mine by searching the sack after cleaning the pay-dirt.

They can be traded in for various rewards from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop.
12013:
The prospector helmet is a part of the Prospector kit that can be bought from the Motherlode Mine in exchange for 40 golden nuggets , or from the Volcanic Mine for 26,000 points. The helmet increases Mining experience by 0.4% when worn. Despite having two lights attached to it, the Prospector helmet does not act as a light source.

Wearing the prospector helmet while entering the Mining Guild is a task in the hard Falador Diary .

Like the rest of the Prospector kit, the helmet provides partial protection against the heat of the Kharidian desert , adding 4 seconds to the interval between required sips from a waterskin, or 34 seconds if the entire set is worn.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Prospector kit set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

Note : Any piece of the set that was purchased from the Petrified Pete's Ore Shop can't be sold for golden nuggets at the Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop . If you try to do this, you will receive the message " You can't sell this item back to Percy as you did not buy it from this shop ".
12014:
The prospector jacket is one part of the prospector outfit and is a reward from the Motherlode Mine in exchange for 60 Golden nuggets or from Volcanic Mine for 39,000 points. The jacket gives a Mining experience boost of 0.8% when worn.

Alternatively, a player can use the Varrock armour 4 from the elite Varrock Achievement diary to receive the experience bonus.

Like the rest of the Prospector kit, the jacket provides partial protection against the heat of the Kharidian desert , adding 12 seconds to the interval between required sips from a waterskin, or 34 seconds if the entire set is worn.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Prospector kit set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

Note : Any piece of the set that was purchased from the Petrified Pete's Ore Shop can't be sold for golden nuggets at the Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop . If you try to do this, you will receive the message " You can't sell this item back to Percy as you did not buy it from this shop ".
12015:
The prospector legs are a part of the Prospector kit that can be bought from the Motherlode Mine in exchange for 50 golden nuggets or Volcanic Mine for 34,000 points. These leggings increase Mining experience by 0.6% when worn.

Like the rest of the Prospector kit, the legs provide partial protection against the heat of the Kharidian desert , adding 12 seconds to the interval between required sips from a waterskin, or 34 seconds if the entire set is worn.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Prospector kit set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

Note : Any piece of the set that was purchased from the Petrified Pete's Ore Shop can't be sold for golden nuggets at the Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop . If you try to do this, you will receive the message " You can't sell this item back to Percy as you did not buy it from this shop ".
12016:
Prospector boots are part of the Prospector kit set, worn in the foot slot. The Prospector boots increase Mining experience by 0.2% when worn.

They can be purchased from Prospector Percy for 30 golden nuggets or from Volcanic Mine for 21,000 points.

Like the rest of the Prospector kit, the boots provide partial protection against the heat of the Kharidian desert , adding 6 seconds to the interval between required sips from a waterskin, or 34 seconds if the entire set is worn.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Prospector kit set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

Note : Any piece of the set that was purchased from the Petrified Pete's Ore Shop can't be sold for golden nuggets at the Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop . If you try to do this, you will receive the message " You can't sell this item back to Percy as you did not buy it from this shop ".
12017:
The Salve amulet (i) is the imbued form of the salve amulet , granting an additional 16.67% [ 1 ] increase in the wearer's ranged accuracy and damage, as well as a 15% increase for magic , when fighting undead monsters .

The salve amulet is imbued by using either 800,000 Nightmare Zone points (halved upon completing the hard combat achievements ), 320 Soul Wars Zeal Tokens , or by using a scroll of imbuing on the amulet. Amulets imbued through the latter two methods do not count for completing the Ardougne Diary task. [ 2 ] Furthermore, amulets imbued at one location cannot be refunded at a different location.
12018:
The Salve amulet(ei) is the enchanted and imbued form of the salve amulet , granting a 20% increase in the wearer's accuracy and damage for melee , ranged , and magic when fighting undead monsters .

The salve amulet's bonuses against the undead do not stack with the black mask and slayer helmet's on-task bonuses; wearing both will only apply the bonuses of the salve amulet (ei). The salve amulet also does not have an effect on the dwarf multicannon 's accuracy. [ 1 ] However, the bonuses of Void Knight equipment do stack with the salve amulet. Additionally, the amulet's effects apply to all targets when using multi-hitting melee weapons in a multicombat area , such as the Scythe of Vitur and the special attack of the dragon 2h sword , but not for multi-hitting magic and ranged attacks (ex. chinchompas and burst spells ).
12019:
The coal bag is a reward purchasable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 100 golden nuggets . The coal bag holds up to 27 pieces of coal (36 if a Smithing cape is equipped). When smelting or superheating , coal in the bag will be used after the coal in the inventory . It is refillable just like essence pouches , though unlike an essence pouch, it does not degrade . This is useful for both mining and smithing as it effectively doubles the amount of coal a player can carry and thus the number of bars a player can make per inventory of ore. Coal placed inside the bag will not add additional weight to your character until removed from the coal bag.

Players can right-click to open the bag, which will have coal that the player mines from coal rocks be automatically placed inside the bag, providing there is space for it.

Alternatively, players can hold-shift and left-click to empty the coal bag without the need to right-click, if " shift click to drop items " is enabled in the settings.

Only one coal bag may be in the player's possession at any time. It cannot be traded or dropped but it can be destroyed if it is empty. Players may sell their coal bag back to Percy in exchange for golden nuggets equal to 80% of its original cost (80 golden nuggets ).

Warning: Attempting to use alchemy spells on the coal bag will destroy it regardless of whether or not there was any coal in it.
12020:
The gem bag is a gem container purchasable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 100 golden nuggets . It can hold 60 of each (300 total) uncut gems of the following types:

A full gem bag is worth 1,129,980 . To deposit a gem, players can use the gem with the gem bag or left-click the bag to store all uncut gems in their inventory. This will produce a game message saying, You add the gem[s] to your bag. Players can empty the bag via a right-click option or by shift-clicking the bag (if they have shift-click item dropping enabled) in their inventory or whilst their bank is open.

Ultimate Ironmen get an additional interface when emptying their gem pouch that allows them to choose the type of gem and the quantity to withdraw.

Players can "open" the bag via a right-click option. Whilst open, any gems that the player picks up off the ground or obtains during Mining and Thieving are automatically placed inside the bag, if there is enough space. Players will receive a game message confirming the open gem bag automatically stored the gem saying, You put it straight into your open gem bag.

Players may only own one gem bag at a time. On death , the gem bag does not lose its contents. Players who no longer want their gem bag can sell it back to Percy for 80% of the original cost.
12021: Clue scroll (medium) is an emote clue obtained from medium Treasure Trails.
12022:
A casket could previously be received after completing any step of a Treasure Trail . These caskets did not always contain a reward, and sometimes only gave another clue scroll.

On 28 July 2016 Treasure Trails were updated. Caskets were replaced with new items called Reward caskets . They are only received once all steps have been completed, and are guaranteed to contain a reward.

Although caskets are no longer obtainable, they are still ingame for any player who had one before the update, making them a rare example of a discontinued item in Old School RuneScape .

Puzzle boxes can be obtained by doing hard, elite, and master Treasure Trails . Before you are able to continue with your clue scroll, you will have to complete the puzzle.

A puzzle box is always scrambled 101 times before being handed to the player, by randomly sliding a piece into the empty position starting from the solved state. [ 1 ]

If you have a duplicate puzzle box, (obtained by a method such as the Drop trick ) in your inventory or bank after completing the clue, you cannot obtain another clue.

12193:
The Ancient robe top is part of the ancient vestment set and can be obtained by completing easy Treasure Trails. To wear, the player requires a minimum of level 20 Prayer.

Curiously, the ancient robe top weights 0.005 kg, whereas all other vestment robe tops weigh 1.8 kg.

This item can be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room, provided that the interface of the corresponding clue tier is opened before attempting to store the item. Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface, as part of the ancient vestment set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

12197:
The Ancient cloak is the cape of the ancient vestment set , requiring 40 Prayer to equip. It can only be obtained from completing medium Treasure Trails . It is unique compared to other vestment cloaks being much lighter, weighing only 0.003 kg instead of 0.4 kg.

This item can be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room , provided that the interface of the corresponding clue tier is opened before attempting to store the item. Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface, as part of the ancient vestment set . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored. Despite being a reward from medium clues, the cloak is stored on the Easy Clue tab in the treasure chest.
12199:
The Ancient crozier is part of the ancient vestment set . To wield one, the player needs at least 60 Prayer .

The crozier is equipped as a staff in the weapons slot and counts as a Zarosian item within the God Wars Dungeon . Despite this fact, it cannot be used to autocast Ancient magicks .

This item can be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room , provided that the interface of the corresponding clue tier is opened before attempting to store the item. Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface, as part of the ancient vestment set . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

It should be noted that despite being obtained from a Reward casket (medium) , it is stored in the easy rewards section of the treasure chest.
12201:

Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface, as part of the ancient vestment set . The dragon cane is a reward from elite Treasure Trails that requires level 60 Attack to wield. This weapon has similar stats to the dragon mace (including the +5 Prayer bonus), although no quest completion is required to wield the dragon cane (while completion of Heroes' Quest is needed to wield the dragon mace). Unlike the mace however, the Dragon Cane has an attack speed of 5 ticks (3.0s).

Unlike other canes, which are spiked weapons, the dragon cane is a polestaff and therefore lacks a stab combat option.

As with most dragon equipment and all Treasure Trails rewards, the dragon cane cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.

They can be used as a quick way to get to the Astral Altar to change your spellbook to the Lunar spellbook .

They can be used as an alternative to reach Barrows for those without the magic level to cast the Barrows Teleport spell.
12407:
Pest control teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Void Knights' Outpost. They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

There are no requirements to use this teleport.

Although players can teleport directly to Pest Control every 20 minutes via Minigame Teleport, these direct teleport scrolls have a few beneficial uses.

Pest Control teleport scrolls provide the closest teleport to an anvil for those doing clues and arguably the most important aspect is they provide players with the closest bank teleport that is not diary locked. By having access to such a close bank, these scrolls are ideal for using when doing Corporeal Beast resupplying or skill related activities.

For Ultimate ironmen, an added major benefit is that it is one of the closest teleports to a rune shop and a general store that sells axes.

12543:
A casket could previously be received after completing any step of a Treasure Trail . These caskets did not always contain a reward, and sometimes only gave another clue scroll.

On 28 July 2016 Treasure Trails were updated. Caskets were replaced with new items called Reward caskets . They are only received once all steps have been completed, and are guaranteed to contain a reward.

Although caskets are no longer obtainable, they are still ingame for any player who had one before the update, making them a rare example of a discontinued item in Old School RuneScape .

Challenge scrolls are riddles given to players by an NPC during a Treasure Trail. Challenge scrolls appear in medium, hard, and elite clue steps. Players must solve the challenge scroll in order to advance in their Treasure Trail. The challenge scroll is not a separate step in the Treasure Trail.

The questions for the challenge scrolls are always the same. Players do not have to read the challenge scroll in order to answer the question. Players only need to talk to the NPC again after receiving the scroll to answer the answer. There are no penalties for incorrect answers.

12579:
Puzzle boxes can be obtained by doing hard, elite, and master Treasure Trails . Before you are able to continue with your clue scroll, you will have to complete the puzzle.

A puzzle box is always scrambled 101 times before being handed to the player, by randomly sliding a piece into the empty position starting from the solved state. [ 1 ]

If you have a duplicate puzzle box, (obtained by a method such as the Drop trick ) in your inventory or bank after completing the clue, you cannot obtain another clue.

12592:
A black pick head was obtained as part of a discontinued random event , in which the black pickaxe head flew off the handle while the player was mining. To fix it, the player had to collect it off the ground and reattach it to the handle.

If players were not paying attention when this occurred, the head would disappear from the ground or be picked up by another player, requiring them to purchase another.

The pick heads were all repaired in an update on 11 September 2014 , and the event was discontinued.
12594:
A broken black pickaxe was a black pickaxe that had been broken by an exploding rock . It could be fixed at Nurmof 's Pickaxe Shop in the Dwarven Mine .

If the broken pickaxe was equipped before being broken, it would remain in the weapon slot. Once unequipped, it could not be equipped again.

After an update on 11 September 2014 making random events optional, all existing broken pickaxes were automatically repaired.
12596:
The Rangers' tunic is a rare item received from elite Treasure Trails . It is part of the ranger kit , and requires 40 Ranged to wear. It has the offensive stats of a green d'hide body and similar defensive stats to a leather body .

The Rangers' tunic has the highest ranged attack bonus for armour that has no defence requirement, making it popular among 1 Defence pures .

This item can be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room , provided that the interface of the corresponding clue tier is opened before attempting to store the item. Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface, as part of the ranger kit set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
12598:
Holy sandals are a pair of footwear obtainable by completing medium Treasure Trails. They require 31 Prayer to wear. They have the third-best prayer bonus for the footwear slot, and can be upgraded into devout boots by using a drake's tooth on them. They also count as a Saradomin item for the God Wars Dungeon and the Bandit Camp.

Holy sandals can be combined with the mole slippers to create the holy moleys, a cosmetic variant of the holy sandals that retain the same stats.

This item can be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room, provided that the interface of the corresponding clue tier is opened before attempting to store the item. Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface.
12600:
The druidic wreath is a piece of headwear obtained after completing the midsummer ritual three times during any of the midsummer events after 2014 . As there was no midsummer event in 2018 , it was made available from Diango's Toy Store for 1 coin .

This item mimics the look of the third age druidic wreath from RuneScape 3 , and as such can be considered part of the 3rd age druidic robes set. Unlike the robes, however, the wreath offers no bonuses.

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room .
12601:
The ring of the gods is a ring dropped by Vet'ion and Calvar'ion .

It can be imbued , with the holy wrench in inventory, for 650,000 Nightmare Zone reward points or 325,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , 260 Soul Wars zeal tokens , or a scroll of imbuing , purchased for 200 Emir's Arena reward points, giving it an additional +4 prayer bonus as well as the effect of the holy wrench when equipped.
12603:
The tyrannical ring is a ring dropped by Callisto and Artio . Callisto can be found in Callisto's Den and Artio can be found in the Hunter's End .

It is very useful when using crush weapons as the tyrannical ring is one of only three rings that provide a crush attack bonus, the others being the brimstone ring and the ring of shadows . However, unlike the brimstone ring and the ring of shadows, the tyrannical ring does not provide any strength bonus.

It is often used with dragon warhammer for its special attack , as it only reduces the enemy's defence if the player hits, which is where the tyrannical ring's accuracy bonus helps.

It can be imbued into a Tyrannical ring (i) using 650,000 Nightmare Zone reward points or 325,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , 260 Soul Wars zeal tokens , or a scroll of imbuing , purchased for 200 Emir's Arena reward points, giving it a +8 crush attack and defence bonus, instead of the usual +4.
12605:
The treasonous ring is a ring dropped by Venenatis and Spindel.

It can be imbued into a treasonous ring (i) using 650,000 Nightmare Zone reward points or 325,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements, 260 Soul Wars zeal tokens, or a scroll of imbuing, purchased for 200 Emir's Arena reward points, doubling the stab attack and stab defence bonuses to +8.
12607:
The damaged book is a book held in the shield slot that can be obtained for 5,000 coins from Jossik after completing Horror from the Deep . The four Bandos pages can be added to upgrade it to the book of war , which gives a damage bonus. Both the damaged and upgraded book count as a god item for Bandos in the God Wars Dungeon .

After completing Horror from the Deep, you are rewarded with a damaged book of your choice: either Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak. You do not need to complete your current damaged book before obtaining a new one of a different type from Jossik. You can buy every damaged book in the same day. Dropping or destroying a damaged book and talking to Jossik results in him returning it to you.

You can check which pages are currently in your incomplete book with the "Check" option. Once you have filled the book, you cannot take the pages out.
12608:
The book of war is a book held in place of a shield, and is the god book aligned with Bandos. It can be purchased from Jossik for 5,000 coins at the Lighthouse. Books of war must be made using all four torn Bandos pages which can be purchased from other players or obtained from Treasure Trails. Equipping a book of war allows the player to preach and perform ceremonies, such as blessing, last rites, and wedding rites, by operating it (none of which have any effect on the game itself, and are simply recited lines of text), costing 25% of the player's special attack energy.

Lost books of war can be reclaimed by speaking to Jossik, complete with all pages that have been added, for no cost. Alternatively, for those who do not wish to travel to the Lighthouse, Perdu will return them to players for 14,000 coins.

The book of war can be used as a training weapon for the Nightmare Zone, as it offers a +5 prayer bonus and a +2 strength bonus. It is the only god book to give a strength bonus.

This book can be useful for melee training for low level players that don't have access to defenders or the obsidian shield yet.

As it is a Bandos-affiliated item, it can be used when collecting ecumenical keys in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.

Filling the book of war currently costs 3,429 coins coins when buying each page individually or 11,380 coins when buying the item set.

Lost books of law can be reclaimed by speaking to Jossik, complete with all pages that have been added, for no cost. Alternatively, for those who do not wish to travel to the Lighthouse, Perdu will return them to players for 14,000 coins.

The completed book has the fifth highest ranged bonus of all off-hand items, following just behind the aquanite hopper and odium ward, which are surpassed by the dragonfire ward and twisted buckler.

The book of law counts as an Armadyl item for the God Wars Dungeon.

Filling the book of law currently costs 6,670 coins when buying each page individually or 23,668 coins when buying the item set.

12612:
The book of darkness is a book held in place of a shield, and is the god book aligned with Zaros. It can be purchased from Jossik for 5,000 coins after completion of the Horror from the Deep quest. Previously, obtaining the book required completion of the Dig Site quest. Ancient books must be made using all four torn Ancient pages which can be purchased from other players, or be obtained from Treasure Trails.

Equipping a book of darkness allows the player to preach and perform ceremonies, such as blessing, last rites, and wedding rites, by operating it (none of which have any effect on the game itself, and are simply recited lines of text), costing 25% of the player's special attack energy.

Lost books of darkness can be reclaimed by speaking to Jossik, complete with all pages that have been added, for no cost. Alternatively, for those who do not wish to travel to the lighthouse, Perdu will return them to players for 14,000 coins.

It is worth noting that the book's pages sound as if they were written recently since the book talks about followers of Zaros being oppressed. However, when Zaros was in power, he had great influence and many followers.

Filling the book of darkness currently costs 7,247 coins when buying each page individually or 16,349 coins when buying the item set.

A stamina potion restores 20% of the player's run energy per dose, and offers a 70% reduction in run energy depletion for 2 minutes. This effect does not stack, and drinking additional doses before the timer has run out will simply reset it back to 2 minutes. When the stamina effect is active, the boost in the run energy orb changes from its usual yellow to orange.

A stamina potion can be made at level 77 Herblore by mixing a super energy potion with amylase crystals . Each dose grants 25.5 Herblore experience , and requires one amylase crystal.

At 85 Herblore, they can be used to make extended stamina potions using marlin scales .

After Barbarian Herblore Training is completed, caviar can be added to a stamina potion(2) to produce a stamina mix . This requires 86 Herblore and provides 60 Herblore experience. A stamina mix has 2 doses, each healing 6 Hitpoints in addition to the usual stamina potion behaviour.

This effect does not stack, and drinking additional doses before the timer has run out will simply reset it back to 2 minutes. When the stamina effect is active, the boost in the run energy orb changes from its usual yellow to orange.

A stamina potion can be made at level 77 Herblore by mixing a super energy potion with amylase crystals . Each dose grants 25.5 Herblore experience , and requires one amylase crystal.

At 85 Herblore, they can be used to make extended stamina potions using marlin scales .

After Barbarian Herblore Training is completed, caviar can be added to a stamina potion(2) to produce a stamina mix . This requires 86 Herblore and provides 60 Herblore experience. A stamina mix has 2 doses, each healing 6 Hitpoints in addition to the usual stamina potion behaviour.

12633:
Stamina mix is a barbarian potion that restores 20% of a player's run energy , reduces the rate at which it depletes by 70% for 2 minutes, and heals 6 Hitpoints . It is made by adding caviar to a stamina potion(2) , requiring level 86 Herblore and giving 60 experience . This mix can only be created after completing the Herblore part of Barbarian training with Otto Godblessed .

Mixing a stamina mix on the top of Seers' Village bank is a requirement to complete the Elite Kandarin Diary .

Drinking a sip of the potion gives the message "You drink the lumpy potion" . If the player drinks all doses or empties the potion, it will become a regular empty vial .

12637:
The Saradomin halo is an item worn in the head slot that can be bought from (or sold to) Lanthus for 75 Castle Wars tickets .

The Saradomin halo acts as a Saradomin item and thus prevents Saradomin followers from attacking its wearer in the God Wars Dungeon . It also allows players to be constantly attacked by Bandits at the Bandit Camp in the Kharidian Desert , as it is a god item .

The defensive bonuses of the halo are similar to those of a black full helm , excluding negative attack bonuses. In addition, the halo gives prayer bonus and magic defence while the full helm does not.

If the player dies a PvP death and the item is unprotected, it will remain in the player's inventory; however, the item will be in a broken, unusable state and must be repaired by using it on Perdu and paying him 25,000 coins .

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room .

12640:
Amylase crystals are a potion secondary ingredient used in the creation of stamina potions . A player can mix amylase crystals with a super energy potion at 77 Herblore to make a stamina potion. One amylase crystal creates a single dose of stamina potion from a super energy(1), and as such, four amylase crystals are required to create a stamina potion(4) from a super energy(4). One crystal is required per dose, granting 25.5 Herblore experience each. Amylase crystals can be bought from Grace found in the Rogues' Den , Worm Tongue at the Colossal Wyrm Remains , and Pirate Jackie the Fruit found in the Agility Arena Store in the form of an amylase pack . One amylase pack contains 100 amylase crystals, costs 10 marks of grace , 60 Brimhaven vouchers , or 100 Termites , and can create 25 stamina potion(4).

An Amulet of chemistry or Alchemist's amulet can be used (provided the super energy potion is less than 4 doses; see Amulet of chemistry#Mechanics ).
12641:
Amylase pack is an item pack containing 100 amylase crystals used in making stamina potions . One amylase crystal is needed to create one dose of stamina potion, meaning one amylase pack is good for 25 stamina potion(4) .

These packs can be bought from Grace's Graceful Clothing for 10 marks of grace , from the Agility Arena Store for 60 Brimhaven vouchers , or from Worm Tongue's Wares for 100 Termites .

Amylase packs can only be sold back to Grace's Graceful Clothing for 8 marks of grace , even if it was bought from the Agility Arena Store or Worm Tongue's Wares .

Therefore, if using amylase packs to convert between currencies, one would have to exchange 12.5 or 7.5 to receive 1 .

The total Grand Exchange value of the crystals contained in a single pack is 56,800 .
12642:
Lumberyard teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Lumber Yard . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

There are no requirements to use this teleport.

They can be used for faster access to the Sawmill to make planks quicker.
12643:
The Pet Dagannoth Supreme is a pet dropped by the Dagannoth Supreme. It is a much smaller version of Dagannoth Supreme.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat), it will be placed into their inventory. When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne.

On death, if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.

The Junk appeared in the Jagex Clan Cup 2014 Skilling Arena , in which players were required to gain as much experience from skilling as possible. Any skilling activity would give these items instead, as a substitute for resource items. If the activity normally gave stackable items, they would instead be substituted with the stackable version of the junk item.

Players could interact with the bank Deposit Boxes inside the Skilling Arena to dispose of all the junk items in their inventory. These deposit boxes deleted the items, rather than sending them to the bank.

Iban's staff (u) (referred to in-game as an Upgraded Iban's staff ) is an upgraded Iban's staff that holds 2,500 charges instead of 120. It is obtained by bringing an Iban's staff and 200,000 coins to the Dark Mage , in the tower east of the entrance to the Underground Pass in West Ardougne . Upgrading the staff will also fully charge it. It requires 50 Magic and 50 Attack to wield. Casting Iban Blast on a monster consumes one charge from the staff and casting it on another player consumes two charges. Casting other spells , like Fire Blast , does not consume any charges.

If Iban's staff is lost prior to completing the Underground Pass quest, Disciples of Iban must be killed for a broken Iban's staff. After the quest is completed, Koftik will give a broken staff to the player at the entrance to the Underground Pass . The broken Iban's staff must be brought to the Dark Mage with 200,000 coins to repair it, then to reobtain the upgraded staff, the player must pay another 200,000 coins to the Dark Mage to upgrade the new staff. The broken staff can be repaired and upgraded directly for 400,000 coins .

The maximum hit with Iban Blast is 25, making it excellent for low-level player killing .

Upgrading Iban's staff or wielding an upgraded Iban's staff is a Medium Ardougne Diary task.
12659: Clan wars capes are unobtainable items that are equipped in the jaw slot during a game of Clan Wars in order to achieve the team cape's effect without needing to wear one. The capes have 16 variants to account for possible facial hair, where fake beards are built into the item to make it appear as if they had not been removed. There are two separate versions for each team, although all the purple team's capes except the default have the same icon as the yellow team.

The Tyrannical ring (i) is an upgraded version of the regular Tyrannical ring . It can be imbued as a reward from the Nightmare Zone , costing 650,000 reward points or 325,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , at Soul Wars for 260 Zeal Tokens , or by using a scroll of imbuing purchased from the Emir's Arena . Its stats are double those of the tyrannical ring.

If not protected, dying to another player will cause the imbued ring to lose its imbued status, but the player will be reimbursed the Nightmare Zone points , Zeal Tokens , or Scroll of imbuing to re-imbue it via the aforementioned methods. Dying to a monster will not remove its imbued effect.

The goblin paint cannon is a two-handed weapon that can be bought from Diango's Toy Store in Draynor Village for 225 coins. It was first introduced during the 2014 Goblin Invasion event, when it could be obtained by speaking to either the Goblin Recruiter or the Guard Recruiter, depending on whose side you joined. Opposing goblins or guards could be covered in paint using the cannon, which would make them attackable.

It is one of the only four melee weapons with an attack speed of 3, with the other ones being the swift blade, ham joint, and mystic cards, with the latter also being a two handed weapon. The swift blade also exclusively uses Stab and Slash attack styles whereas the others use Crush, and the mystic cards have negative combat stat bonuses whereas the others have no bonuses. Because of this, it is commonly used with lower level PvP builds especially among players with 1 Attack where its attack speed out-performs other weapons of a similar tier like the iron scimitar.

While having a goblin paint cannon equipped, other players will have a right-click "Paint" option listed in their choose option menu. Doing this will result in your character performing the spin emote before shooting out what looks like a huge ball of paint. The player will miss their shot in the majority of cases, causing the glob of paint to fly off in a random direction. However, there is a 1 in 15 chance the projectile will connect with the target when you right-click paint someone, which is confirmed by a message saying By some miracle you hit the target! appearing in the chatbox.

Using this ability will not deal damage in any way, regardless whether the target is a player or a NPC, or if the player is currently in PvP or the Wilderness.

A mysterious emblem was an item that could be traded in to the Emblem Trader for bounties, which can be used to purchase items from the Bounty Hunter Store. It can be obtained in several ways:

Killing the player's assigned target on the official Bounty Hunter world, while having a mysterious emblem in the inventory. The opponent's combat level determines the drop rate.

Killing Wilderness bosses on the official Bounty Hunter world.

Killing various monsters assigned by Krystilia. Bosses and monsters assigned by her can drop the emblems outside of Bounty Hunter worlds.

Mysterious emblems cannot be dropped. Unlike most items, mysterious emblems have a seven second timer before being destroyed, in order to prevent players from destroying them mid-combat to deny their killer the emblem as loot.

They can be sold to the Bandit Duty Free general store starting at 30,000 coins each. This is beneficial because it can give a much better return compared to selling it to the Emblem Trader for high alchemy items.

In 2019 with the rework of Bounty Hunter, the Mysterious emblems were discontinued. All existing emblems were converted into a new item called Archaic emblem, while a new Mysterious emblem was created.

A tier 10 emblem was one of the materials required to construct a mounted emblem in the Achievement Gallery, requiring 80 Construction. This was replaced by the Decorative emblem.
12747:
The Archaic emblems are former discontinued items that could be obtained as a reward from Bounty Hunter. Originally, the Tier 1 and 10 Mysterious emblems received were tradeable and could be turned into banknotes. In 2019, Bounty Hunter was reworked; the Mysterious emblems were converted into Archaic emblems and made untradeable. Any player who had one in banknote form was given this unique discontinued variant; it was identical to the real Archaic emblems, except stackable.

In 2021, all Archaic emblems were removed from the game with the closure of the Bounty Hunter Reward Shop. While the normal versions can still be obtained during Deadman Mode, the stackable variants are now gone entirely.

The dark bow is a two-handed ranged weapon that requires level 60 in Ranged to wield. It can only be obtained as a drop from dark beasts and their superior variant, night beasts. With an attack speed of 9 (5.4 seconds), and 8 on rapid (4.8 seconds), this bow stands out as the slowest weapon in the game. It fires two arrows per attack which roll independent accuracy checks. It has the maximum possible attack range of 10, so the longrange attack style will not increase its attack range.

Assuming that the weapon is set to the rapid attack style, the dark bow has a firing time of 2.4 seconds per arrow, whereas a shortbow such as the magic shortbow (i) takes only 1.8. Because of this, the dark bow is only fairly popular for player killing. It has one of the highest max hits of any weapons in the game by means of special attack, along with the crystal halberd and dragon dagger, although the twisted bow and Dharok's greataxe can hit harder with regular attacks, and the dragon 2h sword and Dinh's bulwark are able to deal more total damage with their special attack.

By using a Dark bow imbue scroll, the player can empower the dark bow into a Dark bow (bh), improving the item's stats and special attack. However, you can only use the Dark bow (bh) specifically in Daimon's Crater.

Each arrow fired has an independent chance to be saved by an Ava's device, and the bow may also be fired with only one arrow equipped.

The dark bow is a two-handed ranged weapon that requires level 60 in Ranged to wield. It can only be obtained as a drop from dark beasts and their superior variant, night beasts. With an attack speed of 9 (5.4 seconds), and 8 on rapid (4.8 seconds), this bow stands out as the slowest weapon in the game. It fires two arrows per attack which roll independent accuracy checks. It has the maximum possible attack range of 10, so the longrange attack style will not increase its attack range.

Assuming that the weapon is set to the rapid attack style, the dark bow has a firing time of 2.4 seconds per arrow, whereas a shortbow such as the magic shortbow (i) takes only 1.8. Because of this, the dark bow is only fairly popular for player killing. It has one of the highest max hits of any weapons in the game by means of special attack, along with the crystal halberd and dragon dagger, although the twisted bow and Dharok's greataxe can hit harder with regular attacks, and the dragon 2h sword and Dinh's bulwark are able to deal more total damage with their special attack.

By using a Dark bow imbue scroll, the player can empower the dark bow into a Dark bow (bh), improving the item's stats and special attack. However, you can only use the Dark bow (bh) specifically in Daimon's Crater.

Each arrow fired has an independent chance to be saved by an Ava's device, and the bow may also be fired with only one arrow equipped.

12769:
Frozen whip mix is an item which can be used on the abyssal whip to create the frozen abyssal whip , which makes the whip appear like ice, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

It can be purchased at Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 25 Last Man Standing points.
12771:
Volcanic whip mix is an item which can be used on the abyssal whip to create the volcanic abyssal whip, which makes the whip appear like lava, and is a purely cosmetic addition (although the volcanic abyssal whip does count as a piece of Warm Clothing when subduing the Wintertodt).

It can be purchased at Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 25 Last Man Standing points.
12773:
The volcanic abyssal whip is an abyssal whip with a volcanic whip mix added onto it. The whip mix gives no additional bonuses, and is only used to add aesthetics to the whip. It costs 1,911,785 for both the parts to make the volcanic abyssal whip. The whip counts as a piece of Warm Clothing when subduing the Wintertodt.

While the whip is untradeable in its volcanic state, it can be reverted to the tradeable abyssal whip by using a cleaning cloth on it. However, the volcanic whip mix will not be returned.

Note: Despite being untradeable, if the volcanic abyssal whip is not one of your protected items upon dying to another player in the Wilderness, it will be lost upon death.

This item is kept on death on PvM death outside of the Wilderness, even if it is not one of the 3 most valuable items in your inventory.

Even below level 20 Wilderness, the whip will lose its paint and drop to the ground for the person who killed you.
12774:
The frozen abyssal whip is an abyssal whip with a frozen whip mix added onto it. The whip mix gives no additional bonuses, and is only used to add aesthetics to the whip. It costs 1,909,315 for both the parts to make the frozen abyssal whip.

While the whip is untradeable in its frozen state, it can be reverted to the tradeable abyssal whip by using a cleaning cloth on it. However, the frozen whip mix will not be returned.

Note: Despite being untradeable, if the frozen abyssal whip is not one of your protected items upon dying to another player in the Wilderness , it will be lost upon death.

Even below level 20 Wilderness, the whip will lose its paint and drop to the ground for the person who killed you.
12775:
The Annakarl teleport is a magic tablet that can be broken by players to teleport to Annakarl (the Demonic Ruins) in level 46 Wilderness, providing that they have completed Desert Treasure I.

Because this tablet teleports players to the Wilderness, a warning will appear upon clicking the "Break" option on the tablet. This can be toggled by right-clicking the "Configure" option.

Players can create this item on the ancient lectern by the altar inside the Ancient Pyramid with a piece of soft clay, 2 law runes, and 2 blood runes, as well as level 90 Magic while being on the Ancient Magicks spellbook.

The player does not need to have the relevant Magic level to use the tablet, which shares the same rule with all tablets and the player will not receive any experience, although making the teleport tablet does give 100 experience in Magic.
12776:
The Carrallanger teleport is a magic tablet that can be broken by players to teleport to the Graveyard of Shadows in level 19 Wilderness, providing that they have completed Desert Treasure I.

Because this tablet teleports players to the Wilderness, a warning will appear upon clicking the "Break" option on the tablet. This can be toggled by right-clicking the "Configure" option.

Players can create this item on the ancient lectern by the altar inside the Ancient Pyramid with a piece of soft clay, 2 law runes, and 2 soul runes, as well as level 84 Magic while being on the Ancient Magicks spellbook.

12783:
The ring of wealth scroll is an item that can be used on a ring of wealth (alongside 50,000 coins ) to create a ring of wealth (i) , which doubles a player's chance of getting a clue scroll from monsters and skilling activities in the Wilderness .

It can be purchased from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 5 Last Man Standing points, or obtained as a drop from various monsters in the Wilderness Slayer Cave .
12785:
The ring of wealth (i) is an imbued ring of wealth created with a ring of wealth scroll and 50,000 coins . The imbued ring has all the functions of a ring of wealth with an additional effect of doubling the player's chance of getting a clue scroll from monsters and skilling activities in the Wilderness (excluding beginner clue scrolls ). This effect applies regardless of where the player is whenever they kill a monster in the Wilderness. [ 1 ]

If you die with the ring, regardless if it is an item kept on death , the imbue will be removed from the ring and converted to 50,000 coins . In a PvP death, the coins appear in the inventory of the player who killed you; in a PvM death, the coins will instead go to your grave . It should also be noted that attempting to drop the ring whilst in PvP combat will result in the message "You must wait a few seconds before dropping this item."

Like other dragonstone jewellery, it can be charged to provide teleports, albeit only at the Fountain of Rune .
12786:
The magic shortbow scroll is an item that can be used on a magic shortbow to create a magic shortbow (i), which will make its special attack consume 50% of the player's special attack energy down from 55% and increase its ranged attack bonus to +75 from +69.

The scroll can be purchased from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 5 Last Man Standing points, or obtained as a rare drop from monsters in the Wilderness Slayer Cave.

After being imbued by the magic shortbow scroll, the bow cannot be reverted, and there's no way to reclaim the scroll. On death, players who lose the magic shortbow (i) will drop a regular magic shortbow for the person who killed them.
12788:
The magic shortbow (i) is a bow that requires level 50 Ranged in order to use, and is obtained by using a magic shortbow scroll on a regular magic shortbow. The imbued bow has +75 Ranged attack, instead of the regular bow's +69, and uses 50% of the special bar when performing the special attack, instead of the regular bow's 55%.

Typically, a magic shortbow with amethyst arrows or rune arrows deals significantly higher damage-per-second than a rune crossbow with broad bolts, while a magic shortbow with adamant or broad arrows deals noticeably less damage-per-second.

After being imbued by the magic shortbow scroll, the bow cannot be reverted, and there's no way to reclaim the scroll. On death, players who lose the magic shortbow (i) will drop a regular magic shortbow for the person who killed them.
12789:
A clue box , when held in the inventory, allows a player to keep a single clue scroll , scroll box , or reward casket in their inventory after dying in the Wilderness , at which point the clue box is deleted. The clue/casket protected is in addition to whichever protected items would normally stay in the inventory. Clue boxes do not protect clues for Ultimate Ironman players.

Following the Trouver System Rework , untradeable items like clues and caskets go to the grave where they can be reclaimed for free, so the clue box is all but obsolete, saving only a trip to the grave or to Death's Office .

Clue boxes can be purchased from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 5 Last Man Standing points, though considering the other items on offer at that price, it is seldom advisable to do so.

Only the bottom-rightmost scroll/casket in one's inventory is protected; carrying multiple clue boxes does not produce additional effects. The Items Kept on Death interface does not distinguish the scroll/casket a clue box would protect, though it does indicate that the box would always be lost.

It is recommended to avoid opening a reward casket in the Wilderness while holding a clue box, as the clue box will still be lost on death along with any non-protected items gained from opening the casket.
12791:
The rune pouch is an item that can store 16,000 of three types of runes (except runes found in the Nightmare Zone). Players can cast spells using the runes stored in the pouch, so a rune pouch saves inventory space. With a thread of Elidinis and level 75 crafting, the rune pouch can be upgraded (with a needle) to a divine rune pouch. Players cannot own more than one rune pouch.

If players die a PvP death while carrying a rune pouch in any level Wilderness or in a PvP world, they will lose the rune pouch, unless it has been locked via use of a trouver parchment. It should be noted that the Trouver parchment does not protect runes stored within a Rune pouch upon PvP death.

If players die a PvM death anywhere, including any level Wilderness, the rune pouch is always sent to a gravestone or item retrieval service, unless it has been locked via use of a trouver parchment. Locked rune pouches are kept in the inventory upon PvM death, instead.
12792:
The nest box is an item that holds bird nests. It can be obtained from trading in noted mole claws or mole skins to Wyson the gardener who can be found in Falador Park.

There are three different types of nest boxes.

Nest box (seeds) - Contains birds nests with seeds in them.

Nest box (ring) - Contains bird nests with rings in them.

Nest box (empty) - Contains bird nests with nothing in them.

Each box will contain various amounts of nests depending on what each nest contains.

If you have nest boxes on you, trading more mole parts into Wyson will not result in the bird nests being added to the existing boxes. Rather, you will get a separate additional set of boxes.
12793:
The Nest box (seeds) is an item formerly obtained from Wyson the gardener in Falador Park. It could be obtained from trading in noted mole claws or mole skins. When opened, it would provide a Wyson bird nest.

In an update on 18 February 2016, Wyson's nests were updated to provide better seeds. Therefore, he now gave out new nest boxes which contained different bird nests. However, the original nest boxes remain in the game, making them a rare example of a discontinued item in Old School RuneScape.
