13256:
Saradomin's light is an item obtained by killing Commander Zilyana in the God Wars Dungeon. It can be used to permanently remove the darkness in Zamorak's Fortress in the God Wars Dungeon, which in turn allows the player to see better and more clearly. However, doing so will not prevent the prayer drain from occurring when players enter Zamorak's Fortress.

Attempting to consume it will cause a message in the chatbox that states As you commune with the holy star, you feel the light of Saradomin preparing to fill your mind and enlighten your vision. If you submit, it will help you see through the darkness of Zamorak's evil.

If players proceed with letting the light in, a message appears in the chatbox, stating You submit to the light of Saradomin. Zamorak's darkness will henceforth have no effect on you. Attempting to consume another light will result in a message that the player has already consumed the light.

It can also be attached to a staff of the dead to create a staff of light. This process is irreversible.
13258:
The angler hat is obtained from aerial fishing by purchasing it from Alry the Angler for a price of 50 Molch pearls or acquired randomly from completing a game of Fishing Trawler . The hat grants 0.4% bonus Fishing experience . A Fishing level of 34 is required to wear it. The angler hat is 1 of 4 pieces of the angler's outfit .

When a player receives it from the Fishing Trawler minigame, a message in the chat box states The luck of the sea is in today. You spot a piece of fishing gear caught up in the netting!

The angler hat can be changed into the spirit angler headband by giving it and 1,200 spirit flakes to Gita Prymes . The only difference between the angler's outfit and spirit angler's outfit is that wearing the full spirit angler's outfit acts as a rope for tethering to totem poles and masts while battling Tempoross .

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Angler's outfit set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored. It can also be stored in a tackle box .

13262:
The Abyssal orphan is a boss pet that resembles the scions that are encountered during the Abyssal Sire boss fight.

Players have a 5/128 (1/25.6) chance of obtaining the abyssal orphan when they place an unsired on the Font of Consumption behind The Overseer . As an unsired is a 1/100 drop, this effectively makes the chance of an abyssal orphan 1/2,560. When the unsired is placed into the font, if the pet chance is rolled, a message will appear in the chatbox stating The Font appears to have revitalised the Unsired! .

On death, if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around for 30 seconds before disappearing completely. It can then be reclaimed from Probita in East Ardougne .
13263:
The abyssal bludgeon is a two-handed crush weapon created by having The Overseer combine three untradeable components — the bludgeon axon , bludgeon claw , and bludgeon spine . If the player already had the Overseer create one, they can use the three components on the book it left behind. Level 70 Attack and Strength are required to equip this weapon.

The components can be obtained from placing an unsired , dropped by the Abyssal Sire , in the Font of Consumption . The mean number of Sire kills to complete a bludgeon is 619.4, and the median number of kills is 552.

The bludgeon has a unique characteristic in that all of its attack styles are aggressive , meaning it is only able to be used for Strength training. In addition, all of its attack styles use crush .
13265:
The abyssal dagger is the most powerful dagger in the game and requires 70 Attack to wield. Players have a 13/64 (~20.3%) chance of receiving an abyssal dagger when using an unsired on the Font of Consumption at the centre of the Abyssal Nexus , giving it effectively a chance of 1/492 (~0.20%) per Abyssal Sire kill. Players also have a 1/32,000 (~0.003%) chance of receiving an abyssal dagger as a drop from abyssal demons .

The abyssal dagger has the same strength bonus as the Zamorakian hasta , but is generally considered the inferior stab weapon due to its 10 less stab accuracy, no Prayer bonus and no defensive stats. However, the hasta's combat styles are limited to defensive and controlled (shared). While set to aggressive, the dagger can achieve one additional max hit. As with most daggers , it can be poisoned .

It surpasses the staff of the dead in both Strength and accuracy, with +5 Attack bonus, and +3 Strength bonus over the staff. Players should note that the abyssal dagger is primarily a stab weapon , while the staff of the dead is primarily a slash weapon .

It can be upgraded to the abyssal dagger (bh) with the use of an abyssal dagger imbue scroll , which increases its stab attack bonus by 10 and lowers the damage reduction of its special attack from 15% to 5%. However, the upgraded version can only be used for Pking in the Bounty Hunter minigame .

13274:

The max cape is a cape available to players who have attained level 99 in all 24 skills . It is sold by Mac on his island , west of the Warriors' Guild , for 2,376,000 coins, equivalent to 99,000 for each skill. When purchased, it comes along with a corresponding hood .

The cape's stats are equivalent to a trimmed skillcape . It inherits all skillcape perks from skillcapes. The cape's emote shows the icons for all 24 skills flying above the character's head, and a bar-graph stylised like the skills interface icon, with the player floating over it.

To reach Mac, the player needs a pickaxe and an axe, as well as level 99 in Agility , Crafting , Construction , Defence , Mining , and Woodcutting . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] After purchasing, players can sell excess max capes for 1,900,800 coins. This can only be done if the player has both the hood and cape in their inventory. Other max cape variants can be refunded in the same manner.

This item can be stored in the cape rack of a costume room , as part of the max cape set, along with the hood . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

The total level a player needs for the max cape is 2,376. The minimum amount of experience required for the cape is 312,826,344. As of 1 August 2026, there are 52,396 players that have achieved level 99 in all skills.
13281:
The max hood is obtained from Mac when a player purchases a Max cape . It is available to players who have attained at least 99 in all 24 skills . Players may buy a set of the hood and the cape from Mac for 2,376,000 coins, which is 99,000 coins times 24, the number of skills. The hood itself provides absolutely no offensive or defensive bonuses and may be worn for purely aesthetic purposes.

While the hood is bought with the skillcape, it is not needed to perform the emote associated with it; the skillcape is the only essential item. Conversely, the max hood must be in the player's inventory when they are combining a max cape with other cape slot items, such as the fire cape .

Should players lose the hood, they may reclaim it from Mac for free.

This item can be stored in the cape rack of a costume room , as part of the Max cape set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

The bank key is a Deadman Mode item that allows 10 of the victim's most valuable items, based on Grand Exchange value, to be taken. It can be obtained by killing a player. The player that obtained the key can collect the items by opening a chest in a bank within a low-threat area, which means they must wait until their skull expires or risk being killed by the guards. These bank keys cannot be deposited into a bank, and only five bank keys can be in a player's possession at any given time.

Players who attempt to destroy a bank key must wait for a 10 second countdown displayed in the chatbox, similar when attempting to teleport or log out. Players may cast High Level Alchemy or Low Level Alchemy on it to receive 0gp.

If a player kills a player who is in possession of another bank key, they will drop their own bank key in addition to their victim's bank keys. If a skulled player dies to a guard, 10 of their most valuable items from the bank are dropped wherever they die. Additionally, the player will lose 10% of all of their protected stats.

Players can insure up to ten items (ten single items, not 10 stacks of items) by speaking to the Financial Wizard and depositing the items in the safe deposit box. Items in the safe deposit box will not be lost, unlike those found in the bank, and can be collected any time the player visits the Financial Wizard.

The heron is a members-only skilling pet that can be obtained while training Fishing. The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Fishing level, and the time it takes to gather a resource.

A heron can be turned into a great blue heron by feeding it 3,000 spirit flakes. The recolouring can be reversed by feeding the great blue heron any raw fish, while one spirit flake can be used to turn it back to blue.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat), it will be placed into their inventory. When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack. This message also occurs if there is one last inventory space while the player already has a pet following them, in which case the pet will appear in the inventory instead and the resource dropped to the ground.

On death, if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around for 30 seconds before disappearing completely. It can then be reclaimed from Probita in East Ardougne.

The rotten onion is a special spawner tool distributed by Jagex Moderators to certain players of the Old School RuneScape community. During the MacMillan Cancer Support Charity Event of 2015, it was used to spawn green banners for players watching the livestreamed event.

There are two unique options for the onion:
13328:
The green banner is an item that was made available during the MacMillan Cancer Support Charity Event that was hosted during the 14th and 15th of November 2015 via usage of the rotten onion , which was distributed by Jagex Moderators to certain players of the Old School RuneScape community. It was made available from Diango's Toy Store the week after.

This item cannot leave a placeholder in the bank.
13329:
The fire max cape is the result of combining a fire cape with a max cape , during which the max hood required to be in the player's inventory will automatically convert to the fire max hood .

Like the other max cape variants (a max cape combined with another cape slot item), the fire max cape does not have the max cape's stats or perks with the following exceptions when worn:

The max cape and fire cape can be separated by using a knife on the cape. Mac will also buy back a max cape, along with its variants, for 1,900,800 coins each. He will return the secondary item any max cape variant was combined with upon doing so.

If the player dies a PvP death and the item is unprotected, it will remain in the player's inventory; however, the item will be in a broken, unusable state and must be repaired by using it on Perdu and paying him 150,000 coins .

A fire max cape cannot be gambled for a chance at TzRek-Jad .
13330:
The fire max hood is a hood created by using a fire cape on a max cape . When the fire max cape is created, the max hood that is required to be in the player's inventory during the cape's creation is automatically converted to the fire max hood.

If players are refunding the fire max cape via Mac , the player must also have the fire max hood in their inventory.

Should players lose the hood, they may reclaim it from Mac for free.
13331:
The Saradomin max cape is the result of combining a Saradomin cape with a max cape , during which the max hood required to be in the player's inventory will automatically convert to the Saradomin max hood .

Like the other max cape variants (a max cape combined with another cape slot item), the Saradomin max cape does not have the max cape's stats or perks; it only acts as a cosmetic upgrade to the Saradomin cape with the following exceptions when worn:

The max cape and saradomin cape can be separated by using a knife on the cape. Mac will also buy back a max cape, along with its variants, for 1,900,800 coins each. He will return the secondary item any max cape variant was combined with upon doing so.

Sacred eels are members -only fish that can be caught at Zul-Andra with a fishing rod and fishing bait , requiring at least level 87 Fishing and granting 105 Fishing experience per eel caught. The village may only be accessed once players reach the Tyras Camp during Regicide . Players must also first speak to High Priestess Zul-Harcinqa , or they will be stopped by the closest worshiper and instructed to do so upon trying to fish.

With a minimum Cooking level of 72, the fish can be dissected with a knife to extract Zulrah's scales . Dissecting the fish gives 3–9 scales and 109–127 Cooking experience (100 base XP plus 3 for each scale obtained). A player's Cooking level affects how many scales are received when they are dissected. The minimum, maximum, and average scales per level can be obtained from the table below. Furthermore, the sacred eels provide a relatively high chance (around 1/500, depending on your Fishing level) of obtaining Clue bottles .

With 90 Fishing and Cooking , you can expect to gain about 21,300 Fishing experience, 23,800 Cooking experience, and about 1,200 Zulrah's scales per hour. With 97 Fishing and 99 Cooking, you can expect to gain about 23,500 Fishing experience, 26,400 Cooking experience, and about 1,500 scales per hour (about 200–225 eels). The Rada's blessing 's chance to double caught fish works on sacred eels, increasing the number of eels caught per hour if used.

Players have a base chance of 1/99,000 to obtain the Heron pet while fishing Sacred Eels. On death, each sacred eel's worth counts as 16 coins .

The maximum number of scales acquired from every dissected sacred eel increases in 8-level intervals, capping at a boosted level of 104 (9 scales). [ 1 ]
13340:
The Agility cape is a Cape of Accomplishment that may only be acquired and worn by players who have achieved the maximum level in the Agility skill , 99. Once players have trained to this level, they may purchase the cape from Cap'n Izzy No-Beard , located at the entrance of the Brimhaven Agility Arena , for a fee of 99,000 coins . When this fee is paid, the player receives both the cape and a matching hood .

Like all skill capes , the Agility cape gives +9 to all defensive stats , and also a +4 bonus to prayer if it is trimmed, which requires a separate skill at level 99. The cape is automatically trimmed if this condition is met. However, if the cape is equipped at the time of achieving level 99 in a separate skill, the cape will remain untrimmed as the game will consider it a graceful cape .

When the Agility cape is equipped, it will act as a substitute to the graceful cape , granting the same -4 kg in weight reduction and 3% increased natural run energy restoration; as a substitute, it will also grant the graceful outfit 's set effect when worn with the other five graceful pieces. This allows the cape to be used for the master clue step, "Complete a lap of the Rellekka Rooftop Course while wearing the full graceful outfit." Once per day, it is also able to restore the player's run energy to 100%, and provide the effect of a stamina potion for one minute.

The Agility cape is the only piece of the graceful set that can be purchased with coins.

This item can be stored in the cape rack of a costume room , as part of the Agility cape set, along with the hood . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

The max cape is a cape available to players who have attained level 99 in all 24 skills . It is sold by Mac on his island , west of the Warriors' Guild , for 2,376,000 coins, equivalent to 99,000 for each skill. When purchased, it comes along with a corresponding hood .

The cape's stats are equivalent to a trimmed skillcape . It inherits all skillcape perks from skillcapes. The cape's emote shows the icons for all 24 skills flying above the character's head, and a bar-graph stylised like the skills interface icon, with the player floating over it.

To reach Mac, the player needs a pickaxe and an axe, as well as level 99 in Agility , Crafting , Construction , Defence , Mining , and Woodcutting . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] After purchasing, players can sell excess max capes for 1,900,800 coins. This can only be done if the player has both the hood and cape in their inventory. Other max cape variants can be refunded in the same manner.

This item can be stored in the cape rack of a costume room , as part of the max cape set, along with the hood . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

The total level a player needs for the max cape is 2,376. The minimum amount of experience required for the cape is 312,826,344. As of 1 August 2026, there are 52,396 players that have achieved level 99 in all skills.

13353:
Gricoller's can is a reward from the Tithe Farm minigame, which is found in the south-east corner of Hosidius. Players may exchange points at Farmer Gricoller's Rewards for the can.

Gricoller's can costs 200 points and acts like a watering can, the difference being that it holds 1,000 charges instead of 8. It can be fully refilled by using it on any water source (including the Humidify spell). It can also be refilled at Farmer Gricoller's rewards shop, free of charge.

Players will find the Tithe Farm to be more convenient when using Gricoller's can as it can hold enough water to grow 333 Tithe Farm fruits by itself. Unlike regular watering cans, it can also skip its own animation when used on another plant, removing the need to alternate cans for fast watering.

The tool leprechaun is able to store Gricoller's can in the watering can slot.

A player can purchase more than 1 of these if they use the drop trick, but will find they cannot pick up the original can back up off the ground. If a player, however, stores 1 Gricoller's can at the tool leprechaun, they are able to purchase a 2nd one. Every Gricoller's can operates the same "water tank", much like how binding necklaces, bracelets of clay and other shared-stat items work. This can be useful, as you can store a can with the Leprechaun and fill the second at a bank near a water source. Having a second Gricoller's can in your bank can replace normal watering cans to be used for activities such as watering tree pots in preparation for tree runs without needing to find a tool leprechaun.
13354:
A lovakite bar is a bar of refined lovakite ore made by smelting one lovakite ore and two pieces of coal at the Lovakite furnace in the centre of Lovakengj, granting 20 Smithing experience.

It can be smelted with a Smithing level of 45.

It cannot be smelted in a normal furnace. If players try, it'll say it's not the right temperature. Players must use the Lovakite furnace just south of the blast mine bank (accessible instantly by using Xeric's talisman to teleport to Xeric's Inferno). However, the Superheat Item spell will work as normal.
13355:
Juniper logs are obtained from chopping mature juniper trees , located within Hosidius near the saltpetre deposits. Juniper trees require 42 Woodcutting to chop and give 35 Woodcutting experience per log. They cannot be used in training Firemaking .

Players can deposit up to 60 juniper logs in each charcoal furnace in the south end of Hosidius, and lighting the furnace requires a tinderbox and paying Smoggy 600 coins. After the logs have finished burning, players may obtain juniper charcoal , used to make dynamite . Each log yields 50 juniper charcoal.
13356:
Lovakite ore is a type of ore that can be obtained through Mining, and is only found in the lovakite mine in Lovakengj. Mining this ore requires 65 Mining.

Lovakite ore can be mined with a Mining level of 65 or higher, granting 60 Mining experience. Lovakite ore has a respawn time of 30–45 seconds.

It can be smelted into a lovakite bar by combining one Lovakite ore with two coal, which requires level 45 Smithing and grants 20 experience. Lovakite can only be smelted at the lovakite furnace in central Lovankengj (south of the Blast Mine) or via Superheat Item. Attempting to do so at any other furnace will state that the furnace's temperature is wrong for this ore. Lovakite bars can then be smithed into Shayzien armour.

It takes 11 bars to make one full set of armour, equivalent to 11 lovakite ores and 22 coal.

Varrock armour 2 and higher levels of Varrock armour has a chance to double the number of ores received from mining.

Mining a piece of lovakite ore is a hard Kourend & Kebos Diary task.

It is used in the Crafting skill to create Xerician robes using a needle and thread or a costume needle . The Xerician robes can be stored in an Armour case in the Costume room of a Player-owned house .
13385:
The Xerician hat is a part of the Xerician robes set, and requires 10 Defence and 20 Magic to wear.

Its stats are identical to gnome hats , Canifis hats , the ghostly hood , and the Fremennik hat . The hat is the second-lightest of the equivalent alternatives, being only slightly beaten by the ghostly hood; because of this, it's not recommended to use the hat in situations where it might be lost, as the alternatives are considerably cheaper.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Xerician robes . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
13387:
The Xerician top is part of the Xerician robes set. Equipping the Xerician top requires the player to have at least 10 Defence and 20 Magic .

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Xerician robes . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
13389:
The Xerician robe is part of the Xerician robes set. Equipping the Xerician robe requires the player to have at least 10 Defence and 20 Magic .

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Xerician robes . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
13391:
The lizardman fang is a common drop from lizardmen and their brute and shaman counterparts. They are used to charge teleports on Xeric's talisman, in which each fang provides one teleport charge.

100 Lizardman fangs can also be obtained by dismantling an inert Xeric's talisman, either via the 'Dismantle' option or by using a pet rock on it.
13392:
Xeric's talisman is an amulet that allows players to teleport to locations around Great Kourend . The talisman was once owned by Xeric , a tyrannical ruler who reigned over Great Kourend during the Age of Strife .

At level 72 Construction , the talisman can be mounted in the portal nexus room in a player-owned house . This requires an inert Xeric's talisman, 1 mahogany plank , 1 gold leaf and 5,000 lizardman fangs . A mounted talisman provides unlimited teleport charges.
13393:

13394: Gang meeting info is an item obtained from the information board near Captain Ginea. It details the location of meetings between gangsters and the gang boss. This is part of the Intelligence Gathering activity.
13395:
Intelligence is obtained from gangsters and the gang boss during one of their meetings, which can be discovered by speaking to Captain Ginea . It can be given to her in exchange for a training manual . This is part of the Intelligence Gathering activity. If you receive it as a drop, when you world hop, the item will follow you to the new world. NOTE: The normal despawn timer still applies.

This item cannot be banked, and will instead message "A magical force prevents you from banking this item!" upon attempt.
13396: The training manual is obtained from Captain Ginea as part of the Intelligence Gathering activity after giving her an intelligence report, dropped by gangsters and the gang boss during one of their meetings. Reading the book gives the player the option to gain experience in either Hitpoints , Attack , Strength , or Defence . This item cannot be banked. Dying with the book in your inventory will cause it to be permanently lost.
13397: Servery flour are obtained from the food cupboard in the Hosidius mess. It is used in creating servery pineapple pizza and servery meat pie.
13398: Servery pastry dough is obtained from using a bowl of water on servery flour. It is then used on a servery dish to create a servery pie shell.
13399: Servery raw meat is obtained from the meat table in the Hosidius mess . It can be cooked into servery cooked meat , granting 1 Cooking experience. It is used in creating servery stew and servery meat pie .
13400: Servery dishes are obtained from the utensil cupboard in the Hosidius mess. It is used in creating servery meat pie.
13401: Servery pie shell is obtained from using a servery pastry dough on a servery dish . It is then used on a servery cooked meat to create a servery uncooked pie .
13402: Servery uncooked pie is obtained by using a servery cooked meat on a servery pie shell . It is then cooked to create a servery meat pie , which grants 3 experience. It can then be served at the buffet table for the Shayzien soldiers in the Hosidius mess for additional Cooking experience.
13403: Servery meat pie is obtained from cooking a servery uncooked pie in the Hosidius mess. It is then served at the buffet table for the Shayzien soldiers. A Cooking level of 20 is required to make this meat pie.
13404: Servery pizza base is obtained from using a bowl of water on servery flour . It is then used on a servery tomato to create a servery incomplete pizza .
13405: Servery tomatoes are obtained from the food cupboard in the Hosidius mess . It is used on a servery pizza base to create a servery incomplete pizza .
13406:

13409: Servery plain pizza is obtained by cooking a servery incomplete pizza in a clay oven in the Hosidius mess . It is then used on servery pineapple chunks to create servery pineapple pizza , which is served at the buffet table for the Shayzien soldiers.

13411: Servery pineapple chunks is obtained from using a knife on a servery pineapple . It is then used on a servery plain pizza to create a servery pineapple pizza .
13412: Servery pineapple pizza is obtained from using servery pineapple chunks on a servery plain pizza . It is then served at the buffet table for the Shayzien soldiers in the Hosidius mess . A Cooking level of 65 is required to make this pizza. This item cannot be banked.
13413:

If you try to eat the servery cooked meat, Ewesey will tell you that it is not for you.
13414: Servery potato is obtained from the food cupboard in the Hosidius mess . It is used in creating servery stew .
13415: Servery incomplete stew is obtained by using either a servery cooked meat or servery potato on a bowl of water. It is used in creating servery stew, which is served to Shayzien soldiers in the Hosidius mess.
13416: Servery incomplete stew is obtained by using either a servery cooked meat or servery potato on a bowl of water. It is used in creating servery stew, which is served to Shayzien soldiers in the Hosidius mess.
13417: Servery uncooked stew is obtained by using either a servery cooked meat or servery potato on a servery incomplete stew , depending on what the player put in the incomplete stew. 13419:
Sulphurous fertiliser can be made at level 36 Farming by combining saltpetre with regular compost . It can be used on grape vines in the Vinery to increase the yield of grapes and Zamorak's grapes by 20%.

Sulphurous fertiliser was originally used in the Kourend Favour system, where players could hand it into the Clerk in the centre of the saltpetre mine at a rate of 0.1% Hosidius favour per bucket.
13420:
Gricoller's fertiliser is an item only available within the Tithe Farm minigame.

It is automatically added to your inventory at the start of the minigame granted the player has enough space.

After being used on a planted seed, it will decrease the time it takes for the seed to grow by half.

Gricoller's fertiliser can be useful at the end of a Tithe Farm session when only a small number of fruit are needed to hit the bonus points at the 100 fruit threshold; the fertiliser will help speed up the last growth periods of the smaller batches of plants.
13421:
Saltpetre is a mineral found north-east of the Woodcutting Guild in Hosidius , where five saltpetre deposits can be found (big grey circles on the map). Saltpetre can be obtained by using a spade on these deposits. A bank deposit box can be found in the centre of the saltpetre deposits. Players can teleport here by using the skills necklace and going to the Woodcutting Guild , or using Kharedst's memoirs to teleport to Hosidius , then running south.

Saltpetre can also be obtained as a reward from the Chambers of Xeric and the reward cart after subduing the Wintertodt .

Digging up saltpetre is a task in the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary .
13423:
Golovanova seeds are used to grow golovanova fruit in the Tithe Farm minigame . Level 34 Farming is required to use the seeds.

Upon leaving the minigame area through the farm door , all seeds in a player's inventory will disappear.

No experience is granted for planting the seeds.The player will receive 6 experience upon harvesting the fruit and 60 experience for depositing it into the sacks, or 6.1 and 61.5 experience respectively with the complete farmer's outfit . The player will also receive a bonus of 1,500 experience should they return 75 fruit or more at a time. This experience bonus is not boosted by the farmer's oufit. Additionally, the 75th through 100th fruit deposited will grant double experience. Up to 10,000 seeds can be obtained from the table by the entrance of the minigame.

The total experience earned from harvesting and depositing a full batch of seeds (100 fruits) is 9,660. Wearing the full farmer's outfit will boost the experience from harvesting and depositing fruit (but not the experience bonus) by 2.5%, bringing the total experience per 100 fruits to 9,859.

Leaving the Tithe Farm minigame, either through the door, teleporting, or any other means, will remove any harvested fruit from the players inventory, and reward 0 xp. However, the player can safely log out without losing any harvested fruit or seeds, as the player will be placed inside the minigame when logged back in.

Fresh fish was obtained from barrels of fish found throughout Port Piscarilius. Players must deposit these into the cooling chest in Frankie's Fishing Emporium in the south-east corner of the docks. When handing in at least 2 fresh fish at once, there is a 20% chance for each fish to yield 0.1% Piscarilius favour each. Every fish handed in beyond the first will grant 10 Fishing experience.

Players have a minute before the fresh fish deteriorates, so be sure to deposit it immediately.

It is recommended to gather the fresh fish directly west of Frankie's store, as it's closest to the cooling chest. After gathering about 20 fish, run to the deposit box. This gives approximately 0.3% Piscarilius favour towards the House per 20 fish.
13430:
A bucket of sandworms is obtained by digging sandworm castings north of Tynan's Fishing Supplies , granting 10 experience in Hunter . While digging sandworm castings, players may fail to find any sandworms, resulting in a bucket of sand instead.

In order to obtain buckets of sandworms, players require at least level 15 Hunter while carrying a spade and empty bucket . There is a 59-70% chance of obtaining a bucket of sandworm, depending on the player's Hunter level.

Each bucket holds between 1 and 5 sandworms as anglerfish bait.
13431:
Sandworms are bait used with a fishing rod to catch anglerfish. They can be purchased from Tynan's Fishing Supplies in Port Piscarilius or caught on the shores of Piscarilius, in the north-east area directly east of the bank and just north of Tynan.

When the player reaches 15 Hunter, sandworms can be caught on the shores of Piscarilius by digging sandworm castings with a spade and buckets. Each bucket will fill with either sand or sandworms, with the latter yielding 10 Hunter experience. Harvesting a bucket of sandworms gives between 1 and 5 sandworms and returns the bucket.

Digging sandworms is also a decent method of low-level moneymaking, netting upwards of 100,000–150,000 coins per hour.

Diabolic worms can be used instead, acting as a direct upgrade to sandworms. They are only dropped by Yama, but vastly improve the speed of catching anglerfish.
13432:
A Sandworms pack is an item pack containing 100 sandworms.

These packs can only be purchased from Tynan's Fishing Supplies in Port Piscarilius.

13439:
Raw anglerfish are a type of fish found only in Port Piscarilius . In order to catch this fish, players require level 82 in Fishing , a fishing rod , and either sandworms or diabolic worms . Each catch grants 120 Fishing experience (or 79.2 if using diabolic worms). Anglerfish are located at the bait fishing spot south of Tynan's Fishing Supplies , or they can be caught via boat fishing from any player boat slightly north-east of the Piscarilius foodhall. Anglerfish fishing spots on land have a highly random movement timer, ranging from as little as 8 ticks (4.8 seconds) up to 1000 ticks (approximately 10 minutes), making them considered an unreliable AFK fishing option. However, anglerfish fishing spots at sea do not move and so they are the better option for AFK fishing.

Cooking anglerfish requires level 84 in Cooking , and gives 230 experience. Burning anglerfish will result in a burnt anglerfish . The amount of Hitpoints healed is dependent on the player's Hitpoints level. At level 93 and above, an anglerfish will heal 22. Anglerfish can also heal above maximum Hitpoints (making the maximum Hitpoints possible 121).

Catching an anglerfish and cooking it whilst in Great Kourend is an elite Kourend & Kebos Diary task.
13441:
The Anglerfish is a type of fish that restores 3-22 Hitpoints depending on your Hitpoints level (see table below). Unlike other foods, anglerfish may also heal above your maximum hitpoints up to the amount restored, with a maximum of 121 hitpoints if the player has a base level of 99 hitpoints. This does not apply if the player is in combat in a PvP area, whether with another player or a non-player character.

It can be obtained by cooking raw anglerfish on a fire or cooking range , requiring level 84 Cooking and granting 230 experience when successful. When cooking, there is a chance to fail, resulting in a burnt anglerfish . The burn rate decreases as the player's Cooking level increases. It will only stop burning entirely if the player is wearing a Cooking cape or using Cooking gauntlets at level 97 (87 if elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is completed while cooking at the city kitchens ).

When at level 93 Hitpoints or higher, the Anglerfish is the second highest instant-health single consumption food, behind the marlin , alongside the dark crab , tuna potato , bluefin and manta ray . The anglerfish has the ability to overheal unlike the others, though the dark crab has the lowest weight.

The tuna potato has the lowest Cooking requirement, but highest weight. Cooked moonlight antelope and cooked dashing kebbit heal 26 and 23 health respectively, but part of the healing is delayed, making them not always practical in the same situations.
13443:
Burnt anglerfish is the result of accidentally burning a raw anglerfish while attempting to make an anglerfish . The burn rate while cooking these will decrease as players reach higher Cooking levels, stopping entirely at level 98 when wearing cooking gauntlets .

The burnt anglerfish has no use whatsoever. Like most other burnt food, it is tradeable to other players but not on the Grand Exchange .
13445:
A dense essence block is a raw material used in the Runecraft skill to make blood runes , soul runes , and Arceuus spellbook teleport tablets . They can be obtained by mining the dense runestone at the dense essence mine north-east of Arceuus .

Dense essence blocks can be infused with dark power at the Dark Altar found north-west of the dense runestone mines, turning every dense essence block in the player's inventory into a dark essence block . One Prayer point is drained for each block converted, however players can still convert blocks with 0 Prayer points remaining.

The dark essence blocks can then be crushed with a chisel to turn into dark essence fragments . These dark essence fragments can then be used for runecrafting blood and soul runes. Alternatively, the dark essence blocks can be brought to the lectern located in the Ouditor 's house in Arceuus to create teleport tablets.

Dense essence blocks and dark essence fragments cannot be banked, however dark essence blocks can.

Players cannot get the rock golem pet while mining dense essence blocks.
13446:
A dark essence block is an item created by using dense essence blocks on the Dark Altar located in the northern area of Arceuus. Dense essence blocks are mined nearby using a chisel and a pickaxe.

Each dark essence block created gives 2.5 Runecraft experience while draining 1 prayer point. They can still be made without any prayer points remaining.

Dark essence blocks are used in the creation of Arceuus spellbook teleport tablets (instead of soft clay) at the lectern located in the Ouditor's house in Arceuus whilst being on the Arceuus spellbook.

Dark essence blocks can also be used with a chisel to create 4 dark essence fragments per block, which are runecrafted into blood runes and soul runes. When crafting blood runes, each dark essence block is worth 97.7 experience, including the 2.5 experience gained when imbuing the block at the dark altar. This increases to 121.3 when crafting soul runes.

Dark essence blocks disappear upon death.

[ 1 ] [ 2 ] Otherwise, it must be taken to the Dark Altar in Arceuus to be reanimated.

The Book of arcane knowledge is a reward from helping NPCs find their requested book around the Arceuus Library. When used, it grants players a choice of experience in either Magic or Runecraft, granting Magic experience equal to 15x the player's level, or Runecraft experience equal to 5x the player's level.

Similarly to the book of knowledge, this item cannot be placed within a player's bank and is consumed after one use.

You can use the Arceuus Library Books Calculator to determine how many books are needed to reach a target level or XP.
13514:
Dark manuscripts were ancient pages found in the Grand Library in Arceuus . Horphis could have asked the player to find manuscripts for them, in which their location was random. Upon handing in a manuscript, a book of arcane knowledge was rewarded, as well as favour for Arceuus.

To get a hint to find the location of a manuscript, players could ask Biblia on the top floor of the library.

Players could not read the manuscript as it was too complex for the player to decipher the symbols.

Shayzien supply crates were used to pack Shayzien supply armour . Searching the drawers in any of the armourer 's houses in western or southern Lovakengj yielded 1 or 100 noted supply crates at a time.

Packed Shayzien supply set (2) or higher was required to complete an elite clue scroll Sherlock skill task. The smithed items must be packed into the crate, individual items are not accepted.

The armourers can be found at the following locations:
13565:
A Shayzien supply set (1) is a Shayzien supply crate packed with one of each: Shayzien supply helm (1), Shayzien supply platebody (1), Shayzien supply greaves (1), Shayzien supply gloves (1), and Shayzien supply boots (1). 100 noted shayzien supply crates can be found in the drawers of any armourer's house.

To create the full set to pack into a supply crate, 53 Smithing, 11 lovakite bars, and 30% Lovakengj favour are required:

45 Smithing and 1 Lovakite bar for Shayzien supply gloves (1)

47 Smithing and 1 Lovakite bar for Shayzien supply boots (1)

49 Smithing and 2 Lovakite bars for Shayzien supply helm (1)

51 Smithing and 3 Lovakite bars for Shayzien supply greaves (1)

53 Smithing and 4 Lovakite bars for Shayzien supply platebody (1)

A set is delivered to armourer (tier 1) for 1.5% Lovakengj favour, 675 Mining experience (692 if wearing the full Prospector kit) and 1,200 Smithing experience. It is more efficient to hand in the set compared to delivering a single tier 1 shayzien supply armour which rewards 45 Mining experience, 80 Smithing experience, and 0.1% Lovakengj favour per bar required to make the armour piece. Per bar the set rewards 61.4 Mining experience, 109.1 Smithing experience, and 0.136% Lovakengj favour.

Juniper charcoal is made on the southern beach of Hosidius , shown on the map as Charcoal burners . To make juniper charcoal, mature juniper trees (located north of the charcoal burners) must be cut for juniper logs to add to one of the charcoal furnaces (maximum 60 per furnace), which are then lit with a tinderbox . Smoggy must be paid 600 coins (per furnace) to watch over the process for you. After 16 hours and 30 minutes, 50 juniper charcoal per log added can be collected from furnace, producing up to 3,000 juniper charcoal per furnace.

Juniper charcoal is one of the ingredients needed to make dynamite ; the others being volcanic sulphur , saltpetre , a pot , and a ball of wool . Dynamite is used in the Blast Mine minigame, requiring level 43 Mining to participate.
13571:
Volcanic sulphur is a mineral that can be mined within the Lovakengj sulphur mine. Volcanic sulphur deposits require level 42 Mining and an equipped breathing filter (such as a gas mask, facemask, or slayer helmet) to mine, and grant 35 Mining experience.

Volcanic sulphur is used along with juniper charcoal, saltpetre, and a pot to create a dynamite pot. Adding a ball of wool to the dynamite pot creates dynamite, which can be used in the Blast Mine at level 43 Mining.

A breathing filter is mandatory to attempt to mine volcanic sulphur; if unequipped, a warning is shown in the chatbox stating that "You'll choke on the fumes if you try to mine without protection." In addition, moving gas clouds within the mine will deal rapid hits of 1-3 damage per tick to unprotected players instead of the usual 1 damage per tick with protection.

It is recommended to mine the volcanic sulphur deposits from the south or from the west to avoid taking excessive damage since the gas clouds cannot damage you when directly south or west of you.

Players can extend their stay at the sulphur deposits if they also wear the Hitpoints Cape and Regen Bracelet, as in combination these provide additional natural healing (+4 hp/min).

The sulphur clouds may be safespotted by luring a spider to the western-most sulphur deposit. This can be done by attacking the spider with auto-retaliate off (casting curse spells or splashing recommended). The safespot setup requires the player to stand on the west square positioned south of the western most deposit with the spider attacking from the east. This safespot works as long as you do not move, step on the spider, or others players walking on you or the spider. Mining using this safespot will not show the mining animation, but you will continue to mine.

One volcanic sulphur piece is used in A Kingdom Divided quest.
13572: A dynamite pot is created by combining volcanic sulphur , juniper charcoal , and saltpetre in a pot . Adding a ball of wool converts it into usable dynamite that is used in the Blast Mining minigame on the northern side of Lovakengj .
13573:
Dynamite is used in the Blast Mining minigame on the northern side of Lovakengj . Lighting dynamite in the Blast Mine provides 50 Firemaking experience .

In order to create dynamite themselves, players must combine volcanic sulphur , juniper charcoal , saltpetre , and a pot to create a dynamite pot , then add a ball of wool to complete the product.

As a time-saving alternative for those not wishing to create the dynamite themselves, players can also purchase dynamite from two shops:

Players can also obtain dynamite as a reward from subduing the Wintertodt or completing the Chambers of Xeric , or claim them daily from Thirus once the Kourend & Kebos medium diary is completed (20 for medium, 40 for hard, 80 for elite).
13575:
Blasted ore is obtained after detonating a hard rock face in the blast mine . Players must first excavate the hard rock using a chisel , then using a pot of dynamite on the resulting cavity. Then, players must light the dynamite and run away from it, or large amounts of damage will be taken.

Once the dynamite explodes, blasted ore will appear where the dynamite exploded. It should then be deposited in an ore sack near a blonde-haired operator . Players have three minutes before the blasted ore disintegrates, so it is encouraged to deposit the ore frequently.

Should the player pick up but not deposit the blasted ore in the Ore sack in time, the blasted ore will disappear from the inventory and a message will appear in the chat interface "Your blasted ore has disintegrated." Hopping worlds will also cause all blasted ore to disintegrate.

If a temporary boost is to be applied when blast mining, they must be activated before the blasted ore is initially spawned.

Like pay-dirt , blasted ore cannot be deposited in a bank .
13576:
The dragon warhammer is a warhammer that requires 60 Strength to wield and is currently one of the strongest warhammers available (second only to the Statius Warhammer ) in Old School RuneScape . It is obtained as an extremely rare drop from Lizardman shamans .

The dragon warhammer can be used as a substitute for a regular hammer when banging the big door at the entrance of Bandos' Stronghold in the God Wars Dungeon , as well as in the Chambers of Xeric to stun Jewelled Crabs and build any storage chest (with the required mallignum root planks and Construction level). It can also be used in the Tombs of Amascut to repair the pillars in the monkey puzzle of the Path of Apmeken .

The dragon warhammer is popular for its special attack, as it can drastically reduce the opponent's defence and make them an easier target. Additionally, it is a popular weapon among strength pures due to the lack of an Attack requirement and considerable damage output.

As with most dragon equipment , the dragon warhammer cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.

The seed box is an item that can store up to 2,147,483,647 seeds of six different types. It is purchased from Farmer Gricoller at the Tithe Farm for 250 points. This item can be used directly on a farming patch . Using the box on a patch will automatically plant the first applicable seed of that patch's type, which can be reordered. Players can right-click to open the box, which will have seeds that the player picks up be automatically placed inside the box, provided there is space for it.

Although frags and mushroom spores are not taxonomically seeds, they can still be stored in the seed box.

Like Gricoller's can , players can only own one seed box at a time. It is useful to bring to Slayer tasks and bosses which drop a large variety of seeds commonly, such as nechryael , to save inventory space. Ultimate Ironman players may find the seed box very useful, as it saves up to five inventory spaces while training Farming and Herblore .

It is also useful to bring while shipwreck salvaging due to the number of seeds and frags different shipwrecks provide, particularly at large shipwrecks and merchant shipwrecks . Seeds gained from sorting salvage do not automatically go into an opened seed box.

The ring of wealth (i) doubles the rate of clue bottle drops above beginner clue bottles from Fishing in the Wilderness .

The ring of wealth (i) doubles the rate of clue bottle drops above beginner clue bottles from Fishing in the Wilderness .

13652:
Dragon claws are a two-handed melee weapon obtained as a rare reward from the Chambers of Xeric , and require level 60 Attack to equip. They are notable for their special attack, which can quickly deal a high amount of damage, making them a popular weapon for PKing .

As with most dragon equipment , the dragon claws cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.
13653:
The discontinued bird nest from Wyson was an old variant of the Wyson seed nest obtainable before the release of the Farming Guild . After this update, the existing nests were discontinued, and newly obtained nests would instead be the current variant. All nests previously obtained would remain in banks and inventories, and the new nests obtained would provide snape grass , dragonfruit , celastrus , and redwood tree seeds . This change was made to prevent players from obtaining large quantities of the new seeds immediately upon release of the content.

Like the current version of bird nests, they were obtained from Wyson in exchange for mole claws and mole skins .
13654:
The Nest box (seeds) is an item formerly obtained from Wyson the gardener in Falador Park . It could be obtained from trading in noted mole claws or mole skins . When opened, it would provide a Wyson bird nest . They were added in 2016 with an update that improved the quality of the seeds from Wyson's nests.

In an update on 17 January 2019 , Wyson's nests were updated again to include the new seeds released with the Kebos Lowlands . Therefore, he now gave out new nest boxes which contained different bird nests . However, the original nest boxes remain in the game, making them a rare example of a discontinued item in Old School RuneScape .
13655:
The Gnome child hat is a cosmetic holiday item first obtained from opening the present during the 2016 Birthday event , as well as subsequent birthday events. It is the hat that gnome children wear.

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room .
13656:
The present was an item used during the 3rd birthday event . It was given to the player by Sir Tiffy Cashien , who assumes they were the courier he summoned. The present was intended for his grandson, Ebel Lum, whom the player was supposed to deliver to, but it was brought to the gnome child in Lumbridge instead. Attempting to open it before speaking to the gnome child resulted in the message This isn't for me to open!

The present contained a gnome child hat . Players who did not participate in the previous birthday events would have also received the cow outfit and a war ship .
13657:
Grape seeds can be planted in a vine patch at the Hosidius Vinery at level 36 Farming in order to grow a grape vine, which will yield grapes. Grape seeds can be obtained from the Tithe Farm for 2 points per seed.

Players will need to use saltpetre on the patches with a gardening trowel in order to treat the soil before planting the grape seeds. Afterwards, Gallow will watch over your grapes for free. Sulphorous fertilizer can be used on the patches to increase the yield by 20%.

Once fully grown, players can check the grape vine's health for 625 Farming experience and can harvest the grapes (or Zamorak's grapes if players have a sufficient amount of Bologa's blessings in their inventory). The amount of grapes harvested from a fully grown grape vine is random, much like harvesting herbs, but has a minimum number of five grapes per seed (five harvest lives). Players with higher Farming levels can expect substantially more grapes from each vine. After all the grapes have been harvested, the grape vine will die and players will have to clear the farming patch with a spade.
13658:
A teleport card is used to charge the Chronicle, a book that teleports the player just outside the Champions' Guild. They can be purchased from Diango's Toy Store, for 150 coins each. Additional cards can be obtained by trading with other players and can be bought at the Grand Exchange.

Noted teleport cards cannot be used to charge the Chronicle.

Eight of these cards could be obtained by breaking chocolate eggs during the 2016 Easter event.
13660:
The Chronicle is an equipable book that can be used to teleport the player to just outside the Champions' Guild, making it useful for players who plant seeds in bush and hops patches as well as free-to-play ironmen. The teleport is also a short distance from Charlie the Tramp, making it useful for those doing beginner clues.

During the 2016 Easter event, players were able to acquire it for free by defeating the Chocolate Chicken during the event. It can now be purchased from Diango's Toy Store for 300 coins. If the player has a copy of the Chronicle in the inventory or bank, trying to buy another one from Diango will fail, and the user will receive the following message: "You've already got one of those." However, it is possible to own more than one Chronicle if buying them from Perdu.

In order to use the Chronicle, it must be charged with teleport cards. Players can purchase them from Diango's Toy Store at a base price of 150 coins each. The book can hold a maximum of 1,000 charges, with one being used each time the Chronicle is used to teleport. Upon death, when not an item kept on death, it is destroyed. If the Chronicle is lost or destroyed, it retains its charges if bought back.

The Chronicle's powers do not work in the Wilderness.
13661: A chocolate egg was obtained from chasing the Chocolate Chicken during the 2016 Easter event . Eight of these were obtained during the event, and could be broken to receive a teleport card , which is used to charge the Chronicle . These eggs cannot be deposited into a bank.
13663:

13679:
The cabbage cape is an item that can be purchased from Diango's Toy Store. It has the same stats as coloured capes and team capes.

It was initially obtained during the 2016 April Fools event, when players achieved level 120 in the Cabbage Picking skill. When players trained to this level, they were able to purchase the cape from Kupus Varza for 10 cabbages. After the event, it was added to Diango's store.

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room.

It resembles a Cape of Accomplishment and allows the Skill Cape emote to be performed when worn. It cannot be used instead of a legitimate skillcape for the elite Falador Diary task.
13680:
The cabbage rune was used to pick magic cabbages during the 2016 April Fools event.

Kupus Varza sold 12 of these for 20 coins.
13681:

It was first obtained during the 2016 April Fools event, where Kupus Varza gave it to players once they had achieved level 100 in the "Cabbage Picking" skill.

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room.
16684:
The useless key is an unobtainable item released alongside A Taste of Hope , created to replace the discontinued shortcut key . Two versions of the key were created to replace the standard and bank placeholder versions of the shortcut key. While the useless key was never meant to be seen by players, it inadvertently became visible as the bank placeholders were not wiped from the game. [ 1 ] Therefore, any players who had created a bank placeholder of the shortcut key saw the useless key takes its place.

The placeholders were removed over a year later in an update on 13 June 2019.
19473:
A bag full of gems is a bag that contains an assortment of 40 noted uncut gems . These bags are obtainable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 40 golden nuggets , from Belona 's Mining Guild Mineral Exchange for 20 unidentified minerals , or from Dusuri's Star Shop for 300 stardust .

The chances of an individual gem being an uncut onyx is 1/100,000,000, making the chance per bag approximately 1/2,500,000. In terms of probability, this makes it one of the rarest drops in the game. [ 1 ]

Obtaining the uncut onyx from a bag full of gems does produce an entry in the Collection Log .

The bags are exclusive to the stores they are bought from and therefore cannot be sold to another store in exchange for a different currency.
19476:
The achievement diary cape can be obtained by players who have completed all Achievement Diaries. It can be purchased along with its hood for 99,000 coins, from Twiggy O'Korn in Draynor Village. The cape becomes trimmed after completion of all quests, as do the quest cape and music cape after completing all diaries. The cape is notable for providing teleports to all diary masters, and offering a close bank teleport, and options that are useful for optimal Runecrafting and Farming runs.

If a new quest is released, the cape will untrim itself, and will not be able to be re-trimmed until the player completes it. Unlike skillcapes, the achievement diary cape can be trimmed and untrimmed at will, provided that the player meets the requirements. The cape provides a +4 prayer bonus, regardless of whether or not it is trimmed. Untrimmed skill capes will not be trimmed from trimming the achievement diary cape. Obtaining the music cape is not necessary to trim the diary cape.

This item can be stored in the cape rack of a costume room, as part of the achievement diary cape set, along with the hood. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
19478:
The light ballista is a two-handed crossbow that uses javelins as ammunition, requiring level 65 in Ranged to wield.

It is created by using ballista limbs on a light frame, then using the resulting incomplete light ballista on a ballista spring, and finally adding a monkey tail on an unstrung light ballista. This process requires 47 Fletching and grants 330 experience.

Despite being classified as a crossbow, it cannot be used with a mith grapple to grapple across certain Agility shortcuts.
19481:
The heavy ballista is a two-handed crossbow that uses javelins as ammunition, requiring level 75 in Ranged and the completion of the quest Monkey Madness II to wield. Players must also accept both Duke and Daero 's training in order to make use of it, unlike the light ballista . Attempting to equip the ballista without these requirements results in the message You must have completed Monkey Madness II and the advanced combat training from Duke to be able to wield this weapon. . While there is no direct Defence requirement for the heavy ballista, completing the required training from Daero after Monkey Madness I will provide a minimum of 20,000 Defence experience. This corresponds to an effective level requirement of 33 Defence.

It is created by using ballista limbs on a heavy frame , then using the resulting incomplete heavy ballista on a ballista spring , and finally adding the monkey tail on an unstrung heavy ballista . The entire process requires 72 Fletching and grants 660 experience.

The speed on accurate is one tick slower than a godsword (7 ticks), but when put on rapid it matches the speed of a godsword (6 ticks). The ballista has an attack range of 9. Longrange increases attack range by 1.

Players may combine a heavy ballista with a heavy ballista ornament kit to create a heavy ballista (or) .

Despite being classified as a crossbow, it cannot be used with a mith grapple to grapple across certain agility shortcuts.
19484:

They can be fletched by attaching dragon javelin tips to javelin shafts at level 92 Fletching, granting 225 experience per 15 javelins made.

19493:
Zenyte is the highest tier of gem in Old School RuneScape . Zenyte shards are dropped by tortured or demonic gorillas , then are combined with a cut onyx to produce an uncut zenyte , which can be cut to form a zenyte.

Cutting an uncut zenyte with a chisel requires level 89 Crafting and yields 50 experience . It can then be made into zenyte jewellery by using a furnace along with a gold bar and a mould .

Zenyte jewellery can be enchanted to make some of the most powerful jewellery in the game. Wearing any piece of enchanted zenyte jewellery requires level 75 Hitpoints .

Unlike other gems, zenytes do not appear to form naturally, but rather seem to have been created in some part due to Glough 's mutagen being corrupted by reversing the flow of energy from the charged onyx .
19496:
An uncut zenyte is the highest tier of gem in Old School RuneScape . It can be made by combining a cut onyx with a zenyte shard at the wall of flame beneath the Temple of Marimbo on Ape Atoll , while wearing a zombie monkey greegree (small or big). This requires completion of Monkey Madness II and level 70 Crafting , and grants 15 experience . It can then be cut with level 89 Crafting into zenyte , granting 50 experience.

Cut zenyte is used to make enchanted zenyte jewellery , which are some of the most powerful in the game. These are amulet of torture , necklace of anguish , ring of suffering , and tormented bracelet .
19501:
A zenyte amulet (u) is the unstrung version of the regular zenyte amulet . It is made by using a gold bar on a furnace, while having a cut zenyte and an amulet mould in the inventory.

Level 98 Crafting is required to make one, and grants 200 experience . When used with a ball of wool , it becomes a zenyte amulet , giving an additional 4 experience. After the strung amulet is enchanted via the Lvl-7 Enchant spell, it becomes an amulet of torture , which requires level 93 Magic and yields 110 experience.
19505: The mysterious note is an item obtained during Monkey Madness II . Players will find it by searching the fire remains on the 2 nd floor [ UK ] 3 rd floor [ US ] of Glough's house. The note contains a message written in invisible ink. After the message is decoded it becomes the scrawled note .

19515:
The book of spyology is a book found during the quest Monkey Madness II. It can be obtained from a cupboard on the 2nd floor of Glough's house after investigating the gnome statue.

After completing the quest, it can be reclaimed from the cupboard or a bookcase within a player-owned house.

The author of the book is T. Gure.
19517: A brush is an item obtained during Monkey Madness II. Players will find it by searching the gnome crates on the 2nd floor of Glough's house. It is used to decode the Mysterious note by applying grape juice to the brush to become a Juice-coated brush and using it on the note. After the note is brushed with grape juice it becomes a Scrawled note.
19519: A juice-coated brush is an item obtained during Monkey Madness II by using a pestle and mortar on grapes with a brush in the inventory. Once a player applies the Juice-coated brush to the Mysterious note , they will receive a Scrawled note.
19521: A handkerchief is found after investigating the tree upstairs in Glough 's house. It belongs to Glough 's girlfriend, Anita .
19523: Kruk's paw is an item obtained from Kruk 's corpse during Monkey Madness II . It is used on Zooknock , along with a monkey talisman , to create a Kruk monkey greegree in order to disguise the player as Kruk.
19525:
Kruk monkey greegree (also known as a large ninja greegree ) is used for transforming into Kruk on Ape Atoll during Monkey Madness II . To make one, a player must take a monkey talisman and Kruk's paw to Zooknock , located at the very end of the Ape Atoll Dungeon .

A glitch exists where if the player gets caught and they try to transform back, there is a small chance they will lose their greegree; however, this glitch is not common. If the player has a full inventory, and teleports from Ape Atoll without removing their greegree, they will lose it.

After Monkey Madness II, it can be reobtained from Zooknock in the Tree Gnome Stronghold , north-west of the Gnome Ball Field, if lost by selecting the 'Large Ninja' greegree, as it is not listed as Kruk monkey greegree. No materials are required. If it is lost during the quest, you can get it back talking with Zooknock at the end of the Ape Atoll Dungeon .

The greegree can be used for training Agility at the Ape Atoll Agility Course or to hunt maniacal monkeys .
19527:
A Satchel is obtained during Monkey Madness II . After navigating the maze, the player will discover a crate which they can search. The player needs a total of six satchels to complete that section of the quest. After six are obtained, the player must re-navigate the maze to find the explosives which can only be stored within the satchel.

After all the explosive satchels are placed at weak point, the player can leave the construction site and detonate the explosives.

These satchels cannot be banked.

The zenyte shard is a rare drop received from tortured and demonic gorillas in the Crash Site Cavern , which can be accessed after completion of Monkey Madness II .

In order to create an uncut zenyte , the shard must be fused with a cut onyx in the wall of flames of the Temple of Marimbo Dungeon while holding a zombie monkey greegree (either variant). Doing so grants 15 crafting experience and gives the message: You reach into the extremely hot flames and fuse the zenyte and onyx together, forming an uncut zenyte.

Using a zenyte shard on a cut onyx gives the message: Only the intense heat of the flame pits beneath Ape Atoll can fuse the zenyte and onyx together.
19532:
The zenyte bracelet is made by using a gold bar , a zenyte , and a bracelet mould on a furnace with a Crafting level of 95. Doing so gives the player 180 experience in Crafting.

Players can cast Lvl-7 Enchant on a zenyte bracelet to enchant it into a tormented bracelet . This requires level 93 Magic and grants 110 Magic experience.
19535:
