24664:
The twisted ancestral hat is an ancestral hat with a twisted ancestral colour kit attached to it. The attached colour kit gives no additional bonuses, and is only used to add aesthetics to the hat.

While the hat is untradeable in its recoloured state, it can be dismantled anytime, returning the ornament kit and tradeable hat. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house. If a player loses the twisted ancestral hat in a PvP death, the twisted ancestral colour kit will be placed in their gravestone.
24666:
The twisted ancestral robe top is an ancestral robe top with a twisted ancestral colour kit attached to it. The attached colour kit gives no additional bonuses, and is only used to change the aesthetics of the robe.

While the robe top is untradeable in its recoloured state, it can be dismantled anytime, returning the ornament kit and tradeable robe top. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house. If a player loses the twisted ancestral robe top in a PvP death, the twisted ancestral colour kit will be placed in their gravestone.
24668:
The twisted ancestral robe bottom is an ancestral robe bottom with a twisted ancestral colour kit attached to it. The attached colour kit gives no additional bonuses, and is only used to add aesthetics to the robe.

While the robe bottom is untradeable in its recoloured state, it can be dismantled anytime, returning the ornament kit and tradeable robe bottom. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house. If a player loses the twisted ancestral robe bottom in a PvP death, the twisted ancestral colour kit will be placed in their gravestone.
24670:
The twisted ancestral colour kit is a tertiary drop that can be obtained upon completing a Chambers of Xeric raid in Challenge Mode within the required time frame. It can be combined with any piece of the ancestral robes set to turn it into the corresponding piece of twisted ancestral robes .

Once attached, the robes become untradeable, but the kit can be detached from the twisted ancestral robe pieces, returning both items.

The time frame required to be eligible for a chance at a twisted kit scales with the number of players in the raid.
24672:
Haemalchemy volume 2 is a book found in a bookshelf within the laboratories beneath Meiyerditch during Sins of the Father. It is given to Safalaan.

Haemalchemy, when broken down by definition, is the study of transmuting or modifying blood.

While the exact contents of the book are a mystery, it it known that it details how blisterwood can be used to create weapons that are deadly to vampyres.
24673:
A vyre noble top (unscented) is a piece of a vyre noble disguise which has not been scented with the blood of a vyre noble. It is obtained by giving Polmafi Ferdygris a vyrewatch outfit during Sins of the Father . After obtaining it from Polmafi, it can be found in a chest within the Myreque Hideout .

It must be brought during the fight with Damien Leucurte in order for it to become a vyre noble top .
24674:
Vyre noble legs (unscented) are a piece of a vyre noble disguise which has not been scented with the blood of a vyre noble. It is obtained by giving Polmafi Ferdygris a vyrewatch outfit during Sins of the Father . After obtaining it from Polmafi, it can be found in a chest within the Myreque Hideout .

It must be brought during the fight with Damien Leucurte in order for it to become vyre noble legs .
24675:
Vyre noble shoes (unscented) are a piece of a vyre noble disguise which has not been scented with the blood of a vyre noble. It is obtained by giving Polmafi Ferdygris a vyrewatch outfit during Sins of the Father . After obtaining it from Polmafi, it can be found in a chest within the Myreque Hideout .

It must be brought during the fight with Damien Leucurte in order for it to become vyre noble shoes .
24676:
A vyre noble top is a piece of vyre noble clothing that has been scented with the blood of Damien Leucurte , a vyre noble. The top is made by first buying a vyrewatch top , having it upgraded by Polmafi Ferdygris , and then killing Damien Leucurte while holding it to cover it in his scent. After Sins of the Father , it can be reclaimed from the chest in the Myreque Hideout under Old Man Ral's house.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Vyre Noble outfit . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
24678:
Vyre noble legs are a piece of vyre noble clothing that has been scented with the blood of Damien Leucurte , a vyre noble. The legs are made by first buying a pair of vyrewatch legs , having them upgraded by Polmafi Ferdygris , and then killing Damien Leucurte while holding them to cover it in his scent. After Sins of the Father , they can be reclaimed from the chest in the Myreque Hideout under Old Man Ral's house.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Vyre Noble outfit . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
24680:
Vyre noble shoes are a piece of vyre noble clothing that has been scented with the blood of Damien Leucurte , a vyre noble. The shoes are made by first buying a pair of vyrewatch shoes , having them upgraded by Polmafi Ferdygris , and then killing Damien Leucurte while holding them to cover it in his scent. After Sins of the Father , they can be reclaimed from the chest in the Myreque Hideout under Old Man Ral's house.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Vyre Noble outfit . Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.
24682:
An old note is a note obtained during Sins of the Father , from fallen shelves within the Arboretum , which instructs the player on how to give water to the Blisterwood Tree .

The note itself is a note from one Vampyre Sentinel to another, providing basic instructions on the water needed to cut the tree and collect sap. The amount of gallons of water required to make the tree healthy is unique to each player and is found from this note.
24684:
The tatty note is found by searching the skeleton in the northern part of the Meiyerditch Laboratories, where the ruins that lead to the true Blood Altar is found.

The note itself is written by Minas, a miner (presumably a slave) who was assigned to excavate the caves in the laboratories, and was eventually killed by his fellow miner, Jovan, in a fit of madness after he came into contact with a blood talisman in the ruins leading to the Blood Altar.

Jovan's skeleton, which can be found inside the Blood Altar, can be examined, which states A message carved into the ground next to it reads: 'Minas, I'm sorry.', suggesting he regained his senses before dying inside the altar.
24686: The journal page is obtained by searching the mud mound north of the Icyene graveyard with a spade, which yields the journal page and an ancient armour.
24688: Ancient armour is obtained by searching the mud mound north of the Icyene graveyard with a spade, which yields an ancient armour and a journal page. It has no use.
24690:
The tome of experience is received from Ivan Strom on completion of the Sins of the Father quest . Reading it opens a window to select the skill a player wishes to advance. The player must be at least level 60 in their chosen skill. In the event this item is lost or destroyed, players may reclaim this item from Ivan Strom in Old Man Ral 's house in Meiyerditch . After progressing far enough into The Blood Moon Rises , it is reclaimed from Old Man Ral instead.

It has six chapters which provide 15,000 experience each. After confirming, the player receives the message " You read a fascinating chapter and earn experience! You have been awarded 15,000 (skill) experience! " After the sixth reading, the book disappears and the player receives the message " The book crumbles into a dust cloud of knowledge. "

This item cannot be banked. If your inventory is full, he will hold the tome for you until you clear some space and talk to him again.
24691:
Blisterwood logs are logs which can be cut from the blisterwood tree inside the Darkmeyer Arboretum , requiring 62 Woodcutting to chop and granting 76 experience per log. To access the Arboretum, players must progress through the Sins of the Father quest until Desmodus Lasiurus's slaves have been returned.

Blisterwood logs are used in the Sins of the Father quest for the creation of the blisterwood flail , and in The Blood Moon Rises quest for the creation of the hallowed flail and blisterwood stakes . At level 62 Firemaking , blisterwood logs can be burned on the ground for 96 experience per log, or in an abyssal lantern (requiring 6 logs), to increase blood rune yield by 20% when runecrafting.

Occasionally when chopping the blisterwood tree , a message in the chatbox will state A small spider jumps at you from the log you just cut. This interrupts the woodcutting process and causes players to go idle. Players who have not progressed too far in The Blood Moon Rises may find it more convenient to take logs from a crate in Sugadinti's Hideout , which contains an unlimited amount of logs and can fill an inventory instantly.
24693:
The ruby sickle (b) is an item obtained by using a ruby on a silver sickle (b) during Sins of the Father . It can be enchanted into an enchanted ruby sickle (b) by casting Lvl-3 Enchant on it.

The sickle has a right-click "bloom" option which can be used next to rotten logs, branches, or bushes in Mort Myre swamp to obtain Mort myre fungi , stems , and pears . These items can be used to fill the Druid pouch which allows the player to fight Ghasts . Bloom can also be cast on dead vines in the Ancient Guthixian Temple to grow them into flowering vines which can be picked to obtain a vine flower .

It can also be used to harm Vampyres and Vampyre Juvinates , but this is not recommended due to its weak stats.
24695:
The enchanted ruby sickle (b) is an item obtained by using a ruby on a silver sickle (b) , then casting Lvl-3 Enchant on the resulting ruby sickle (b) . It is to be used on blisterwood logs to create a blisterwood sickle , which is then used to create the blisterwood flail .

The sickle has a right-click "bloom" option which can be used next to rotten logs, branches, or bushes in Mort Myre swamp to obtain Mort myre fungi , stems , and pears . These items can be used to fill the Druid pouch which allows the player to fight Ghasts . Bloom can also be cast on dead vines in the Ancient Guthixian Temple to grow them into flowering vines which can be picked to obtain a vine flower .

It can also be used to harm Vampyres and Vampyre Juvinates , but this is not recommended due to its weak stats.
24697:
The blisterwood sickle is an item obtained by using a ruby on a silver sickle (b) , casting Lvl-3 Enchant on the resulting ruby sickle (b) , and then using blisterwood logs on the enchanted ruby sickle (b) . It is used on the Ivandis flail to create the blisterwood flail . It requires an Attack level of 50 to wield.

The sickle has a right-click "bloom" option which can be used next to rotten logs, branches, or bushes in Mort Myre swamp to obtain Mort myre fungi , stems , and pears . These items can be used to fill the Druid pouch which allows the player to fight Ghasts . Bloom can also be cast on dead vines in the Ancient Guthixian Temple to grow them into flowering vines which can be picked to obtain a vine flower .

It has a 15% damage and 5% accuracy bonus against vampyres . [ 1 ]
24699:
The blisterwood flail is a one-handed staff created during the Sins of the Father quest by combining a blisterwood sickle with the Ivandis flail . Should the flail be lost before quest completion, it can be reclaimed from Veliaf Hurtz in the Icyene Graveyard for 40,000 coins. After quest completion, it is sold by Ivan Strom in Meiyerditch. It is a silver weapon and can deal full damage to vampyres of all tiers.

This flail requires an Attack level of 50 to wield, and gives a 25% damage and 5% accuracy bonus against vampyres . [ 1 ] Though it can autocast spells, it is outclassed as a high-prayer bonus magic weapon by any crozier , and no spells are capable of dealing damage to vampyres.

The flail is also effective in damaging the vyrewatch and vyrewatch sentinels , due to the flail being incredibly unpredictable and random, which allows the player to circumvent the vyrewatch's ability to predict an opponent's moves through mind reading, and thus dodge regular weapon attacks. [ 2 ] The blisterwood further enhances the flail due to the bark continuing to grow unpredictably even after the logs are processed, [ 3 ] in addition to the sap being poisonous to vampyres. [ 4 ]

The blisterwood flail retains the ability to cast Bloom from the Ivandis flail and any of the blessed sickle varieties used to create the Blisterwood sickle . This multiplicity of use lets a player kill ghasts , vampyre juvinates , and vyrewatch with a single weapon, making it highly useful for Temple Trekking .

During The Blood Moon Rises , a blisterwood flail is used to create the Hallowed flail .
24701:
The giant squirrel is a skilling pet that can be obtained after completion of an Agility course, as well as from tagging marked ticket dispensers within the Brimhaven Agility Arena.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat), it will be placed into their inventory. When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne.

On death, if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.
24703:
A coin pouch is an item obtained from pickpocketing certain NPCs, which contains several coins depending on the NPC it was obtained from. To obtain the coins from them, players can simply click their stack of coin pouches to open them all at once, or they can right-click them to open one at a time. They cannot be traded or banked.

Up to 28 coin pouches can stack in a player's inventory, after which the player must open them to collect the coins inside before being able to pickpocket more. This limit can be increased by completing the Ardougne Diary, where it increases to 56, 84, and 140 after completing the Medium, Hard, and Elite diaries, respectively.

Coin pouches have different variants depending on who the player pickpocketed it from; for example, a coin pouch from pickpocketing guards does not stack with pouches from pickpocketing Ardougne knights. NPCs who are pickpocketed via blackjacking yield coins directly while they are knocked out instead of coin pouches. If rogue equipment is used to receive double the loot from pickpocketing, only one coin pouch is obtained (containing the normal amount) while the other half is obtained directly as coins.
24704:
Daeyalt essence is an untradeable type of essence used in Runecraft. It is obtained in the daeyalt essence mine by trading daeyalt shards with Noranna Tytanin, who can be found near the exit in the north-east area of the mine. Each daeyalt shard trades for a single daeyalt essence, and all essence is sent directly to the player's bank (except in the case of UIMs, who can only trade for as much essence as their inventory can currently hold).

If The Blood Moon Rises is not progressed to the final fight with Drakan, then Vyre noble clothing must be worn to trade in the shards for daeyalt essence. Mining the daeyalt shards requires level 60 Mining and completion of Sins of the Father.

Daeyalt essence acts the same way as regular essence does, being able to be stored in essence pouches. However, it gives 50% extra experience per essence. This bonus is multiplicative with the 70% bonus at the Ourania Altar, for a total bonus of 155% extra experience. Above 90 Runecrafting one can expect to average roughly 23 experience per Daeyalt essence at the Ourania altar. Daeyalt essence cannot be used in place of dark essence fragments at Kourend's Blood and Soul Altars.

Using a mixture of daeyalt essence and pure essence in the same runecrafting trip will result in the daeyalt essence being used first and a second craft-runes action on the altar is required to then craft using the pure essence. Because of this, Achievement Diary tasks will fail unless you only use one type of essence.
24706:
Daeyalt shards are magical shards that can be mined from daeyalt essence rocks at the daeyalt essence mine beneath Darkmeyer. Requiring level 60 Mining and completion of the quest Sins of the Father to access, players can only mine the active daeyalt essence, which can be recognised as the one surrounded by sparkles. The number of shards received per action varies between 2 and 3, averaging 2.5, and always granting 5 experience. Mining enhancers do not increase the amount of shards received.

Daeyalt shards can be converted to daeyalt essence by trading Noranna Tytanin in the mine for an equal amount. Any essence received is sent to the bank. To trade in the shards for daeyalt essence, players must be wearing vyre noble clothing unless they have completed Blood Moon Rises.

The tier of pickaxe used affects the rate at which shards are mined, however Mining level does not. With moderate concentration and a dragon pickaxe, around 4,000 shards can be mined per hour. With high concentration and tick manipulation players can reach up to 8,000 shards mined per hour.
24709:
Hallowed crystal shards are items used to teleport to the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby from any place where teleports are allowed. They can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 1 hallowed mark. 5 of them are obtained for free upon first talking with the Mysterious Stranger in the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby.

In addition to being a convenient way to return to the Hallowed Sepulchre, Hallowed crystal shards are notable for being one of the closest teleports to a bank in the game.
24711:
Hallowed marks are the reward currency gained by looting coffins within the Hallowed Sepulchre in Darkmeyer. These can be used at the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop.

Hallowed marks were the currency of Hallowvale during the Second Age and early Third Age. During The Blood Moon Rises, it is revealed that the marks are made out of pure silvthrill.

If used to purchase Hallowed sacks, the only reward with tradeable outputs, they are worth approximately 939.56.

A similar item is obtained and used during The Blood Moon Rises. The stackable currency cannot be used in place of the quest variant.
24719:
Hallowed token is an item used to add an extra minute of time during a Hallowed Sepulchre run, it is consumed upon use. If a player wants to add the extra minute to the run, the token needs to be activated before the timer runs out. It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 10 hallowed marks. You may use more than one token per attempt at the Sepulchre.

Attempting to activate the token while outside of the Hallowed Sepulchre will result in the message: "The Hallowed token can only be used inside the Hallowed Sepulchre minigame." Attempting to activate the token when the timer has expired will result in the message: "The Hallowed token is unresponsive as you have run out of time."

Up to 1000 Hallowed tokens can be stored in the Hallowed Sepulchre Equipment Storage run by the Mysterious Stranger.
24721:
Hallowed grapple is an item that has a 100% chance of succeeding a grapple shortcut inside the Hallowed Sepulchre. It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks. The grapple only works inside the Hallowed Sepulchre and cannot be used elsewhere.

The grapple also counts as a Saradomin item for the purposes of recharging your run energy at the Magical Obelisks at the end of each floor, as well as in God Wars Dungeon.

The Hallowed grapple can be stored in the Hallowed Sepulchre Equipment Storage run by the Mysterious Stranger.
24723:
The Hallowed focus is an item that will give a 100% chance to succeed at conjuring Portal Frames inside the Hallowed Sepulchre and will slightly speed up enchanting the portal when equipped. It also causes the player to use the lowest level enchantment spell available instead of the highest. It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks.

The focus also counts as a Saradomin item for the purposes of recharging your run energy at the Magical Obelisks at the end of each floor, as well as in God Wars Dungeon.

Despite its resemblance to a lantern, the Hallowed focus does not act as a light source.

The Hallowed focus can be stored in the Hallowed Sepulchre Equipment Storage run by the Mysterious Stranger.
24725:
Hallowed symbol is an item that reduces the number of sacrificed vampyre dust and speeds up the rate at which the player can pass through the Prayer barrier when passing the Saradomin Brazier skilling challenge inside the Hallowed Sepulchre. It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks.

With the necklace equipped, sacrificing at the Saradomin Braziers will only take one vampyre dust instead of two, and you will move through the barrier at a rate of 4 ticks instead of 5.

The necklace also counts as a Saradomin item for the purposes of recharging your run energy at the Magical Obelisks at the end of each floor, as well as in God Wars Dungeon. Additionally, the necklace can be used in place of a holy symbol when using the prayer book.

The Hallowed symbol can be stored in the Hallowed Sepulchre Equipment Storage run by the Mysterious Stranger.
24727:
The hallowed hammer is an item that will never break nails inside the Hallowed Sepulchre (regardless of the plank and nail combination used). It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks. Unlike the other hallowed equipment, the hammer does not need to be equipped in order for its effect to work.

The hallowed hammer cannot be used in place of a normal hammer outside the Hallowed Sepulchre. The hammer also counts as a Saradomin item for the purposes of recharging your run energy at the Magical Obelisks at the end of each floor, as well as in God Wars Dungeon.

The Hallowed hammer can be stored in the Hallowed Sepulchre Equipment Storage run by the Mysterious Stranger.
24729:
Dark dye allows one piece of the graceful outfit to be recoloured to a black and red variant. Six are needed to recolour the full graceful set, as the dye is consumed with one use.

It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 300 hallowed marks.
24731:
Hallowed ring is a reward from the Hallowed Sepulchre. It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 250 hallowed marks. When equipped, it negates all damage taken from failing environmental obstacles like the knight statues' swords and the crossbowman statues' bolts, and reduces the recovery time by teleporting the player back to the start of the obstacle should they fail. It has no effect on the recovery time for failing the grapple pillars and does not negate damage taken for failing to enchant portal frames.

The ring also counts as a Saradomin item for the purposes of recharging your run energy at the Magical Obelisks at the end of each floor and as a follower item in God Wars Dungeon.

The Hallowed ring can be stored in the Hallowed Sepulchre Equipment Storage run by the Mysterious Stranger.
24733:
A dark acorn is a Hallowed Sepulchre reward that recolours the giant squirrel pet into a black and red variant. It is purchased from the Mysterious Stranger's Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 3,000 hallowed marks.

Using it on a giant squirrel will allow it to metamorphose into a dark squirrel.
24735:
The Ring of endurance (uncharged) is a discontinued item that was released with Sins of the Father. Like the real Ring of endurance, it could originally be obtained as a reward from the Hallowed Sepulchre.

For unknown reasons, a new Ring of endurance (uncharged) was added to the game a week after release. The original ring was discontinued, and was made untradeable. This briefly led to a glitch where players who had the original ring were unable to trade it.

The ring has an "Activate" option, which presumably converts it into the new ring. It may still exist ingame for any players who have not converted it into the new ring yet, making it a rare example of a discontinued item in Old School RuneScape.
24736:
The ring of endurance is a potential reward from the Grand Hallowed Coffin on the final floor of the Hallowed Sepulchre and requires level 70 in the Agility skill to equip. The ring can be charged with stamina potions and stamina mixes, with each dose granting one charge, as well as extended stamina potions which grant two charges per dose. Storing a maximum of 1,000 charges, it costs 969,000 to fully charge using stamina potion(4) or 987,500 to fully charge using extended stamina potion(4). The ring counts as a Saradomin item within the Hallowed Sepulchre and the God Wars Dungeon.

The ring provides two effects when charged:

First, if the player consumes a dose of a stamina potion, extended stamina potion, or stamina mix with the ring equipped, then the effects of the potion are doubled along with its duration (a stamina potion will consume 1 charge and grant 40% run energy and a buff lasting 4 minutes instead of 20%/2 minutes, while an extended stamina potion will consume 2 charges and grant 80% run energy and a buff lasting 8 minutes instead of 40%/4 minutes). This effect is immediately halved if the ring is unequipped. (Note that despite the Stamina Boost option on the Agility cape providing the effect of a stamina potion it will not have its duration doubled, nor will it consume any charges.)

Second, if the ring has 500 charges or more, it will passively reduce the run energy drain rate by 15% without using any charges. The passive effect does not stack with the stamina potion effect on drain rate (which alone provides a 70% reduction).

All of the stamina charges will not be refunded upon uncharging the ring. Charges on the ring are not lost upon death.
24738:
The strange old lockpick is a potential reward from the Hallowed Sepulchre. It can be used to open any set of doors within the Barrows. It comes with 50 charges, which deplete when used to open a set of doors. The lockpick is only tradeable when fully charged. After all 50 charges have been used it disappears. When running low on charges, the High Level Alchemy spell can be used to recoup some of the costs, since its value stays high even when used.

The strange old lockpick provides a better success rate for opening coffins within the Hallowed Sepulchre compared to a normal lockpick. Additionally this lockpick will speed up looting coffins compared to having a normal lockpick or no lockpick. It does not use any charges when used in the Hallowed Sepulchre.

Despite being an improved variant of a lockpick within the Hallowed Sepulchre, it cannot be used in place of a regular lockpick outside of the Hallowed Sepulchre.
24740:

24743:
The Hallowed graceful hood is one of many variants of the graceful hood . It is recoloured by using dark dye on it, purchasable from the Mysterious Stranger in the Hallowed Sepulchre for 300 hallowed marks .

Strange hallowed tome is an item that can be found by investigating a skeleton in the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby. There are five total pages, with each page being unique to one of the five levels of the sepulchre. Page 1 comes with the book, while pages 2 through 6 come from floors 1 through 5 respectively. Coffins have a 1/10 chance to contain the page unique to that floor, [ 1 ] and the player cannot receive a duplicate page while they still have another copy of that page. Pages added to the hallowed tome cannot be received again and the tome will still contain all added pages even if it is lost and reobtained.

Blood pint is a type of ale that temporarily boosts Attack and Strength by 4% + 2 while draining Magic and Prayer by 4% + 2 when drunk (see table below). Unlike other ales, it cannot be made through brewing .

The blood shard is a drop from vyrewatch sentinels, venators, and from pickpocketing vampyres in Darkmeyer. The blood shard can be added to an amulet of fury, making it an amulet of blood fury. This amulet has the same stats as a regular amulet of fury, but grants a 20% chance of healing 30% of the damage dealt to a target when using melee, resulting in a 6% lifesteal on average. A blood shard provides the amulet with 10,000 charges, losing one for every successful hit. Once the amulet reaches 0 charges the blood shard is destroyed, but the amulet of fury remains.

The effect of the rogue equipment does apply to this item when pickpocketing; the player will have a chance to receive two Blood Shards if they are wearing parts of the outfit, with it guaranteed if the full set is worn. While pickpocketing with a full inventory, both Blood Shards will drop to the floor.

When killed by another player and the amulet of blood fury is not one of the items protected on death, the amulet is converted to a normal amulet of fury; the blood shard and any remaining charges are lost.

24844:
The ring of endurance is a potential reward from the Grand Hallowed Coffin on the final floor of the Hallowed Sepulchre and requires level 70 in the Agility skill to equip. The ring can be charged with stamina potions and stamina mixes, with each dose granting one charge, as well as extended stamina potions which grant two charges per dose. Storing a maximum of 1,000 charges, it costs 969,000 to fully charge using stamina potion(4) or 987,500 to fully charge using extended stamina potion(4). The ring counts as a Saradomin item within the Hallowed Sepulchre and the God Wars Dungeon.

The ring provides two effects when charged:

First, if the player consumes a dose of a stamina potion, extended stamina potion, or stamina mix with the ring equipped, then the effects of the potion are doubled along with its duration (a stamina potion will consume 1 charge and grant 40% run energy and a buff lasting 4 minutes instead of 20%/2 minutes, while an extended stamina potion will consume 2 charges and grant 80% run energy and a buff lasting 8 minutes instead of 40%/4 minutes). This effect is immediately halved if the ring is unequipped. (Note that despite the Stamina Boost option on the Agility cape providing the effect of a stamina potion it will not have its duration doubled, nor will it consume any charges.)

Second, if the ring has 500 charges or more, it will passively reduce the run energy drain rate by 15% without using any charges. The passive effect does not stack with the stamina potion effect on drain rate (which alone provides a 70% reduction).

All of the stamina charges will not be refunded upon uncharging the ring. Charges on the ring are not lost upon death.
24847:
Rocky is a skilling pet that can be obtained when training the Thieving skill. This includes stealing from stalls, pickpocketing from NPCs, picking fruit in the Sorceress's Garden , and looting grand gold chests within Pyramid Plunder . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Thieving level, and the person/object the player is stealing from.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

On death , if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.

Soft clay pack is an item pack containing 100 noted soft clay. It is obtainable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop in the Motherlode Mine for 10 golden nuggets, from Belona's Mining Guild Mineral Exchange for 10 unidentified minerals, or from Dusuri's Star Shop for 150 stardust.

When purchasing clay packs, gold nuggets and minerals are worth 1,160, and stardust is worth 77.33.

The packs are exclusive to the stores they are bought from and therefore cannot be sold to another store in exchange for a different currency.
24853:
A bag full of gems is a bag that contains an assortment of 40 noted uncut gems . These bags are obtainable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 40 golden nuggets , from Belona 's Mining Guild Mineral Exchange for 20 unidentified minerals , or from Dusuri's Star Shop for 300 stardust .

The chances of an individual gem being an uncut onyx is 1/100,000,000, making the chance per bag approximately 1/2,500,000. In terms of probability, this makes it one of the rarest drops in the game. [ 1 ]

Obtaining the uncut onyx from a bag full of gems does produce an entry in the Collection Log .

The bags are exclusive to the stores they are bought from and therefore cannot be sold to another store in exchange for a different currency.
24855:
The mythical max cape is the result of combining a mythical cape with a max cape , during which the max hood required to be in the player's inventory will automatically convert to the mythical max hood .

Like the other max cape variants (a max cape combined with another cape slot item), the mythical max cape does not have the max cape's stats or perks; it only acts as a cosmetic upgrade to the mythical cape with the following exceptions when worn:

The max cape and mythical cape can be separated by using a knife on the cape. Mac will also buy back a max cape, along with its variants, for 1,900,800 coins each. He will return the secondary item any max cape variant was combined with upon doing so.

On a PvP death, it is always kept in the inventory, even if not protected. If the player is skulled and has the Protect Item prayer active, both the max cape and their most valuable item will be kept. Otherwise, on death from causes outside of the wilderness, if it is not one of your protected items, it goes to your grave .
24857:
The mythical max hood is a hood created by using a mythical cape on a max cape . When the mythical max cape is created, the max hood is required as well and is automatically converted to the mythical max hood.

If players are refunding the mythical max cape via Mac , the player must also have the mythical max hood in their inventory.

Should players lose the hood, they may reclaim it from Mac for free.

24880:
Amy's saw is an equipable saw that can be bought from the Mahogany Homes Reward Shop for 500 Carpenter points . Unlike the crystal saw , it does not provide any Construction level boost.

The saw is wielded in the weapon slot. Its combat bonuses are comparable to bronze weapons—it falls between a bronze sword and bronze scimitar in offensive bonuses, but its attack speed is slightly slower.

The saw can be wielded in the shield slot by converting it to its off-hand variant via the "Swap" option, exactly the same as the Imcando hammer . This allows the player to wield both tools at the same time, conserving inventory space when using a Shipwrights' Workbench , building furniture in their player-owned house , or during the Mahogany Homes minigame.

It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player's costume room .
24882:
The plank sack is an item that can be bought from the Mahogany Homes Reward Shop for 350 carpenter points . Only one plank sack may be owned at a time.

The sack holds a total of 28 planks of any type, they do not have any weight while inside, and can be used directly from the sack.

Servants never deliver planks into a plank sack when returning from the bank or sawmill , making it a poor option for Construction training in a player-owned house . It is generally useful for Ultimate Ironmen or when doing Mahogany Homes , increasing experience and carpenter points hourly rates, or for saving on banking trips for the Hallowed Sepulchre and Shipbuilding . This is very similar to how the log basket functions.

The plank sack does not need to be manually emptied in order to use its contents - planks can be used directly from the sack.

Players can quickly fill or empty the contents of the sack by right-clicking "Use" on the item whilst the bank interface is open. If there are no planks in the inventory, the contents of the sack will be emptied. If there are planks, it will fill using those in the inventory.
24884: A supply crate is a Mahogany Homes reward obtained from Amy 's Rewards Shop for 25 Carpenter points . It contains various amounts of all kinds of materials used in training Construction . These crates are not intended to turn a profit, but are simply a way to help alleviate some of the costs of Construction.
24885:
The Hosidius blueprints are an item purchased from Amy , leader of the Mahogany Homes , for 2,000 Carpenter points . It can be used to permanently unlock a Hosidius-themed house style .

In order to change the house style, players must redecorate with an Estate agent while having the blueprints in their inventory. When the house style is changed to something else, the blueprints are not returned. However, once unlocked, players may always return to the Hosidius theme for just the 5,000 coin fee.

When inspecting the blueprints, a message in the chatbox will appear, stating These blueprints appear to be a set of instructions for creating the Hosidius player-owned house theme. Perhaps an Estate Agent can make use of these?

Waxwood log is a quest item used only in the Daddy's Home miniquest. During the miniquest, three of them can be found within the crates in Old Man Yarlo's kitchen in Varrock.

It is used to make waxwood planks, a particularly water-resistant type of wood used to build a bed for Old Man Yarlo.

Duplicates cannot be obtained.
24939:
Waxwood planks is a quest item used only in Daddy's Home. It is made by giving waxwood logs to the sawmill operator in the Lumber Yard.

Three waxwood planks are required to build a damp-resistant bed for Old Man Yarlo.

Duplicates cannot be obtained.
24940:
Marlo's crate is a quest item reward in Daddy's Home. It is obtained from Marlo after building all the furniture required for Old Man Yarlo.

If used in Construction the materials hold a potential of 1,545 Construction experience.

This item cannot leave a placeholder. If lost on death, you can reclaim it for free from Marlo.
24941: The bp obj (short for Bank PIN Object) is an unobtainable item added to the game with A Porcine of Interest. It has an appearance identical to an Empty box. It is used internally to store the player's bank PIN, by means of having an object variable set to the value of the PIN.
24942:
Reinforced goggles are a piece of Slayer equipment worn in the head slot. The goggles (or a Slayer helmet) must be worn when fighting sourhogs.

One pair is obtained for free during A Porcine of Interest, but additional pairs can be purchased after the quest from any Slayer Master for 100 coins.
24944:
The sourhog foot is a quest item used only in A Porcine of Interest . It is obtained by using a knife or slash weapon on the Sourhog after killing it.

It is given to Sarah in the Falador Farm to collect the bounty.
24946:
Hallowed sacks are obtainable from Mysterious Hallowed Goods for 100 Hallowed marks. When opened, hallowed sacks give loot found in coffins within the Hallowed Sepulchre.

Each sack gives five rolls from the low-tier loot table, one roll from the mid-tier loot table, and two rolls from the high-tier loot table. The average value of a hallowed sack is 93,956.35.

Mysterious pages and the strange old lockpick are not obtainable from hallowed sacks.

The Moonclan teleport is a magic tablet that can be broken to teleport to the gate to the village on Lunar Isle , providing that they have previously visited Lunar Isle once during Lunar Diplomacy .

Players can create this item on the lunar lectern in the ceremonial building on Lunar Isle with a piece of soft clay , 1 law rune , 2 earth runes , and 2 astral runes , as well as level 69 Magic while being on the Lunar spellbook .

The player does not need to have the relevant Magic level to use the tablet, which shares the same rule with all tablets and the player will not receive any experience , although making the teleport tablet does give 66 experience in Magic.
24951:
The Ourania teleport is a magic tablet that can be broken by players to teleport outside of the Ourania Cave and the Ourania Altar, providing that they have completed Lunar Diplomacy.

Players can create this item on the lunar lectern in the ceremonial building on Lunar Isle with a piece of soft clay, 1 law rune, 6 earth runes, and 2 astral runes, as well as level 71 Magic while being on the Lunar spellbook.

The player does not need to have the relevant Magic level to use the tablet, which shares the same rule with all tablets and the player will not receive any experience, although making the teleport tablet does give 69 experience in Magic. Cabbages are a series of unobtainable items. Presumably, they are used in order to track the status of players being able to purchase exclusive content. However, it is unknown how they are used in this regard.

Two cabbages were added in June 2018, with "Buy" and "Unbuy" versions, with the release of the Purple skin exclusive to Twitch Prime

A cabbage was added in November 2019, to track points earned in the Twisted League, and presumably determining access to the Leagues Reward Shop

Another cabbage was added on 5 December 2019, with the overhaul of the Leagues Reward Shop, tracking "negative points"

Four cabbages were added in October 2020, presumably used during the Trailblazer League

Two cabbages were added in January 2022, presumably used during the Shattered Relics League

The Headless head is a holiday reward received from completing a Halloween event from 2020 onwards.

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room .
24977:
The magical pumpkin is a reward for the 2020 Halloween event . The item is used to plant a pumpkin in a garden or formal garden of a player-owned house using a watering can . Interacting with the magical pumpkin causes the player to take and eat pieces of different coloured candy . After eating the candy, the player will say Ooh piece of candy. . The candy does not provide any boosts, nor does it heal any missing health.

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room . The magical pumpkin can also be retrieved this way if a Halloween event has been completed on a free-to-play account.

24989: Rick's box is an item used during the 2020 Halloween event. It is found under the bed in Rick's room in the Wizards' Tower, accessed via the portal on the 1st floor. A riddle within must be solved to unlock the box and receive Rick's head.
24990:
Rick's head is an item used during the 2020 Halloween event. It is obtained by unlocking Rick's box, and is taken back to Rick.

Upon inspecting Rick's head, the chatbox will state "This head was found in Rick's box. Hopefully it's him."
24991:
Witch's brew was taken from the cauldron of brew at Eve's party during the 2020 Halloween event. Eve requests that the player drink it for her to help with Rick's predicament.

After consuming it, the chatbox states "You drink the witch's brew. It's better than you thought it would be."

Although it is contained in a beer glass, one is not left over after drinking.
24992:
Spider snacks were used during the 2020 Halloween event . It was obtained by searching the barrel of spiders at Eve's party. Players must eat one in order to have Eve help them with Rick's predicament. Despite being edible and described as tasty, they do not heal any hitpoints when eaten.

When eaten, the chatbox will state " You eat the spider snack. It makes you feel surprisingly comfortable. " If the player tries to use the spider snack on a range or fire , the chatbox will state " You can't cook that. "
24993: Incantation is an item used during the 2020 Halloween event. It is given to the player by Eve to restore Rick to normal.

The item allows players to teleport to any fairy ring, spirit tree, or tool leprechaun, providing that the destination is in a region the player has unlocked. It is not subject to Wilderness teleport restrictions, with the exception of spirit tree locations.

25104:
The Crystal of Echoes is an item that is obtainable during the Grid Master community event via the Total Recall relic, rewarded after equipping a unique item from the God Wars Dungeon.

The crystal allows players to teleport to store a single coordinate in the world along with their current hitpoints, prayer, and special attack energy. Any time later, the player may use the crystal to teleport back to the stored coordinates while setting their hitpoints, prayer, and special attack energy back to their initially stored values.

Combat stats outside of the ones explicitly listed above do not get saved by the crystal. There is no cooldown associated with using the crystal and the save state is remembered after death. The crystal cannot store unique special attack energy stats such as those related to the soul reaper axe or sunlight spear. This item ignores wilderness teleport restrictions.

If lost or destroyed, the crystal of echoes can be reclaimed from The Sage.
25106:
The extradimensional bag is a scrapped item intended for use in the Trailblazer League upon unlocking the Second Inventory relic. As the relic gave the player the item, it would have been required to be unlocked in a bank. The relic, and by extension the bag, was scrapped due to some severe bugs found with it late in development and thus is an unobtainable item.

The bag effectively acted as a second inventory with 28 spaces, and can be withdrawn from and deposited into from anywhere. Like the looting bag, it can be opened so that items that are picked up will go straight into the bag.

Items within the bag cannot be used from within; players must have them within their inventory to use them. In addition, storage items such as the herb sack and rune pouch cannot be stored inside the bag.

If the bag was lost, it could be reclaimed from the Leagues Tutor and the contents within would be safe.

The clay head is an item created during the quest Getting Ahead . It is used to attempt to convince Gordon that players have killed the Headless Beast . However, he will not believe them, and players must use bear fur , grey wolf fur , or Fur on it (while having a needle and thread ) to create the fur head to try convincing him again.

When created, the player performs an emote with a knife and soft clay in hands.

The player can only have one clay head at a time. Attempting to create another with a clay head in the player's inventory results in the chatbox stating "You already have a clay head." If the player banks the clay head and crafts another one in the inventory, the clay head stored in the bank is destroyed. After mounting a bloody head to the Mounted Head Space in Gordon and Mary's house, the clay head (and other fake head variants) are destroyed and can no longer be created again.

The clay head is destroyed upon death . If lost during the quest, the player needs to create another.

This item cannot leave a placeholder in the bank.

The Slayer helmet (i) , requiring a Defence level of 10 to wear, is a piece of equipment that is worn in the helmet slot. It provides the bonuses of multiple pieces of protective and beneficial Slayer equipment. It functions in the same manner as its unimbued variant (with the 16.67% Melee bonus), except that it also provides an extra 15% boost to Ranged accuracy and Ranged damage, and a 15% boost to Magic accuracy and Magic damage, against monsters assigned as the player's Slayer task.

It has defensive bonuses equivalent to the rune full helm , with the exception of providing +11 higher relative magic defence (+10 vs. -1) as well as positive Magic and Ranged attack bonuses. It will prevent infection from Nex 's virus attack, and can be used as warm clothing for Wintertodt .

Players can imbue the Slayer helmet using either 1,250,000 Nightmare Zone reward points (625,000 when the hard tier of Combat Achievements are complete), 500 Soul Wars Zeal Tokens , or by using a scroll of imbuing purchased from the Emir's Arena . The scroll can be used on the black mask before assembling the Slayer helmet or on the Slayer helmet itself.

If an imbued Slayer helmet is disassembled, then it will return an imbued black mask, along with the other components. The black mask (i) can be uncharged to return (depending on the original imbuing method) the scroll of imbuing, or a full refund of the Nightmare Zone reward points or Soul Wars zeal tokens used to purchase it.

For players with undead Slayer tasks , the boosts given by the Salve amulet or Salve amulet (e) do not stack with the effects of a Slayer helmet (i), and the amulet's boosts will take priority over the helmet's.

25193:
The granite ring (i) is an imbued version of the regular granite ring from the Nightmare Zone and Soul Wars minigames . It requires 50 Defence and 50 Strength to equip. The imbue upgrade costs either 500,000 Nightmare Zone points or 250,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , 200 Zeal Tokens , or by using a scroll of imbuing purchased from the Emir's Arena .

The upgrade doubles all defensive bonuses, including the negative Magic defence bonus.

If not protected, dying to another player will cause the imbued ring to lose its imbued status, but the player will be reimbursed the Nightmare Zone points , Zeal Tokens or Scroll of imbuing to re-imbue it via the aforementioned methods. Dying to a monster will not remove its imbued effect.

On the other hand, if its wearer dies to a monster, the ring will retain its imbued status even if dropped on death .
25195:
A blue cape is a cosmetic cape worn by players during a game of Soul Wars , as well as the minigame's tutorial. The cape, alongside a blue icon , are automatically equipped by players in the blue team upon the start of a game, and cannot be unequipped. Attempting to remove the cape will display the message You can't remove your cape while playing Soul Wars. When a game of Soul Wars ends or the player leaves the tutorial, both the cape and icon are removed from the player.

Nomad can upgrade the player's Soul Wars capes with ammunition saving effects when Ava's devices (or their max cape variants) are used on him.
25196:
Soul fragments are obtained as drops from Forgotten Souls during a game of Soul Wars . They can also be obtained by killing players who possess them. Players can give souls to team members with the use option.

The fragments are used on the Soul Obelisk to reduce the damage reduction percentage of the Avatar of Creation and Destruction . The team who controls the Soul Obelisk will have each soul fragment reduce the Avatar's damage reduction percentage by one, while the team that does not have control will find that sacrificing soul fragments at the Soul Obelisk will only be worth one-third of the contribution.
25197:
The Soul Wars guide is a book given by Nomad at the start of the Soul Wars minigame after the player has finished the tutorial. It contains basic information about the minigame.

The Soul Wars guide is destroyed upon death . If players lose the book, they can reclaim it from Nomad.

This book can be stored in a player-owned house bookcase .
25199:
Bones are acquired in the Soul Wars minigame as drops from enemy players. They look just like normal bones , but have a different examine text and a destroy option instead of drop .

The bones are buried at a graveyard to increase the percentage of their Avatar's damage reduction. If the bones are buried in a graveyard in which the team that does not have control over, it will only be worth one-third of the contribution. Players can also give the bones to a teammate by using it on them, providing the teammate has turned on Accept Aid .

Players that die in Soul Wars will drop one set of bones, plus all of the bones and soul fragments in their inventory.

When a game of Soul Wars ends, all gameplay items obtained are removed.

Burying the bones does not grant Prayer experience.

25202:
Bandages are a healing item that can only be obtained in Soul Wars . After the game has ended, or if the player left the game early, all bandages in a player's inventory will disappear.

Bandages are found on the table in the start room. They restore 1 + 15% of a player's hitpoints (rounded down) and 100% of a player's run energy. They have the ability to cure poison and venom effects. They do not cure corruption . It is possible to use bandages on other players to heal them.
25203:
A potion of power is a potion exclusive to Soul Wars , obtained from the table of potions of power at the player's base. The potion combines the effects of a super combat , super ranging , super magic , and super restore potion. Unlike most potions, the potions of power cannot be combined with one another.

When a game of Soul Wars ends, all gameplay items in the player's inventory are removed, including the potion of power. All boosts acquired from drinking it are removed as well.

Drinking a potion of power increases your activity in Soul Wars by 9%.

A barricade is an item used in the Soul Wars minigame as portable obstacles to restrict enemy movement.

The barricades have a set-up option that places the item on the ground below the player, turning it into an attackable object with 50 hitpoints . Each team in the minigame can have a maximum of 10 barricades set up. If the limit is reached, players on that team cannot set up more barricades unless some of the previously set up barricades are destroyed.

Players cannot walk through placed barricades, and must destroy it by attacking it or using an explosive potion on it.

If you have reached your barricade limit, a message in your chat box will inform you so. They cannot be poisoned .

25244:
The dark key is a key that can be obtained by looting the chest in the Isle of Souls Dungeon . Doing so requires level 28 Thieving , and the chances to pick the lock can be increased by having a lockpick .

The key is used to open Dark Chests , which can be found in the basement of the Crumbling Tower , on the north side of the Isle of Souls .
25246:
The ring of suffering (i) is an upgraded version of the regular ring of suffering . It can be imbued as a reward from the Nightmare Zone , costing 725,000 reward points or 362,500 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , at Soul Wars for 300 Zeal Tokens , or by using a scroll of imbuing purchased from Emir's Arena for 200 points. Its stats are double those of the ring of suffering.

The ring can also be charged with rings of recoil to give it the recoil effect, renaming the item to ring of suffering (ri) . Each ring of recoil provides 40 charges, assuming the ring of recoil has not been drained prior. A maximum of 100,000 charges can be stored, equivalent to 2,500 rings, at a cost of 2,350,000 coins . Players can configure the charges while the ring is in their bank by right-clicking on Configure-Charges, as long as players have the required materials. If a player uncharged the ring, the recoil rings stored will not be refunded. The ring of recoil effect is toggle-able, so players may disable it as to not waste it during training and instead use it in activities such as fighting Zulrah , or in PvP combat, where the effect may prove more useful. Charges are not lost upon death.

If not protected, dying to another player will cause the imbued ring to lose its imbued status, however the player will be reimbursed the Nightmare Zone points , Zeal Tokens or Scroll of imbuing to re-imbue it via the aforementioned methods. Dying to a monster will not remove its imbued effect.

If not protected, dying to another player will cause the imbued ring to lose its imbued status, however the player will be reimbursed the Nightmare Zone points , Zeal Tokens or Scroll of imbuing to re-imbue it via the aforementioned methods. Dying to a monster will not remove its imbued effect.
25250:
The Salve amulet (i) is the imbued form of the salve amulet , granting an additional 16.67% [ 1 ] increase in the wearer's ranged accuracy and damage, as well as a 15% increase for magic , when fighting undead monsters .

The salve amulet is imbued by using either 800,000 Nightmare Zone points (halved upon completing the hard combat achievements ), 320 Soul Wars Zeal Tokens , or by using a scroll of imbuing on the amulet. Amulets imbued through the latter two methods do not count for completing the Ardougne Diary task. [ 2 ] Furthermore, amulets imbued at one location cannot be refunded at a different location.
25252:
The ring of the gods (i) is an upgraded version of the regular ring of the gods . It is imbued as a reward from the Nightmare Zone , costing 650,000 reward points or 325,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , at Soul Wars for 260 Zeal Tokens , or by using a scroll of imbuing purchased from the Emir's Arena . Imbuing the ring also requires having a holy wrench in the inventory, though it does not consume it. The Prayer cape does not act as a substitute for imbuing the ring.

The imbued version incorporates the holy wrench's benefit of increasing prayer points restored from some prayer potions when it is equipped, and also provides an extra +4 prayer bonus compared to the regular version. The increased prayer restoration effect of the ring of the gods, Prayer cape and holy wrench do not stack . Unlike the Prayer cape and holy wrench, ring of the gods (i) must be worn to activate the prayer restoration effect and does not work when in the player's inventory.

The Salve amulet(ei) is the enchanted and imbued form of the salve amulet , granting a 20% increase in the wearer's accuracy and damage for melee , ranged , and magic when fighting undead monsters .

The salve amulet's bonuses against the undead do not stack with the black mask and slayer helmet's on-task bonuses; wearing both will only apply the bonuses of the salve amulet (ei). The salve amulet also does not have an effect on the dwarf multicannon 's accuracy. [ 1 ] However, the bonuses of Void Knight equipment do stack with the salve amulet. Additionally, the amulet's effects apply to all targets when using multi-hitting melee weapons in a multicombat area , such as the Scythe of Vitur and the special attack of the dragon 2h sword , but not for multi-hitting magic and ranged attacks (ex. chinchompas and burst spells ).
25280:
Essence packs are an unobtainable item which contain 100 pure essence when opened. There are two variants of this item, the first being a generic item pack intended to be purchased with coins , and the second intended to be purchased with stardust via Dusuri's Star Shop .

Essence packs were offered as a purchasable item from Dusuri's Star Shop in the Shooting Stars poll , though it only received 73.4% support, 1.6% short of the votes required to pass. As the developer creating Shooting Stars was unaware of the first version's existence, a second version of the item was created and subsequently removed from the shop after the item failed to pass the poll, which is why two variants of the item exist.
25282:
The sled is an item originally obtained during the 2020 Christmas event , in Scrubfoot's cave beneath Goblin Village . It is used to slide down the slope to the area where green and red fireflies can be found.

The sled is only useable in this instance; if a player attempts to ride the sled anywhere else, the chatbox will state "You cannot use that here!"
25283:
Red fireflies are an item from the 2020 Christmas event . They were obtained by catching red fireflies in the cave below the Goblin Village . Along with green fireflies , they were given to the goblin generals during the event.

If lost, the item could be reobtained by catching one again before completing the event.
25284:

If lost, the item could be reobtained by catching one again before completing the event.
25285: The stick is an item obtained during the 2020 Christmas event . It is used to move the goblin's sacred boulder into Goblin Village to be used as a substitute for a traditional Christmas tree.
25286: Mouldy sawdust is an item obtained during the 2020 Christmas event , found in the Goblin Cook 's kitchen. Along with rotten meat and stale bread , it is one of three ingredients used to create goblin stew .
25287: Rotten meat is an item obtained during the 2020 Christmas event , found in the Goblin Cook 's kitchen. Along with mouldy sawdust and stale bread , it is one of three ingredients used to create goblin stew .
25288: Stale bread is an item obtained during the 2020 Christmas event , found in the Goblin Cook 's kitchen. Along with mouldy sawdust and rotten meat , it is one of three ingredients used to create goblin stew .
25289:
Goblin stew was made during the 2020 Christmas event using mouldy sawdust, rotten meat, and stale bread in the cauldron in the Goblin Cook's kitchen. It is given to the goblin generals of Goblin Village.

Attempting to eat it causes the player to say: "I wouldn't eat that even if I got paid for it."
25290:
Goblin gifts is an item obtained during the 2020 Christmas event. It is obtained by searching the treasure chest for suitable items in the south-westernmost building in Goblin Village, and is given to the goblin generals.

If lost, the item may be reobtained by searching the treasure chest again.
25314:
The giant boulder is a holiday reward received from completing a Christmas event from 2020 onwards. When equipped, players will be given a unique animation of them struggling to carry the boulder.

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room .
25316:
Goblin decorations are a holiday reward received from completing a Christmas event from 2020 onwards. The item is used on furniture that can be built in the pool , fireplace (needs to be a stone fireplace or marble fireplace ; using goblin decorations on a clay fireplace results in the message, "Only ordinary logs can be used to light the fireplace"), curtains , and spirit tree spaces within a player-owned house .

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room .

If lost, or if not received due to completing the Christmas event as a free-to-play player, the item can be reclaimed from Diango in Draynor Village.

A gnome child icon can be built in the icon space of the chapel in a player-owned house , aligning the player's chapel toward the gnome child . It requires 45 Construction to build and gives 100 experience when built. Notably, this is less than the usual 60 experience per oak plank other furniture rewards, implying that the Gnome child icon item provides a negative 80 experience. The player must have a hammer and a saw in their inventory to build it.

Unlike other icons, the icon can be read, which displays a poem:

Note : If players remove the icon, they will not receive the icon back. It must be reclaimed from Diango or a toy box .

Because the Gnome Child cannot be picked up normally, the follower item is not intended to be received by players, but is used as a failsafe measure in the event that the Gnome Child follower is forced into the player's backpack.

25340:
The Ectoplasmator is a reward from the Soul Wars minigame. Requiring 40 Prayer, it can be purchased from Nomad on the Isle of Souls for 250 Zeal Tokens.

It has a similar effect to the bonecrusher and ash sanctifier, yielding Prayer experience upon killing spectral creatures, equal to 20% of the monster's max health rounded down. Unlike the bonecrusher or ash sanctifier, the ectoplasmator does not need to be charged for this effect to take place. This does not restore prayer points in the Catacombs of Kourend, as the Catacombs only grant prayer points for bones.

The ectoplasmator stacks with the bonecrusher when killing a spectral monster that also drops bones, like ankou. This item cannot be taken into Soul Wars.
25342:
The spoils of war is a reward from the Soul Wars Minigame . It can be purchased from Nomad on the Isle of Souls for 30 Zeal Tokens .

Despite not containing any weapons or armour, spoils of war can't be opened on the main island of Entrana . They can, however, be taken through the law rift in the Abyss or through the mysterious ruins to the Law Altar and opened there.
25344:
A soul cape is a cape obtained from the Soul Wars minigame , costing 2,500 Zeal Tokens to purchase from the reward shop. It requires level 70 Prayer to purchase and equip, and offers the highest Prayer bonus in the cape slot . It is visually identical to the capes that are given to players upon entering a round in the Soul Wars minigame, however, the capes inside the minigame do not have any bonuses.

It is worth noting that even though the capes act as Ava's Devices in the minigame after showing any variety Ava's device to Nomad , the reward cape does not have this effect throughout Gielinor.

Players can right-click "Toggle-colour" to switch between the cape's two colours.

This item can be stored in the cape rack of a costume room .

If the player dies (including in PvP) and the cape is unprotected, it will be sent to the gravestone .

The Lil' Creator is a pet obtained from spoils of war in Soul Wars . It is a much smaller version of the Avatar of Creation . Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between Lil' Creator and Lil' Destructor, which is a smaller version of the Avatar of Destruction .

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

On death , if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.

A swampbark body is a piece of swampbark armour worn in the body slot , requiring level 50 Magic and 50 Defence to equip. The body can be made with level 48 Runecraft by bringing a splitbark body and 500 nature runes to the Nature Altar . Doing so requires players to have first learnt the secret to infuse the armour via reading the runescroll of swampbark .

In addition to their stats, the helm, body, and legs increases the duration of bind spells by 2 ticks (1.2 seconds), with the full set increasing the duration by 6 ticks (3.6 seconds). For comparison, Ice Barrage binds players for 32 ticks (19.2 secs).

It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Urium remains are an item found and used in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . To obtain these remains, the player must kill urium shades , located behind a solid gold door in the Shade Catacombs .

To burn the urium remains, first place redwood pyre logs or rosewood pyre logs on a funeral pyre , followed by the urium remains, then light the pyre with a tinderbox . This will grant the player 500 Firemaking experience for redwood pyre logs and 590 Firemaking experience for rosewood pyre logs (750 and 885 respectively with elite Morytania Diary complete) and 120.5 Prayer (180.7 with hard Morytania Diary complete) experience. Neither the pyromancer outfit nor zealot's robes give any of their effects when burning shade remains.

Urium remains will always reward the player with either a gold shade key or some coins . Gold keys give unrestricted access to all areas of the Shade Catacombs and open the gold chests in the urium area of the catacombs, which give the best rewards out of all the chests.

Coins and keys dropped by cremating these remains will not despawn for five minutes, and cannot be taken by other players during this time. When dropped by the player, they will despawn and become visible to others at the normal rate.
25422:
Bleached bones are an untradeable drop from Undead Zealots . They can be offered at the Altar of the Damned to recharge a player's prayer points to full like a regular altar.

Players can bury bleached bones for 4.5 Prayer experience. Unlike long and curved bones , there is no warning that prevents the players from accidentally burying the bones. Alternatively, players can turn bleached bones into bonemeal at the Ectofuntus . Bleached bones cannot be used on the Exposed altar in The Teomat . Bleached bones can be given to a dog and they will happily gnaw on them.

The key may be used to enter the Shade Catacombs and then open the correctly coloured chest. It will open a gold-framed chest with a red lock . This type of key can be used to open any door within the tombs, giving the player unrestricted access to all areas.

Unlike most items, this key will not despawn and cannot be taken by other players for 5 minutes when initially dropped from shade remains, similar to other keys from the Shades of Mort'ton minigame. When dropped by the player, they will despawn and become visible to others at the normal rate.

The zealot's robe top is a piece of the Zealot's robes set that can be obtained from looting gold chests within the Shade Catacombs .

The robe top grants a 1.25% chance to prevent various remains from being consumed whilst training Prayer ; wearing the full set will increase this chance to 5%, and stacks with the bone-saving effect of the altar in the Chaos Temple . However, this does not apply at the Forthos Dungeon 's Sacred Bone Burner , nor when casting Sinister Offering .

This item can be stored in the magic wardrobe of a costume room , as part of the Zealot's robes set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

The robe top grants one less prayer bonus than the easy-to-obtain Proselyte hauberk , but may be preferable as it does not have any negative attack bonuses .

The silver coffin is an item that can store up to 20 shade remains of any different type. It is obtained by bringing silver locks and a broken coffin to Dampe by the entrance to the Shade Catacombs. Shade remains cannot be burnt directly from the coffin and must be removed prior to constructing the pyre.

The coffin has several right-click options available:

Fill - Stores all shade remains in the player's inventory into the coffin, providing there is space inside.

Configure - Gives three options for the player:

Check Shade Count - Informs the player of how many shade remains are inside the coffin.

Open/Close Coffin - Opens the coffin, which will have shade remains that the player picks up be automatically placed inside the coffin, providing there is space for it. Closing the coffin will instead have shade remains placed into the inventory when picked up.

Remove lock - Prompts the player if they really want to remove the lock, and warns that any shade remains stored will be lost.

Empty - Empties remains from the coffin into the player's inventory, with highest-tier remains being withdrawn first.

The tree wizards' journal is a journal obtained from chests within the Shade Catacombs . Higher tier chests give a higher chance of obtaining the journal, as well as wearing a ring of wealth . Opening the journal for the first time gives players a runescroll of swampbark , which can be read to unlock the ability to create swampbark armour .

When the journal is first opened, a message in the chatbox will state " As you open the ancient notes, a rough scroll falls out. " After having read the book once, the player will from now on receive the accompanying scroll as a reward from the chest whenever otherwise a book would have been obtained.

Written by a Zarosian warlock named Xazyd Wier , who lived during the early years of the Third Age , the journal describes their experiences with a great hollow tree after the fall of Kharyrll .

The journal can be retrieved from the bookcase in a player-owned house .

When the notes are first opened, a message in the chatbox will state " As you open the ancient notes, a rough scroll falls out. " After having read the book once, the player will from now on receive the accompanying scroll as a reward from the chest whenever otherwise a book would have been obtained.

Written by Otrava prior to her conversion to Zamorak during the early years of the Third Age , the journal describes her experiences with a great hollow tree near the ruins of Flamtaer whom she referred to as the Chatter Tree.

The notes can be retrieved from the bookcase in a player-owned house .
25478: The runescroll of swampbark is a scroll obtained from chests within the Shade Catacombs . Higher tier chests give a higher chance of obtaining the item, as well as wearing a ring of wealth . Reading the scroll unlocks the ability to craft swampbark armour from splitbark armour .
25481: The runescroll of bloodbark is a scroll obtained from chests within the Shade Catacombs . Higher tier chests give a higher chance of obtaining the scroll, as well as wearing a ring of wealth . Reading the scroll unlocks the ability to craft bloodbark armour from splitbark armour .
25484:
The soulreaper axe is a two-handed axe requiring level 80 in Attack and Strength to wield. It is available to use on a beta world as part of the DT2 Rewards Beta , where players can playtest it in various content before a poll is brought forward to ask players whether they'd like it to be implemented in the live game as a reward from completing the quest Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire .

The axe will damage players for 8 hitpoints for every hit they do, and gains a "Mighty Stack" in the process. Each Mighty Stack gives the player a +6% boost to their Strength level (additive with prayer bonuses), and players can gain up to 5 Mighty Stacks; players will stop taking damage from subsequent attacks if they have 5 Mighty Stacks. In addition, players will lose a Mighty Stack if they have not attacked for 10 ticks (6 seconds).

The axe also has a right-click "Check" option, but this currently only yields the chatbox message Nothing interesting happens.

Dharok's platebody from Last Man Standing is a minigame-exclusive variant of the normal Dharok's platebody. It can be obtained (along with the rest of the set) from opening the chests with a bloody key or bloodier key, or looting the crates that spawn at random locations on the map. It can be looted from other players as it always drops on death. It is only available inside the minigame and does not degrade.

As it is part of Dharok's barrows set, if Dharok's platebody is worn along with all of the other pieces of equipment in Dharok's barrows set, the player gains a special effect. Attacks do more damage as the player's hitpoints decrease, up to 98.9% bonus damage with 1 hitpoint remaining with 99 max.

In the minigame, the set is highly valued as it can deliver devastating damage to unsuspecting opponents not using Protect from Melee. However, it requires players to stay at low health, making it risky to use effectively. It also makes players vulnerable to magical attacks, since the full set is required for the effect and it provides negative magical defence. If a player does not wish to use the effect, the platelegs and platebody are still useful pieces of equipment.

For more details on the mechanics and strategies for this equipment, see the set page.

The TzRek-Jad (translated as Baby Fire Elemental ) is a pet that can be obtained via defeating TzTok-Jad in the TzHaar Fight Cave . It is a much smaller version of TzTok-Jad . Players are twice as likely to receive the pet upon defeating TzTok-Jad if they are assigned to defeat it on a Slayer task. In addition, players may exchange their fire capes by speaking to TzHaar-Mej-Jal for a 1/200 chance of obtaining TzRek-Jad. Provided a player defeats TzTok-Jad while on a Slayer task for a 1/100 chance of the pet and hands in their cape, the overall chance of receiving the pet from either the boss or the cape is approximately 1/67.

Players who have completed all six of TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between the TzRek-Jad and JalRek-Jad, which is a smaller version of JalTok-Jad . Attempting to change the pet's appearance before completing the challenges will result in the chatbox stating " You must have completed TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges to do that. "

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

On death , if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.

Stardust can be mined during the Shooting Stars activity. It is used as currency in Dusuri's Star Shop or to add charges to the celestial ring and celestial signet .

The amount of Mining experience per stardust is 32, with free-to-play worlds awarding half experience.

The first person to attempt to mine a crashed star will be notified in the chatbox that they are the first to find the star, alongside a jingle. This person will also receive double the stardust for the next 300 they mine as a reward, regardless of which star they mine. Players will not receive bonus XP for the bonus stardust. If players are not the required level to mine a new star, simply prospecting it will give the bonus, even if no mining is done or the player does not have a pickaxe. Also note that this bonus does not stack (caps at 300 bonus dust).

Free-to-play players may acquire stardust, but will not be able to use them as Dusuri's Star Shop is only available to members.

If the player dies (including in PvP), any unprotected stardust will be sent to the gravestone .
