32876: An aquanite tendon is an item obtained from aquanites found within the Ynysdail Cavern . Players with level 60 Smithing can create the aquanite hopper by using the tendon on an anvil with a mithril bar and hammer in the inventory, granting 350 experience.
32879:
The aquanite hopper is a ranged offhand requiring level 60 Ranged to equip. It is created by using an aquanite tendon on an anvil whilst having a mithril bar and hammer in the player's inventory, requiring level 60 Smithing and granting 350 experience.

The hopper is a purely offensive shield slot item with no defensive bonuses, but possesses a passive effect in which crossbows are given an 11% chance [ 1 ] to fire a second shot when the hopper is equipped. This second shot has 33.3% reduced accuracy , 66.7% reduced damage, and 66.7% reduced enchanted bolt proc chance; if the first shot procs an enchanted bolt effect, the second shot will never do so.
32882: Reef snake gland is the venom gland of a reef snake .
32886:
A chain is an item used to link two cannonballs together to create two chainshot cannonballs for boat combat . These require the same Smithing level, and gives the added bonus of halving a target's movement speed for 8 ticks (4.8s).

They are created at an anvil with one steel bar , requiring level 34 Smithing and granting 37.5 experience.

Aside from making chainshot cannonballs, they are used to create the Ivandis flail by linking the enchanted emerald sickle (b) and the rod of Ivandis together.

Chains can be freely obtained from a crate in the old Myreque Hideout under Old Man Ral's house during A Taste of Hope . After the quest, it can be obtained again from the same place, but the player can only collect one at a time without performing the drop trick .
32889: A lead bar is a metal bar used in shipbuilding , as well as certain island amenities . It can be created through the Smithing skill at level 25 by using two lead ore on a furnace , granting 15.5 Smithing experience.
32892:
A cupronickel bar is a metal bar used in shipbuilding , as well as certain island amenities . It can be smelted at level 74 Smithing by using 2 copper ore and 1 nickel ore on a furnace or by using the Superheat Item spell from the standard spell book.

When attempting to make cupronickel bars at the Blast Furnace , up to 14 nickel ore can be deposited at a time. As a result, players should deposit 18 copper ore and 9 nickel ore each run, withdrawing the bars once every three runs for a total of 27 bars per withdraw.
32895:
A coin pouch is an item obtained from pickpocketing certain NPCs, which contains several coins depending on the NPC it was obtained from. To obtain the coins from them, players can simply click their stack of coin pouches to open them all at once, or they can right-click them to open one at a time. They cannot be traded or banked.

Up to 28 coin pouches can stack in a player's inventory, after which the player must open them to collect the coins inside before being able to pickpocket more. This limit can be increased by completing the Ardougne Diary, where it increases to 56, 84, and 140 after completing the Medium, Hard, and Elite diaries, respectively.

Coin pouches have different variants depending on who the player pickpocketed it from; for example, a coin pouch from pickpocketing guards does not stack with pouches from pickpocketing Ardougne knights. NPCs who are pickpocketed via blackjacking yield coins directly while they are knocked out instead of coin pouches. If rogue equipment is used to receive double the loot from pickpocketing, only one coin pouch is obtained (containing the normal amount) while the other half is obtained directly as coins.
32902:
Jatoba logs are logs, which can be cut from jatoba trees using the Woodcutting skill and are primarily used during the Troubled Tortugans quest. Cutting jatoba logs from a jatoba tree requires an axe and level 40 Woodcutting , granting 92 Woodcutting experience per log. They give 120 Firemaking experience when burnt.

Jatoba logs cannot be fletched, attempting to do so gives the message The material properties of the wood are unsuitable for use in bows or ammo. .
32904:
Camphor logs are logs, which can be cut from camphor trees, requiring 66 Woodcutting to chop and grants 143.5 Woodcutting experience per log. Their primary purpose is to be converted into camphor planks at a sawmill, costing 2,500 coins each, planks which are extensively used for boat upgrades and amenities in the Sailing skill. Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes.

Players can also burn these logs with the Firemaking skill for 180 experience at level 66 or above.

Camphor trees are only located on the Great Conch, which requires partial completion of Troubled Tortugans. Players with level 66 Farming can also farm them by planting a camphor sapling at a hardwood tree patch.
32907:
Ironwood logs are logs which can be cut from ironwood trees , requiring 80 Woodcutting to chop and grants 175 Woodcutting experience per log. Players can burn these logs with the Firemaking skill for 220.5 experience at level 80 or above.

Players training Construction can bring ironwood logs to a sawmill to get a ironwood plank at a cost of 5,000 coins each. Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes .

Ironwood trees are only located on Sunbleak Island , which requires 72 Sailing to dock at. Players with level 80 Farming can also farm them by planting an ironwood sapling at a hardwood tree patch .
32910:
Rosewood logs are logs which can be cut from rosewood trees , requiring 92 Woodcutting to chop and grants 212.5 Woodcutting experience per log. Players can burn these logs with the Firemaking skill for 268 experience at level 92 or above.

Players training Construction can bring rosewood logs to a sawmill to get a rosewood plank at a cost of 7,500 coins each. Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes .

Rosewood trees are only located on Drumstick Isle , which requires level 79 Sailing to dock at. Players with level 92 Farming can also farm them by planting a rosewood sapling at a hardwood tree patch .

Because Drumstick Isle is far from a bank, having a greater teleport focus is recommended to chop large quantities, although this can be rather costly and/or even more time-consuming to obtain. Without the greater teleport focus, using the Prifddinas dock and sailing north to the teal portal is the fastest way to get to the isle. A log basket is recommended to extend trip lengths, and if intending to make planks out of the logs, a plank sack with runes and coins for Plank Make , as well as sawmill vouchers is a further optimisation.
32921: The jar of feathers is a rare untradeable drop from the Shellbane Gryphon that can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the boss.
32924:
A crate of arrowtips is an item that may be obtained from a ledger table after taking on a courier task , which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their boat and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the cargo hold before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a crewmate assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit. After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.

32926: Serving platter is an item used in the 2025 Christmas event . During the event, the player can place drinks on the platter, including beer , dwarven stout , cider , wine , milk, chocolate milk, and eggnog . The player can also place food from crates in the basement of the Blue Moon Inn . The main courses include chicken, beef, jubbly, nut roast, mushroom wellington, and trout. Side dishes include potatoes, sprouts, cauliflower, broccoli, cabbage, peas, parsnips, carrots, and stuffing.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a crewmate assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit. After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.

33002:
Holy moleys are a cosmetic variant of the holy sandals, made by combining a pair of holy sandals and mole slippers via Wyson the gardener. Like the holy sandals, they require 31 prayer to wear. To combine them, players must use either item on him, which will initiate a confirmation message to combine them.

As a variant of the holy sandals, holy moleys retain the same properties, such as combat stats and counting as a Saradominist item in relevant content (ex. God Wars Dungeon and Bandit Camp). However, holy moleys cannot be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room.

While the holy moleys are untradeable, they can be reverted anytime via the "Dismantle" option, returning both items after the player confirms they wish to do so. Additionally, upon a PvP death, the killer will receive the holy sandals and mole slippers as loot.

Holy moleys count as warm clothing when subduing the Wintertodt.
33004:
Kharidian quest lamp is a lamp used to complete the Kharidian storyline, up to and including Beneath Cursed Sands . It can be purchased from the skull shop in the Deadman: Annihilation event for 1,500 skull points, or from the Emblem Trader in the Bounty Hunter Shop on the permanent Deadman mode server for 2,000,000 archaic points.

Rubbing the lamp gives the message You rub the lamp and complete the Desert quest storyline, up to Beneath Cursed Sands! Check the Quest List to see your new unlocks.

Myreque quest lamp is a lamp used to complete the Myreque storyline, up to and including A Night at the Theatre. It can be purchased from the skull shop in the Deadman: Annihilation event for 1000 skull points, or from the Emblem Trader in the Bounty Hunter Shop on the permanent Deadman mode server for 2,000,000 archaic points.

It does not complete Sins of the Father.

Rubbing the lamp gives the message You rub the lamp and complete the Myreque quest storyline, up to Night at the Theatre! Check the Quest List to see your new unlocks.

The Ruinous powers is an item purchased from the skull shop in Deadman: Annihilation for 5,000 Skull points.

The item allows players to alternate between the standard prayer book and the Ruinous Powers prayer book. Unlike the version of the item from the Trailblazer Reloaded League , it cannot be equipped.

If lost, it cannot be reclaimed for free; you must spend another 5,000 points to get another. However, it is not necessary to do so, as you can freely switch prayer books via the Deadman's skull once you've purchased the item without needing to keep it.

The Annihilation weapon scroll can be used to cosmetically change the toxic staff of the dead, Bow of Faerdhinen (c), or all three pieces of crystal armour. It can be purchased from the Deadman Reward Store for 12,000 Deadman Points, which are earned from participating in seasonal Deadman events.

The scroll can be used by bringing it to Nigel. When you give the scroll to Nigel, it will permanently unlock the 5 cosmetics for the player and remove the scroll permanently. You can then freely switch any of the items between their standard and deadman variant at Nigel, and it can be applied to however many of the item you wish.

Crystal equipment reverted from the Deadman variant will be reset to the default colours of the item; the Meilyr clan colours for the armour, and the Hefin clan colours for the bow.

The thunder khopesh is a weapon that requires 60 Attack to wield. It can be obtained from looting Deadman's chests .

It has a passive effect that grants standard, successful hits a 20% chance to summon a delayed lightning bolt at the target's location, damaging enemies in a 3x3 area for up to 50% of the player's max hit. The lightning bolt will be summoned at the centre of the target's location at the time the effect was triggered.

The lightning does not roll accuracy checks, but it is possible for enemies to move out of the effect between the attack triggering and the attack striking, causing them to avoid the damage entirely. No experience is gained from the damage dealt by the lightning bolts.

It is a corpbane weapon, meaning it does full damage to the Corporeal Beast .

In Deadman: Annihilation , it only requires 10,000,000 coins to charge instead of 50,000,000.

Gary is an item that may be placed into the player's inventory when Gary is following them during the 25th Anniversary event . Dropping it will cause him to follow the player, much like a pet does.

Because he cannot be picked up normally, the follower item is not intended to be received by players, but is used as a failsafe measure in the event that the Gary follower is forced into the player's backpack.
33089:
The bottomless milk bucket is dropped by Brutus, the repeatable post-quest boss of The Ides of Milk quest. It can be used to hold up to 10,000 uses of a variety of milks and milk-related products, albeit one at a time:

If a player has multiple bottomless milk buckets, each bucket can hold a different type of milk. These can be used in quests such as Cook's Assistant, Gertrude's Cat, Skippy and the Mogres, and Plague City; a single charge will be used from the bottomless milk bucket rather than emptying it entirely. However, a bottomless milk bucket filled with chocolatey milk cannot be drunk to replenish health, and a bottomless milk bucket filled with milk cannot be used in place of a regular bucket of milk to build a pet feeder. The bottomless bucket also cannot be used on a regular bucket to decant milk despite being able to use a regular bucket of milk on a bottomless bucket to add charges to it. Similarly, the bottomless milk bucket can not be used in the Gnome Restaurant Minigame to create orders. The bottomless bucket cannot be consolidated with the contents of another bottomless bucket.

It is possible to fill the bottomless milk bucket directly from a dairy cow by milking the cow while having the bottomless milk bucket in inventory, however it is not possible to milk a dairy buffalo with the bottomless milk bucket. The process is automatic, requiring the player to only click once to start milking, after which one charge is added to the bucket every 7 ticks, or 6 ticks if wearing the cowbell amulet, until the bucket is full or the player is logged out due to inactivity. Filling the bucket completely takes approximately 11 hours and 40 minutes without the cowbell amulet, and 10 hours while wearing the cowbell amulet.

A bottomless milk bucket filled with milk can be used at a dairy churn to produce cream, butter or cheese. The latter of which has an AFK timer of 7 minutes and grants over 15,000 cooking exp per hour. This is the cooking skilling method with the highest AFK timer.

Unlike the bottomless compost bucket, the bottomless milk bucket is untradeable even when empty. Although the bottomless bucket has a risk value of 100,000, if you die with the bucket in the Wilderness beyond level 20, the player that kills you receives 5,400 coins.

The bottomless milk bucket is a great source of food for growing cats and while collecting spices in Evil Dave's Basement.

The cow slippers are a cosmetic pair of footwear dropped by the post-quest version of Brutus. They have no requirements to wear, and can function as warm clothing when subduing the Wintertodt.

There is a swap option to switch between styles. Only one of the styles is tradeable.

When switching between styles, there is a small chance to swap to the fourth variant, featuring the colour scheme of cows found on the Isle of Souls. The slippers can be swapped once every tick, but multiple pairs of slippers can be swapped within the same tick if clicked in rapid succession – increasing the chance that one pair will swap to the fourth style. There is a chatbox warning when trying to swap away from the fourth style, so spam-clicking the swap option is a safe method.

This item can be stored in the magic wardrobe of a costume room. All variants of the cow slippers can be stored at the same time.

33103:
The cowbell amulet is an item obtained from Gillie Groats upon speaking to her after completion of The Ides of Milk.

Whilst worn, players can milk dairy cows in 6 ticks (3.6s) instead of 7 ticks (4.2s). Additionally, it can teleport players to the Lumbridge cow field when charged with air runes, to a maximum of 1,000 charges; when teleporting with the amulet, one of the nearby cows or cow calves at the destination will say Moo? or M-Moo?, respectively.

Using the "Ring" option on the amulet whilst Brutus has not yet respawned will result in him respawning 13 ticks (7.8s) after the chatbox message appears, in comparison to his natural respawn time of 36 ticks (21.6s). Note that ringing the cowbell amulet too late (ex. a few seconds before he is due to respawn) can result in a longer respawn time.

If lost, it can be re-obtained by talking to Gillie Groats. Multiple amulets can be obtained using the drop trick. Each amulet holds charges independently. The uncharged amulets will stack together in the bank. But any with charges will take a whole bank space each, even if they have the same number of charges as each other.

If kept after death or protected by your gravestone, the amulet keeps its charges. If the amulet is lost, all charges in it will be lost as well.

A raw t-bone steak is an uncooked food dropped by the post-quest version of Brutus. At level 13 Cooking it can be cooked on a fire or cooking range to create a cooked t-bone steak or a burnt t-bone steak.

When eaten, a cooked t-bone steak will restore 9 Hitpoints and provides a +2 Strength boost.
33109:
Cooked t-bone steak is a type of food that restores 9 Hitpoints when eaten, as well as a +2 Strength boost. It can be obtained by cooking raw t-bone steak on a fire or range, granting 90 Cooking experience when successful.

Similarly to karambwans , it is possible to use tick manipulation to cook each raw t-bone steak in one tick rather than the standard speed.
33112: A burnt t-bone steak is the result of accidentally burning a raw t-bone steak while attempting to make a cooked t-bone steak . The burn rate while cooking these will decrease as players reach higher Cooking levels.
33115:
Bull bones are remains dropped by Brutus. Unlike most items, which only have a "Take" option on the ground, the item has a "Bury" option instead, which when selected prompts a confirmation message whether the player wishes to receive 40 Prayer experience. This confirmation message is shared with giant bones, and toggling it off for one of the bones toggles it off for both.

Telekinetic Grab cannot be cast on the bones, and the bonecrusher works to automatically bury them. As they cannot be picked up, they cannot be used for alternative Prayer training methods, such as the gilded altar or the deep Wilderness chaos altar.
33117: A magic lamp is an item obtained as a reward from Gillie Groats after completing The Ides of Milk . It can be used to gain 1,000 experience in any combat skill, including Prayer .
33118:
Abyssal potatoes are obtained by harvesting the growth just north of the fire in the Scar. Harvesting the potato causes the message You harvest an odd looking object. It kind of looks like a potato. to appear. It provides a +1 Strength boost when eaten, with the message You eat the potato. You feel strangely powerful.

Feeding an abyssal potato to Brutus upgrades the fight to its hard version, Demonic Brutus. Obtaining the potato requires completion of Desert Treasure II; defeating the Leviathan alone is insufficient to obtain the potato. This item cannot be put in sacks.
33120:
A perfected quetzal whistle(i) is a teleportation item that takes players to any built Quetzal Transport System landing site. When the teleport function is clicked, it will open the transport interface. It cannot be used beyond level 20 Wilderness . As the imbued form of the perfected quetzal whistle , it has unlimited charges.

The whistle can be obtained by giving a total of 10,000 charges worth of raw hunter meats or quetzal feed to Soar Leader Pitri who can be found up the climbable rope at the Hunters' Guild . In order for Pitri to accept noted meats, you must have them in your inventory, along with the perfected whistle, before using the whistle on them. Speak to them and select "More Options" then "I have more food for the birds", while in possession of a perfected quetzal whistle .

All 10,000 charges do not need to be given at once, and Pitri will inform the player of how many charges worth of items they've given so far with each contribution. Charging any quetzal whistle contributes towards the total charges needed for the imbued version. Once obtained, subsequent imbued whistles can be purchased from Pitri for 50,000 coins each.

The "Rumour" option on the whistle will remind players of their active rumour, e.g. Your current rumour target is a grey chinchompa. You'll need to bring back some of its fur. Cervus was the source of the rumour. .

Quetzal whistles may be used to teleport to any built landing site in the Quetzal Transport System without needing to unlock Renu during Twilight's Promise . There is an option in the game settings to configure whether to open a map or directly teleport you to the guild. The tickbox for this can be found under the Gameplay section.
33122:
Annihilation exit portal blueprints are received when first using the Annihilation blueprints to redecorate a player-owned house to the wilderness theme house style. They are used to construct an Annihilation exit portal, which can be used with any house style.

To use the blueprints, players must build an Annihilation exit portal in the centrepiece space of a garden or formal garden in their player-owned house, requiring 10 iron bars and the Annihilation exit portal blueprints. The player must have a hammer and saw in their inventory to build it. If players only have one exit portal in their house, they will not be able to remove it until a second one is built.

Players will not receive back the blueprints upon removing the portal. However, additional copies can be obtained by speaking to Nigel in Lumbridge.
33124:
Beef is a pet that can be obtained from defeating Brutus.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat), it will be placed into their inventory. When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne.

On death, if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.

Beef has an Interact option, in which the player can choose the options "Moo" and "Emote". The "Moo" option will make Beef (as well as a random nearby cow) say "moo".
33126:
The Groats Principles is a book on husbandry obtained during The Ides of Milk. It can be found by searching the shelves in Seth Groats' house, and is given to Cassius in order to progress through the quest.

It cannot be stored in a bookcase within a player-owned house. Once the quest is completed, all copies of the book (whether in the inventory or bank) are removed.
33128:
Milk samples are samples of bad-tasting milk obtained from Cassius during The Ides of Milk , which the player must drink on two separate occasions. Upon drinking the first sample, the player will take 1 poison damage, but the player will not be poisoned. This will not kill the player if they have only 1 Hitpoint when drinking the sample.

Despite misconceptions, the milk sample is simply just cow milk. [ 1 ] Although Cassius doesn't own any cattle besides his bull Brutus , it is implied in the quest that he was stealing milk from the Groats' cow herd. [ 2 ] Brutus' aggression was disturbing the herd and causing their milk to taste bad, which Cassius says is the unique flavour he was trying to sell. [ 3 ]

33133:
Pristine spider silk is an item dropped by Sarachnis, which can be combined with the herb sack to create a silklined herb sack, which gives an increased storage capacity.

There are no additional level requirements or items needed in order to upgrade the herb sack, and it does not need to be emptied prior to doing so.

Extra sheets of pristine spider silk can be given to Brother Aimeri in exchange for a grubby key. This requires starting the miniquest In Search of Knowledge, by healing him with five pieces of food (must be meat, fish, or vegetables).
33135:
A silklined herb sack is an upgraded variant of the herb sack, made by using a pristine spider silk on it. It will store up to 100 of each of the grimy normal herbs instead of 30, for a total of 1,500 stored. Because of the greatly expanded capacity, it is a useful item for farming herbs. A full herb sack is worth 3,590,500 coins.

It can be manually filled by using the left-click 'Fill' option, which will deposit any grimy herbs from your inventory, unless it is full. It can be opened or closed with the right-click options 'Open' or 'Close' respectively. An open sack will automatically deposit any grimy herbs that are picked up by the player, as well as those harvested from a herb patch and Herbiboars, provided there is space for it. A closed sack will not automatically deposit herbs.

The 'Empty' option deposits herbs into the inventory, starting from the lowest level herb, and with the bank open it will deposit all of the contents into the bank. Using the 'Check' option will list all currently stored herbs within it in the chat box. Using the 'Check' option while the sack is empty will result in the messages You look in your silklined herb sack and see: The silklined herb sack is empty.

The herb sack is useful for killing monsters that often drop valuable herbs, such as chaos druids, flesh crawlers, aberrant spectres, and deviant spectres, since it only takes up one inventory slot. It can also be used when lighting incense burners during open altar house parties, reducing the frequency of banking or unnoting Marrentill at Phials.

Herbs stored within it are not lost upon death, and will stay in the herb sack upon death, unless the player has untoggled this setting. Even if the herb sack is one of the items kept on PvP death, the herbs inside the herb sack are NOT kept on death when killed by a player.

33142:
A ballistic attractor is a boat facility that recovers 60% of any types of cannonballs fired from cannons on the boat. In order to build one, players must read a ballistic attractor schematic , obtained by speaking to Ava in Draynor Manor after completing Animal Magnetism .

The ballistic attractor can be built at specific facility hotspots on the boat, requiring level 50 Sailing and 44 Construction , granting 2141 Construction experience.
33143:
The ballistic attractor schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a ballistic attractor for a boat , which recovers 60% of cannonballs fired.

Players can receive the schematic by speaking to Ava in Draynor Manor after completing Animal Magnetism and Pandemonium . Even though the ballistic attractor requires 50 Sailing to build, there is no Sailing level requirement to claim the schematic.
33144:
A veiled kraken tentacle is an item that is commonly dropped by veiled krakens when on a bounty task asking the player to kill them.

When the player has the required amount to complete the bounty task (which can be re-checked via the captain's log should the player forget), they are brought back to a port master to claim the task's rewards via their "Claim-rewards" option.
33145:
A veiled kraken ink sac is an item that is commonly dropped by veiled krakens when on a bounty task asking the player to kill them.

When the player has obtained one to complete the bounty task, it is brought back to a port master to claim the task's rewards via their "Claim-rewards" option.
33146:
The Scribbled notes can be obtained from the note on a table during the 2026 Easter event, or reclaimed from the Easter Bunny if lost.

Reading the notes shows different hints to help the player find Archibald depending on their progress through the event:

"I heard there is a potion that can make me stronger!" - Search shelves in Apothecary's pharmacy.

"I heard about a guy who sells bendy sticks." - Search stepladder on the 2nd floor of Lowe's Archery Emporium. You will also receive an egg box, for which the code to unlock it is "LOWE".

"I heard the view from up here is the best!" - Search the wall at the very top of the Varrock church. You will go through a cut-scene.

"I heard you can buy shiny, pointy sticks from this guy." - Search the table with weapons on it at Varrock Swordshop.

"I heard about an evil place of worship. Sounds cool!" - Go to the building in south-east Varrock, where the Mage of Zamorak resides and search the chair.

"Bil noun omen." - Anagram for Blue Moon Inn. Search the bed in the easternmost room on the top floor to find a decoy egg box. Click the egg box to receive the next note.

"I heard there is a real king, in a court!" - Go to Varrock Palace and search the eastern suit of armour in King Roald's room.

"I heard there is this massive vault of riches underground." - Go to Varrock west bank and catch Archibald underground, next to the gate.

Return the egg to the Easter Bunny to complete the event.
33147:
Egg box is an item found upon searching the stepladder upstairs in Lowe's Archery Emporium during the 2026 Easter event . The box can be opened using the code LOWE, which updates the scribbled notes with a new clue.

The rotation of each dial is randomised each time the egg box is opened. The four dials can each be configured to one of ten letters:

This results in 10,000 possible letter combinations.

A second version of the egg box is found when searching the bed in the Blue Moon Inn . This version is a decoy egg, and provides updated scribbled notes immediately upon opening.

He may also be used as a substitute for a player to open the doors in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon , similarly to egg and the pet rock .

If destroyed, a replacement can be obtained from Diango in Draynor Village or from the toy box of a costume room .

33218:
The Knapsack is an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League, given to players who picked the Barbarian Gathering relic.

Up to 3 different types of gathered items can be placed in the knapsack, which has a total maximum capacity of 140. The items can be added manually by using them on the knapsack, or if it is open and has space available, they will automatically be stored upon gathering them.

The bag can be closed to stop automatically storing resources, or opened to start doing so, provided it has free space.

Items that can be stored in the knapsack include:

Wood

Fish (both raw and cooked)

Metallic ore, coal and clay

Metal bars

Pure essence

If items are automatically cooked or smelted by Hotfoot, the products go directly into an open knapsack upon gathering them.

Items in the sack can be deleted anywhere in the world by using the "dispose" option, but items may only be taken out by depositing them at a bank, including via the "empty containers" button.

The knapsack can be retrieved from the Leagues Tutor in Yama's Lair if lost.

33221: A barbarian arm is a hidden item which is "given" to players who picked the Barbarian Gathering relic during the Demonic Pacts League , enabling them to cut trees, mine rocks, and fish without the need for the respective tools.
33227:
The Evil eye is an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League, given to players who picked the Evil Eye relic. The Eye allows players to teleport to the entrance of any boss or raid in the combat achievements list.

The eye can be retrieved from the Leagues Tutor in Yama's Lair if lost.
33229:
The transmutation ledger is an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League , given to players who picked the Transmute relic.

The ledger, whether in the inventory or equipped, counts as an infinite source of nature runes . Additionally, players can use items compatible with transmutation spells on the ledger to show a list of what they can turn into.

The ledger is unnecessary to cast the transmutation spells, and the spells can be cast even if greyed-out in the spellbook.
33231:
Soul shards are an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League by players who have picked the Soul Harvest relic, via harvesting any crops (including picking fruit at Tithe Farm or picking herbs in the Chambers of Xeric ), as well as a replacement for bones and demonic ashes when killing any NPC that would otherwise drop them. Soul shards are automatically placed in the inventory providing space is available.

Soul shards can be used as a substitute for rune or pure essence while training Runecraft (including combination and sunfire runes ), as well as blessed bone shards at the Teomat 's libation bowl (requires 30 Prayer ) to earn 550 Prayer XP per 100 shards (before Leagues multipliers); sacrificing soul shards does not require wine ( jugs of blessed wine or blessed sunfire wine ). Soul Shards may also be used on the Blood and Soul Altars in Kourend as a substitute for Dark essence fragments .
33233:
The Map of alacrity is an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League , given to players who picked the Map of Alacrity relic . The map allows players to teleport to select agility shortcuts .

The map can be retrieved from the Leagues Tutor in Yama's Lair if lost.

Underground shortcuts are displayed north of the game map; pan upward to see their locations.
33235:
Clue contracts is an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League , which may be rewarded from opening reward caskets with the Conniving Clues relic.

They can be used to teleport to the location of the current clue step, and are also used in place of the usual items Falo asks for. Each contract can be used for one teleport.
33237:
The butler's bell is an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League , given to players who picked the Butler's Bell relic.

When rung it will summon a Demon butler to work for the player, who gathers and processes resources even while offline. Using the Check-option on the bell gives the status on what the butler is currently working on for the player.
33239:
The flask of fervour is an item obtained during the Demonic Pacts League, given to players who picked the Flask of Fervour relic.

When the Flask is consumed, Hitpoints, prayer points, and special attack energy are fully restored. The player may also use this when their hitpoints reach 0 but has not started the death animation. Over the next 4 ticks (2.4s), three explosions hit all enemies (with some exceptions, see below) within 3 tiles of the player's position at each intervals (follows the player) typeless damage equal to 60% of base Prayer level (30% in PvP). During the active effect, all damage taken is reduced to 0. Venom is cured upon use and sanity is restored to 100%.

The flask has a base cooldown of 3 minutes (300 ticks) which is reduced by 1 tick (0.6s) for each instance of 10 damage dealt in a single hit, meaning that a player who attacks for 40 damage, or deals 2x20 damage reduces the cooldown by 4 ticks (2.4s). Dealing 2x9 damage does not reduce the cooldown. Its own explosion damage also does not reduce the cooldown.

The flask can be retrieved from the Leagues Tutor in Yama's Lair if lost.

33243:
The infernal tecpatl is a two-handed echo weapon that can be obtained from Echo Amoxliatl during the Demonic Pacts League .

The weapon is essentially a mix of the lesser nagua weapons, sharing the same accuracy bonuses as the earthbound tecpatl , sulphur blades , and glacial temotli , and is able to use all three attack styles (stab, slash, and crush). The only differences between it and the three lesser nagua weapons is that it has a slightly better strength bonus (+70 vs +64), a demonbane effect, and a negative prayer bonus.

Each attack lands two independently rolled hits ; the maximum damage of each hit is determined by calculating the combined max hit as normal and dividing it by two. If the combined max hit is odd, one max hit is rounded up while the other is rounded down (e.g., 45 → 22 + 23). Additionally, the infernal tecpatl has 10% demonbane , providing increased accuracy and damage against demons .
33245:
Nature's recurve is a two-handed shortbow that can be obtained from Echo Hespori in the Demonic Pacts League. It can fire up to dragon arrows.

Upon a successful hit with nature's recurve, there is a 50% chance that the player's Hitpoints and Prayer points are restored by 10% of the damage dealt, rounded up. This passive cannot heal players above 99 hitpoints, even if Demonic Pacts related to overhealing are unlocked. Ranged echo hits from pacts will also not trigger the healing passive.
33247:
V's helm is a helmet that can be obtained from the Echo Dagannoth Kings during the Demonic Pacts League .

It acts as an imbued slayer helm and provides a passive effect which grants a 5% chance when the player is hit with 1 or more damage to reduce that damage to 0; when this occurs the player will receive the message V's helmet fills you with energy. and their next special attack within 60 seconds will not cost any special attack energy to perform. This secondary effect has no cooldown, but cannot be stacked (i.e. if a special attack has not yet been used since the first effect activated, the secondary effect is lost). The special attack orb's icon will change to a unique icon while this secondary effect is active ( ).
33249:
The Fang of the Hound is a one-handed echo weapon that can be obtained from Echo Cerberus during the Demonic Pacts League .

Every hit with the Fang of the Hound has a 5% chance to cast Flames of Cerberus at the target, which is a fire spell with a base max hit of 10, and can be increased with elemental weakness and magic strength. When the effect is triggered, the magic damage is dealt without needing to pass a second accuracy check. The effect also benefits from pacts .
33251:
King's barrage is a two-handed crossbow that can be obtained from Echo King Black Dragon during the Demonic Pacts League. It is able to fire bolts up to dragon, and additionally deals full damage to the Corporeal Beast.

The crossbow always shoots 2 bolts at once, dealing damage in two hitsplats, with both hitsplats having their max hit halved. The first bolt counts as a crossbow attack, while the other counts as an ice attack which will always freeze the current target in place for 24 ticks (14.4 seconds). The freeze effect can be toggled on and off with the weapon. The ice attack does not regenerate runes. The crossbow generates both ranged and mage experience.
33253:
The shadowflame quadrant is a one-handed staff that can be obtained from the Echo Thermonuclear smoke devil during the Demonic Pacts League . The staff acts as an infinite source of air, water, earth, and fire runes, and can autocast spells from all spellbooks .

When using elemental spells on the standard spellbook with the quadrant equipped, an additional spell will be fired, dealing 40% of the damage of the first attack. When attacking a monster with an elemental weakness , this weapon will cause the spell to be treated as if the target was weakest to that element. This does not change the originally cast spell, but instead modifies damage and accuracy according to the monster's highest weakness. For example, if a target has a 30% air weakness and the player is casting Water Surge , the quadrant will treat the target as if it had a 30% water weakness instead. This allows the player to benefit from Demonic Pacts that trigger when casting a certain elemental spell, even if their target is not weak to said spell.

It has a melee range of 8 tiles but does not allow for meleeing when equipped.

The lithic sceptre is a one-handed magic powered sceptre that can be obtained from the Echo Grotesque Guardians in the Demonic Pacts League. It is charged with 1 body rune and 3 earth runes per charge, holding up to 10,000 charges when fully charged.

Every time the player attacks with the sceptre, they will gain a "Shatter stack", which can be stacked up to 14. One Shatter stack will be lost every ~30s when out of combat, regardless of if it is equipped or not. Shatter stacks are also lost upon teleporting or entering an instance.

Bosun's workbench is a boat facility that allows an assigned crew member to automatically repair the player's ship when it has taken damage beyond the max heal of the repair kit used. It can be built after reading Bosun's workbench schematic , a quest reward from The Red Reef , in any facility hotspot that supports a salvaging station , although only visible under the "All" options category.

Repairs made using this facility consume repair kits stored in the ship's cargo hold . Just as with manually commanding them to repair, crewmates' Deckhandiness levels ( D ) may randomly provide additional healing between 0 and D −1.

The workbench takes on a different appearance to match the boat's hull .

A Void melee helm is a piece of Void Knight equipment that is obtained as a reward in the Pest Control minigame. It can be bought from a Void Knight for 200 commendation points , although a player must have at least level 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , along with level 22 Prayer to buy and wear one.

The melee helm grants the player a 10% bonus towards melee damage and accuracy when worn with the void knight top , robe and gloves . The void knight mace and void seal are not required for the bonus. It has the same stats as the other two helmets. It is useful for training melee skills but maximum strength gear will be more effective. The void melee helm is the only Void Knight helmet that doesn't have any additional benefit with Elite Void .

If the player dies a PvP death at level 20 Wilderness or below and the item is unprotected, it will remain in the player's inventory; however, the item will be in a broken, unusable state and must be repaired by using it on Perdu and paying him 160,000 coins .

If the player dies a PvP death above level 20 Wilderness and the item is unprotected, it will be converted to coins. To prevent this, a Trouver parchment and a payment of 500,000 coins can be given to Perdu in order to permanently lock the item. The locked item will remain in the player's inventory; however, the item will be in a mangled, unusable state and must be repaired by using it on Perdu and paying him 500,000 coins.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room .

The price is defined as 200,000 coins plus the current guide price of an ancient staff .

If the player dies a PvP death above level 20 Wilderness and the item is unprotected, it will be converted to coins. To prevent this, a Trouver parchment and a payment of 500,000 coins can be given to Perdu in order to permanently lock the item. The locked item will remain in the player's inventory; however, the item will be in a mangled, unusable state and must be repaired by using it on Perdu and paying him 500,000 coins.

It can be purchased from Commander Connad for 375 honour points in all four roles, and one Penance Queen kill. It can be sold back to Connad for 300 honour points in all four roles by using it on him.

Note: It is possible to obtain at any level, but low level players may struggle specifically with the attacker role.

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room.

Blessed Dizana's quiver is an upgraded variant of Dizana's quiver , made by using it on a Shrine of Ralos while having a total of 150,000 sunfire splinters and a Dizana's quiver in the player's inventory. Charging the quiver with sunfire splinters contributes to the required amount of splinters to upgrade.

The blessed quiver permanently gains the effects of Dizana's Sunfire , where an additional +1 Ranged Strength and +10 Ranged accuracy is applied to stored arrows and bolts - essentially acting as a variant of the original with unlimited charges. The upgraded variant also retains its level 75 Ranged requirement to equip.

It can also be combined with the max cape to change its appearance by turning it into Dizana's max cape .

Dizana's max cape is the result of combining blessed Dizana's quiver with a max cape, during which the max hood required to be in the player's inventory will automatically convert to Dizana's max hood.

Like the other max cape variants (a max cape combined with another cape slot item), Dizana's max cape does not have the max cape's stats or perks; it only acts as a cosmetic upgrade to blessed Dizana's quiver with the following exceptions when worn:

It acts as a Cooking cape to allow access to the Cooks' Guild without a chef's hat, golden chef's hat, Varrock armour 3 or 4

It acts as a Crafting cape to allow access to the Crafting Guild without a brown apron or golden apron

It acts as a Runecraft cape to prevent essence pouches from degrading (but does not allow access to runic altars)

It acts as a Firemaking cape to work as a piece of warm clothing

It can be used to perform the Skill Cape emote.

The cape retains the perks of the blessed Dizana's quiver.

The max cape and quiver can be separated by using a knife on the cape. Mac will also buy back a max cape, along with its variants, for 1,900,800 coins each. He will return the secondary item any max cape variant was combined with upon doing so.

33534: The etched araxyte fang is an item created by using a chisel on an araxyte fang. With a Crafting level of 86, it can be combined with a amulet of torture to create the amulet of rancour. 33537:
Garlic cocktails are an item purchasable from a werewolf in the late Lord Myrmel 's home, directly south of the Drakan's medallion Darkmeyer teleport.

As completion of The Blood Moon Rises causes vampyres to be tolerant towards the player, having the cocktail in the inventory causes vyrewatch and vyrewatch sentinels to once again be aggressive to the player; however, it has no effect on other vampyres, such as the Darkmeyer bankers or venators . As such, players can still use the Darkmeyer bank with the cocktail in their inventory, and can drop or store the cocktail in their bank if they wish to lose aggression.
33539:
A bucket of bloodwood sap is an item obtained in Vampyrium by cutting either bloodwood trees or the engorged bloodwood tree , and is used to make seeking arrows .

Buckets of bloodwood sap can be either used on any type of logs that can be fletched into arrow shafts , or directly on any unpoisoned arrows. Using one bucket of sap directly on arrows yields 15 seeking arrows, while using one on logs turns it into sap-treated logs.

Because higher tier logs yields higher quantities of arrow shafts per log, using bloodwood sap on logs and then fletching them into seeking arrow shafts will give a better return for the player's time. For arrows that are already made, players can add feathers to the shafts to create seeking headless arrows , then use it on an existing arrow to "upgrade" it to a seeking arrow.

When attempting to collect buckets of bloodwood sap with a full inventory, the bucket will not be collected and will instead be deleted immediately. Logging out will also cause any buckets and buckets of bloodwood sap sitting under the trees to disappear. Teleporting out, however, does not cause them to disappear.
33541:
A seeking arrow shaft is used in Fletching to make seeking arrows . Seeking arrow shafts can be cut from different types of sap-treated logs by using a knife on them, each tier yielding 5 additional Fletching experience per set of 15 arrow shafts, with better types of logs yielding greater quantities of shafts.

A set of 15 feathers can be attached to sets of 15 arrow shafts, yielding 15 experience and 15 seeking headless arrows . Arrowtips are then attached to the seeking headless arrows to create seeking arrows; they can also be used on fully made arrows to "upgrade" them.
33547:
A seeking headless arrow is used in fletching to make seeking arrows . A set of 15 feathers can be attached to sets of 15 seeking arrow shafts , yielding 15 experience and 15 seeking headless arrows.

Once made, a set of 15 arrowtips can then be attached to them to create seeking arrows; they can also be used on fully made arrows to convert them in sets of 150.

33621:
Leechfin live in the rivers of Vampyrium. Upon completion of The Blood Moon Rises, they can be fished from leechfin fishing spots south of the Ruined Village with a big fishing net and level 78 Fishing, granting 33.2 experience per fish. A fish barrel cannot be used to store leechfin, and Fishing enhancers will not work for fishing leechfin; however, the angler's outfit will provide bonus experience.

Leechfin can be cut with a knife or fletching knife for a 1/3 chance to receive a blood sac, of which 50 can be squeezed to create one vial of blood, in the range of 6–18 vials per hour, depending on the method used and concentration. Cutting the fish interrupts the fishing and reduces experience rates by about 40% when fishing and cutting a full inventory. After initiating the cutting, subsequent leechfins will be automatically cut once per tick (which cannot be sped up), providing 20 Cooking experience each.

Leechfin fishing is a high-intensity method of training Fishing, with rates maxing out at about 131,000 experience per hour. Mechanically, catching leechfin is similar to raw bream fishing in Neypotzli, but provides considerably better experience.
33623:
Blood sacs are obtained from dissecting leechfin fished from leechfin fishing spots, or by killing Venators or the Maggot King within Vampyrium. 50 blood sacs can be squeezed to make a vial of blood with an empty vial in inventory, giving blood sacs an indirect value of 163.88. Making a vial of blood in this way does not complete the Vial of Blood Collection Log slot.

A warning will be given if attempting to squeeze a blood sac without a vial; continuing the attempt results in a game message stating You squeeze a sac. It empties onto the floor.
33625:
Letvek are bait for hunting stymphikes , obtained by catching letvek in box traps with 76 Hunter , or through monster drops on Vampyrium .

At high Hunter levels, upwards of 700 letvek can be caught per hour with 3- tick manipulation , yielding approximately 145,000 experience per hour. With 1-tick trap resetting, 160,000 experience per hour is possible.

Letvek will run away if dropped, but they can be placed on a table. Letvek cannot be stored in the huntsman's kit .
33627:
Dull ancient medals are an item commonly dropped by the Maggot King . When polished in Vampyrium , one of two messages will appear in the chatbox. If the message says The medal releases a trace of ancient magic as it falls apart. , then 8 Prayer points will be restored every 6 ticks for 120 ticks (72s), for a total of 160 prayer points.

However, there is a 3/7 chance the message instead says The medal quivers with magic and breaks apart! , and in addition to the prayer restoration, the player's combat stats will be boosted, up to +20 in Attack , Strength , and Defence , +14 in Ranged , and +11 in Magic . This also inflicts 1 damage to the player. The boosted stats will remain for 4 minutes and 30 seconds, after which the boosted stats will begin to decay naturally.

When the prayer restoration effect ends, a chatbox message stating The prayer restoration blessing dissipates. will appear. For the combat boost, the effect ending is indicated by the message You feel the power start to diffuse.

As long as the player stays in Vampyrium, both effects will carry over upon death. However, they will end immediately upon leaving Vampyrium, either by teleporting or by using the portal at Castle Drakan .

This item is always lost upon death.
33628:
Stymphike tartare is a food dropped by the Maggot King. When eaten, it will heal 26 Hitpoints and poisons for 1 damage. It has a non-standard eat delay of 1 tick, meaning multiple can be consumed in quick succession. Additionally each piece consumed will delay the player's next attack by 4 additional ticks, which is also non-standard compared to the default 3 tick delay.

When leaving Vampyrium with the item present in the inventory, it will turn into rotten stymphike tartare, which can no longer be consumed. As such, if ending a trip at the boss with many stymphike tartare remaining, players may wish to make the trip back to Sangvesti to bank them so that they can be used in a subsequent trip. Attempting to eat one anywhere else however will result in the tartare rotting alongside a chatbox message stating "On closer inspection, it looks like that meat is rotten."
33629:
Rotten stymphike tartare is the result of a stymphike tartare being brought out of Vampyrium whilst it is present in the player's inventory, rendering it inedible.

Players who deposit a stymphike tartare into the bank, then attempt to eat one whilst not in Vampyrium, will result in the tartare rotting alongside a chatbox message stating "On closer inspection, it looks like that meat is rotten."
33631: The crimson kisten is a two-handed spiked weapon requiring level 60 Attack and 85 Strength to wield. Obtained as a rare drop from the Maggot King , the weapon is mainly used for its special attack , dealing high damage against opponents weak to crush attacks.
33634: The elder venator fang is an item dropped by the Maggot King. With a Crafting level of 84, it can be etched using a chisel to produce the tradable etched elder venator fang, which is used to upgrade the necklace of anguish into the necklace of rupture, giving 500 Crafting experience. The etched elder venator fang, despite being tradable, cannot be sacrificed in Death's Coffer.
33636: The etched elder venator fang is an item created by using a chisel on an elder venator fang. With a Crafting level of 84, it can be combined with a necklace of anguish to create the necklace of rupture.
33639:
The necklace of rupture is an upgraded variant of the necklace of anguish requiring 90 Hitpoints to wear. It is made by combining the necklace of anguish with an etched elder venator fang, made from the untradeable elder venator fang drop from the Maggot King.

The necklace of rupture is the best-in-slot ranged necklace, boasting an additional +5 ranged attack, +3 ranged strength, and +1 prayer bonus over the necklace of anguish.
33642:
Maggot marquess is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Maggot King , being a much smaller version of it.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

On death , if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.
33644: Dummy stymphike feather is an unobtainable item. Notably, it is listed on the Grand Exchange and is not a members only item. Unlike the actual stymphike feather , it can be wielded.
33651:
Stymphike feathers are dropped by stymphikes caught using the Hunter skill, as well as from various monsters on Vampyrium.

They may be handed in to the aranei at the Apsul and Virer Hunting Grounds for limited off-task access to venators. Each venator kill requires 30 feathers, costing 2,790 per venator if purchasing from other players.

Stymphike feathers can also be used in place of standard feathers for fletching, when making bolts, darts, and arrows, however they are not able to be used for fly fishing.

Stymphike feathers may be used to pay the aranei scout near the portal to Castle Drakan to move the player's grave near to them, if they had died whilst fighting the Maggot King. Depending on the current prices of stymphike feathers, this may be the most cost-effective way to pay.
33653:
Stymphike carcasses are dropped when hunting stymphikes and have no known uses. It cannot be stored in a meat pouch.

When used on Soar Leader Pitri, they say "I don't know what that thing is, but I don't believe it counts as meat! Get some of the raw meats that the hunters bring back; the birds will eat those."

If attempting to use it on Renu, it will reject it and drop one feather beneath the player's feet, accompanied by a game message stating You generously offer the quetzal your carcass. At the horrific smell, it disgorges a feather.

Attempting to use it on a fire or range yields the message You can't cook that.
33655: Makeshift spears are a tool used to hunt stymphikes in Vampyrium . Players can obtain these in bundles of 10 from the pile of makeshift spears .
33657: Orikalkum gravel is unrefined orikalkum that can be obtained as a drop from venators and the Maggot King . It has no uses other than its high alchemy value.
33659:
Grapevines are an item dropped by venators. They can be picked for roughly 10-15 grapes; Bologa's blessings can be used to pick Zamorak's grapes instead, providing an alternative way to obtain them instead of using grape seeds.

By default, grapevines do not stack in the inventory or bank. However, using them on one another combines them with the message You tie the grapevines together, creating an even longer grapevine..

They can be picked from the inventory while the bank interface is open, which automatically deposits the grapes.
33661: Venator fangs are an item dropped by venators and the Maggot King . These can be traded in for dragon arrowtips at a 1:1 ratio by speaking to the aranei by the aranei shrines in the Apsul or Virer Hunting Grounds , or by choosing their right-click "Trade-teeth" option.
33663: Venator teeth are an item dropped by venators and the Maggot King . These can be traded in for dragon dart tips at a 1:1 ratio by speaking to the aranei by the aranei shrines in the Apsul or Virer Hunting Grounds , or by choosing their right-click "Trade-teeth" option.
33665:
Maggot eggs are obtained by killing the Maggot King and taking eggs from its corpse rather than looting the stomach. There are six variants of maggot eggs, each offering a different chance of hatching into the maggot marquess pet.

When taking into account the drop rate of all six eggs, alongside the pet rate from the eggs, the overall chance of receiving the pet from taking eggs is 1/1,502.4 to receive the pet on a given kill, which is roughly 2.33 times the drop rate from looting the stomach.

Blisterwood stakes are a one-handed ranged weapon that becomes craftable during The Blood Moon Rises , after the player is recommended to do so by Sarei . They are made by using a knife on blisterwood logs , yielding five stakes per set of logs.

Blisterwood stakes can deal full damage to vampyres of all tiers and have an accuracy and damage bonus of 25% against them. Outside of that, they have comparable bonuses to an adamant knife , having the same ranged strength and a +1 bonus over them in ranged accuracy , while also having a longer attack range .

Despite being made of wood, blisterwood stakes benefit from the ammunition recovery benefits granted by Ava's devices .
33718:
The hallowed flail is a one-handed flail created during The Blood Moon Rises. It is constructed using hallowed marks given to the player by Efaritay Hallow, a blisterwood flail, and the blisterwood sickle (e) at an anvil with a hammer in the player's inventory. It is a silver weapon and can deal full damage to vampyres of all tiers. After quest completion, it is sold by Efaritay in Castle Drakan.

This hallowed flail requires an Attack level of 50 to wield, and gives a 25% damage and accuracy bonus against vampyres. Compared to the blisterwood flail, it changes from a staff (with crush and autocast options) to a flail (with only slash options) and a faster attack speed, as well as some minor changes in attack and defense.

In addition to the flail's unpredictability and the blisterwood already present on it, the hallowed flail has been made more efficient at killing vampyres over its predecessors due to the presence of pure silvthrill and its shortened shaft making it less cumbersome to wield.

The hallowed flail retains the ability to cast Bloom from the blisterwood flail. This multiplicity of use lets a player kill ghasts, vampyre juvinates, and vyrewatch with a single weapon, making it highly useful for Temple Trekking. It does not count as a Saradomin item in the God Wars Dungeon.

The poem scroll is an item obtained during The Blood Moon Rises during the escape from the Castle Drakan of Vampyrium , found on a table in the dining hall. The text of the poem provides the times required for solving the grandfather clock puzzle. The hands are set to the directions (North, West) and number of kills (eleven, four) mentioned.

The solution is derived from reading the map and using the locations as shown on the map (Apsul on the right and Virer on the left) to tell you where to input the answers in the poem. It starts in Apsul as mentioned on the first line, so you start on the right (East) clock and change the big hand for the father and the small hand for the son. The first answer is North "The father then went north,", so you input 12 to point it North and use the big hand as it's the father, then the next is four "For he vanquished four prey." so you input 4 and use the small hand as it was the son who vanquished four. It then goes on to say that they met again in Virer, so you move to the left (West) clock and continue. The next answer is eleven "The father killed eleven," so you input 11 on the big hand for it was the father and finally the last answer is west "Then departed to the West." so you input 9 to point it West on the small hand as it was the son who departed.

Rotten diary , titled Mouldy Diary , is an item obtained during the quest The Blood Moon Rises by chopping down one of the darkwood trees in the darkwood tree room on a peninsula south of the main path through the room.

Upon completion of the Sotfa Forest segment of The Blood Moon Rises it cannot be obtained if missed, and cannot be reobtained if dropped. It cannot be stored in or obtained from the bookcase of the player's house .
33796: Amitire leaves are obtained from amitire plants during the quest The Blood Moon Rises . They are used to make amitire stew to help Safalaan Hallow recover.
33797: Amitire stew is made from stew and amitire leaves during the quest The Blood Moon Rises . It is given to Safalaan Hallow to help him recover.
33798:
Hallowed marks are given to the player by Efaritay Hallow during the quest The Blood Moon Rises. They are combined with the blisterwood flail and a blisterwood sickle (e) at an anvil to create the hallowed flail.

The Hallowed marks obtained from the Hallowed Sepulchre cannot be used in their stead, only the quest variant can be used.
33799: The healing potion is an item obtained during the hideout defence section of The Blood Moon Rises . They are used to heal the aranei whenever rubble falls on them.
33800:
The silvthrill ballista is a special two-handed crossbow used during the quest The Blood Moon Rises , when Lowerniel Drakan begins his assault on Sugadinti 's hideout in Vampyrium .

The player uses it to destroy the various portals Drakan summons. It can only fire silvthrill javelins , which are also given to the player during this segment of the quest. No experience (ranged or otherwise) is rewarded with use of the ballista. Both the silvthrill ballista and silvthrill javelins are removed from the player's inventory upon completion of the segment.
33801: The silvthrill javelin is a special type of ranged ammunition used by the silvthrill ballista . The silvthrill javelins and ballista only appear during the quest The Blood Moon Rises , when Lowerniel Drakan begins his assault on the hideout in Vampyrium . Both the silvthrill ballista and silvthrill javelins are removed from the player's inventory upon completion of the segment.
33802:
Mysterious jerky is an item that heals 22 Hitpoints when eaten. It can be found throughout Castle Drakan during The Blood Moon Rises quest.

As with other supplies found in Vampyrium, it cannot be consumed outside of that realm, with attempting to do so resulting in the "Given you're not in a hostile environment where supplies aren't highly limited, you don't see any need to consume something as disgusting as this." chat message.

Consuming the jerky gives the message You eat the mysterious jerky. It tastes better than expected.
33803:
Putrid sticky potion is a potion that can be obtained in Castle Drakan in the The Blood Moon Rises quest . Drinking it restores 20% of the player's run energy per dose, and offers a 70% reduction in run energy depletion for 2 minutes. This is the same effect as a stamina potion . Just like a stamina potion, wearing a charged ring of endurance will double the potion's duration and consume one charge per sip.

As with other supplies found in Vampyrium , it cannot be consumed outside of that realm, with attempting to do so resulting in the " Given you're not in a hostile environment where supplies aren't highly limited, you don't see any need to consume something as disgusting as this. " chat message.

Drinking the potion gives the message You drink the putrid sticky potion. You feel oddly energetic.

It then continues restoring one prayer point every 12 ticks for 8 minutes, a total of 66 prayer points per dose. It has the effects of a combined super restore and prayer regeneration potion .

As with other supplies found in Vampyrium , it cannot be consumed outside of that realm. Attempting to do so will display the message Given you're not in a hostile environment where supplies aren't highly limited, you don't see any need to consume something as disgusting as this.

Drinking the potion gives the message You drink the foul chunky potion. You feel oddly reinvigorated

33811:
Rancid slimy potion is a potion in the quest The Blood Moon Rises .

It is similar to a Saradomin brew in which it can overheal the player for the same amount (115 at 99 Hitpoints ), but drains significantly less stats when consumed; -1 in combat stats each time it is drunk, rather than the fluctuating amount based on the player's combat levels. Each dose temporarily lowers Attack , Strength , Magic , and Ranged by 1 and raises Hitpoints by 15 and Defence by 15% + 2 and by 20% + 2 of their base levels, rounded down. This can boost the player's Hitpoints and Defence above their base level by up to the amount restored.

As with other supplies found in Vampyrium , it cannot be consumed outside of that realm. Attempting to do so results in the message Given you're not in a hostile environment where supplies aren't highly limited, you don't see any need to consume something as disgusting as this.

Drinking the potion displays the message You drink the rancid slimy potion. You feel oddly robust.

A jar of congealed blood is a consumable item that can be obtained in Castle Drakan during the quest The Blood Moon Rises . Eating it will completely restore energy , Hitpoints and Prayer .

Jar of congealed blood is a strong emergency item due to the benefits it provides in one click. It is recommended to use this item as a last resort when hitpoints and prayer are as low as possible to maximise the benefit obtained from it. Dropping this item leads to it being destroyed.

As with other supplies found in Vampyrium , it cannot be consumed outside of that realm, with attempting to do so resulting in the " Given you're not in a hostile environment where supplies aren't highly limited, you don't see any need to consume something as disgusting as this. " chat message.

Eating the congealed blood gives the message You eat the congealed blood. It tastes better than expected and leaves you feeling fully refreshed.
33820:
Smelly kebab is an untradeable food from The Blood Moon Rises quest. It heals 18 Hitpoints when eaten. It is a fast food , a subtype of food that incurs non-standard attack or eating delays when consumed.

As with other supplies found in Vampyrium , it cannot be consumed outside of that realm, with attempting to do so resulting in the " Given you're not in a hostile environment where supplies aren't highly limited, you don't see any need to consume something as disgusting as this. " chat message.

Eating the kebab gives the message You eat the smelly kebab. It tastes... unusual.
33821: Raw impaler meat is an uncooked food dropped by impaler deer. It can also be obtained from a cupboard in Sugadinti's Hideout during The Blood Moon Rises. When cooked, it behaves like normal meat, and can be made into either sinew or cooked meat.
33827:
The ancient sceptre is an upgraded version of the Ancient staff that requires level 70 Magic , 60 Strength , 50 Attack , as well as completion of Secrets of the North to wield. It is made by bringing the untradeable Ancient icon and staff to Eblis . This combination process is irreversible.

The ancient sceptre, like its predecessor, can be used to autocast spells from the Ancient Magicks and standard spellbook . Unlike the ancient staff, the ancient sceptre provides a 10% Magic damage bonus, as well as a passive effect that increases the effects of Ancient Magicks by 10%. This passive effect does not increase the Magic damage bonus.

As a Zarosian item , it will also grant god protection towards Zarosian NPCs in the God Wars Dungeon .

If the player dies a PvP death and the item is unprotected, it is reverted to an ancient staff that is dropped for the killer, and the ancient icon disappears. To prevent this, a Trouver parchment and a payment of 500,000 coins can be given to Perdu in order to permanently lock the item. The locked item will remain in the player's inventory; however, the item will be in a mangled, unusable state and must be repaired by using it on Perdu and paying him 500,000 coins.

A letvek in a bucket can appear in the player's inventory while collecting sap from the engorged bloodwood tree (it does not replace the sap that would have been gained). It can be gently shooed away by clicking the bucket; until this is done, the player can no longer chop the tree.

Despite the chatbox message warning that players should get rid of the letvek in the bucket before it drinks their sap, the letvek will not drink any bucket of bloodwood sap that is present in the inventory; however, players can use one on the letvek in the bucket to feed it, satiating its hunger and sending it scurrying away.

34016: Wooden spikes are used in goat hunting in southern Wyrmscraig . Players are required to line a pit with spikes before luring the goats into them. They can be obtained from the spikes supply found near Geoff the farmer.
34017: Wyrmscraig goat fur is a drop obtained by hunting Wyrmscraig Goats in the Goat hunting area on the island of Wyrmscraig . It can be used to dress golems in the golem crafting activity.
34020:
Sunstone is a material which can be mined from sunstone rocks or the sunstone monolith at level 53 Mining which is used in the Golem crafting minigame.

Sunstone can be crafted into a sunstone core at level 60 Crafting (gives 10 Crafting experience) when used with a chisel.
34022:
A sunstone core can be crafted through the Crafting skill at level 60 by using a chisel on a sunstone, granting 10 Crafting experience.

Sunstone cores are used in the golem crafting activity, together with a hunter furs, to complete and activate a golem, requiring 1 sunstone core and 1 fur per golem.

During the quest Fallen From Grace, one sunstone core is required to power the broken golem blocking a crevice leading into the basement of Ardeaglais.
34024:
The jeweller's chisel is a reward from golem crafting on the island of Wyrmscraig. It is an improved version of the chisel with passive effects when cutting gems. It adds a flat 20% to the player's chance to successfully cut opals, jades, and red topaz. (E.g. at level 60 crafting, the chance to successfully cut a jade will be increased from 73% to 93%.) It also has a 10% chance to cut two gems at once when cutting any gem, granting experience for both gems cut. This 10% chance also applies to cutting gems into bolt tips, with bolt tip cutting being over twice as fast as the standard chisel at 2 ticks (1.2s) per gem instead of 5.

It is obtained as a rare drop after inserting a sunstone core into an unpowered golem whilst golem crafting.

It is kept in the inventory on death. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player's costume room.
34027:
Hallowfell is a two-handed sword that requires level 75 Attack to wield. It is a reward from fighting the Mad Angel, a boss found on Wyrmscraig, and it has a unique effect where it can hit multiple enemies in an area around the player at once.

This item cannot be used in Death's Coffer.
34030:
The jar of light is a rare drop from the Mad Angel found on Wyrmscraig .

The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the Mad Angel. The jar also acts as a light source .
34032: The sunstone crystal is an item dropped by the Mad Angel during the quest Fallen From Grace. It is used to build the bank chest in Auchrie on Wyrmscraig, also requiring 2 lead bars, 8 mahogany planks, 32 mithril nails, a saw, and a hammer. If lost before building the bank chest, it can be reclaimed by speaking to Cormac or by defeating the Mad Angel again.
34033:
Ardeaglais teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of Ardeaglais on Wyrmscraig . It is dropped by the Mad Angel , and can be stored in the master scroll book .

This scroll is only usable after completing the Fallen From Grace quest. Attempting to use the scroll without meeting the requirements displays the game message: You need to have completed the Fallen From Grace quest before you can teleport to Ardeaglais.
34035: Placeholder is an unobtainable version of the Hallowfell that can be found in the game cache and seen in the search menu of the Grand Exchange . It shares most of its characteristics with the Hallowfell, except for an additional "Dismantle" option and its examine text of simply placeholder.
34040:
Mr McGroot is a pet obtained from hunting goats on Wyrmscraig, a Hunter training method.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat), it will be placed into their inventory. When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne.

On death, if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, and can be reclaimed from Probita.
34042:
Aggy is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Mad Angel , being a much smaller version of it.

When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

On death , if a player loses their pet (as a follower or in your inventory) it will wander around the area for 30 seconds before despawning. Even if the player returns in time, the pet cannot be picked up, however it can be reclaimed for free from Probita.
34044:
A large hat can be found on southern Wyrmscraig , near the west end of the Wyrmscraig Goat hunting area.

When investigated prior to beginning Fallen From Grace , it gives the message Someone's left their hat here. How odd. After starting the quest, investigating the large hat will play a cutscene the first time, then give the message The hat appears to be hooked onto a rock. Could it be Keenan's? . After continuing through the quest, the message will change to Likely Keenan's hat. Did he leave it here or lose it? After completion of the quest, the message becomes Hopefully poor Keenan will be the last victim of the Mad Angel.

The large hat cannot be picked up by the player, nor can it be picked up via Telekinetic Grab .
34045: The worn journal is found on a table in the basement of Ardeaglais. It cannot be picked up by the player, nor does Telekinetic Grab work on it, but it can be investigated to read it.
34046:

If lost, it can be reclaimed from a bookcase within a player-owned house or the searchable rocks next to the sunstone monolith.

34061: Vampyre snail shell is an unobtainable item. Presumably, the shell would have been dropped by the Vampyre Snail, and the player would have to craft it into a vampyre snelm. However, the snail drops the snelm directly rather than the shell.

34072: Sawmill coupon (camphor plank) is a type of sawmill coupon which is used to cover the 2,500 cost of converting camphor logs into camphor planks . The coupon is only redeemable at a sawmill , and cannot be substituted for coins when casting Plank Make .
34074: Sawmill coupon (ironwood plank) is a type of sawmill coupon which is used to cover the 5,000 cost of converting ironwood logs into ironwood planks . The coupon is only redeemable at a sawmill , and cannot be substituted for coins when casting Plank Make .

34404: The air diamond is an elemental gem obtained by killing killerwatts. It is used in the creation of the amulet of air, the air diamond must be used on the Air Runecrafting Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 air runes.
34407:
The amulet of air is an amulet that has the same base stats as an amulet of magic, with the added bonus of a +2 max hit to air spells.

To create an amulet of air, the air diamond must be used on the Air Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 air runes.

It can be combined into an elemental amulet, which adds a +2 max hit to spells of all four elements.

34428:
The elemental amulet is a magic amulet that gives a +2 max hit to all elemental spells. It is created by using any of the four elemental amulets on an elemental runecrafting altar, while having all four amulets and 500 air, water, earth, and fire runes in your inventory. The amulet has the same base stats as an amulet of magic.

The +2 max hit is added before magic damage and elemental weakness modifiers are applied, and therefore scales with both. This bonus stacks additively with the bonus from the chaos gauntlets, for a total of +5 max hits when casting bolt spells. The bonus does work against Salarin the Twisted.
